chapters.title: Chapter 851 - 457: The Great White Bear’s Secret
paragraphs: "That day, when I was patrolling this polar region, I found it possessed a kind of spirituality that no other creature on this planet has."
"It is smarter than other beasts, even capable of understanding my words."
"So, I taught it to learn, taught it to cultivate, taking roughly a thousand years, breaking through to a legend."
The crowd nodded.
Being able to cultivate to a legendary level in a place like this proves that this white bear’s talent is indeed quite remarkable.
Of course, this also has something to do with the teachings of the God of Radiance.
With the personal teachings of a Divine Spirit, let alone a legend, even becoming a demigod is quite simple.
"White bear, come and meet these human race adults."
The God of Radiance seemed quite pleased with this great white bear.
The bear obediently walked over.
"Greetings to the esteemed adults."
The white bear brought its two bear paws together and surprisingly bowed to the crowd.
This amusing scene caused two young women in the group to burst out laughing.
The white bear appeared somewhat confused and ignorant.
However, Han Xing sensed a hint of a different aura from it.
Thus, he directed his gaze towards the white bear’s information.
[Snow White Bear]: Legendary Creatures
[Level]: Level 54
[Attributes]: Power 17247, agility 15321, spirit 16231, constitution 20124
[Skills]: Blizzard Claw Strike, Tearing Storm, Advanced Thick Hide, Protection of the God of Fertility, Snow Mountain Seal (Legendary Skills)
[Divine Power Value]: 2731
Its attributes appear very ordinary.
Were it not for Han Xing seeing the name of one of the skills on the system panel, he would have treated this white bear as a common legend.
"Interesting," Han Xing thought with great interest.
To verify his conjecture, Han Xing released the golden divine power from his body, completely enveloping the white bear, beginning to examine its body.
"What are you doing?"
Feeling restrained, the white bear instinctively backed away.
Han Xing said nothing, continuing to explore its body meticulously.
The white bear became increasingly frantic, starting to wave its paws, struggling wildly.
"Roar! Let me go!!!"
However, under Han Xing’s suppression, not even a demigod could break free.
The team members also looked at Han Xing’s actions with some surprise, seemingly unsure of why he suddenly targeted this white bear.
At this moment, seeing that it could not escape, the white bear looked towards the God of Radiance for help.
"Divine Master! Save me!!"
The God of Radiance was completely bewildered at the moment.
He didn’t know what had happened, how this situation suddenly arose.
Testing the waters, he said, "Saint Master Han Xing... has this white bear offended you in any way?"
"If you say so, I’ll discipline it."
The God of Radiance accompanied his words with a smile.
The shock in the white bear’s eyes grew even stronger.
It wondered why the invincible God in its heart was showing such respect to this human.
Han Xing continued his exploration of the white bear’s body, speaking with interest, "Radiance, don’t rush; the results will appear soon."
"Don’t worry, I won’t do anything to this white bear."
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance slightly relaxed.
Then he said to the white bear, "White bear, cooperate a little."
"This is Saint Master Han Xing, and he said he won’t do anything to you."
Hearing the God of Radiance’s words, the white bear fell into complete despair.
It simply gave up on struggling, allowing Han Xing to investigate.
Finally, when Han Xing’s divine power touched the great white bear’s brain region.
He suddenly felt a stabbing pain akin to being pricked by needles.
Han Xing was forced to halt the divine power investigation.
The great white bear ’thumped’ to the ground, sat down, and opened its bear mouth, gasping for breath.
Walking over, the God of Radiance asked with a smile, "Saint Master Han Xing, did you discover anything?"
"I raised Big White; it shouldn’t have any issues."
Clearly, the God of Radiance valued this great white bear highly.
Having hidden here for thousands of years, only this great white bear could communicate with him, serving as the God of Radiance’s sole friend.
Yet Han Xing looked at him and then asked, "Radiance, do you know the God of Fertility?"
Upon hearing this, Radiance was taken aback, seeming to recall something.
A moment later, he responded, "I have some impression, but the God of Fertility is already dead."
"Dead?"
"Yes,"
The God of Radiance nodded, "She, like me, got caught up in the conflict between rules and became a defeated one."
Han Xing asked curiously, "Do you know who killed her?"
"Yes, it was the God of Life."
"The God of Fertility and the God of Life belonged to the same major system. That year, in order to break through to True Godhood, the God of Life devoured Fertility."
"By devouring Fertility, Life has evolved to become the Mother of Life."
At this point, the God of Radiance seemed to realize something, tentatively asking, "Saint Master Han Xing, are you implying this white bear is connected to the God of Fertility?"
The great white bear was by now completely panicking.
It hastily defended itself, "Lord God, I don’t know any God of Fertility; you have to believe me..."
Han Xing paid no attention to its defense, directly stating, "Not connected, rather this white bear is the reincarnation of the God of Fertility’s consciousness."
"She possibly predicted she’d be devoured by the Mother of Life and purposely preserved the last thread of consciousness, appearing within this white bear."
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance was astounded.
He looked uncertainly at the white bear, asking, "Big White, is what Han Xing says true?"
By now, the white bear kept shaking its head, "Lord God, I’m really not the God of Fertility; I’m your faithful follower!"

chapters.title: Chapter 852 - 457: The Great White Bear’s Secret (Part 2)
paragraphs: The God of Radiance fell into confusion once more.
He had been here for at least several thousand years.
He discovered this White Bear a thousand years ago.
However, compared to the White Bear’s testimony, he believed Han Xing’s words more.
When the God of Radiance’s gaze fell upon him, this White Bear seemed to realize something.
It panicked and said, "Divine Master! He’s lying to you, I’m really not the God of Fertility!"
"You have to believe me!"
However, just as the White Bear uttered these words,
The God of Radiance struck directly with a divine power seal, sealing the White Bear entirely.
It was sealed to the ground, with a confused expression, asking, "Divine Master, why?"
The God of Radiance responded with a chuckle, "Why, of course, because Saint Master Han Xing couldn’t possibly lie to me."
"Alright, stop pretending, Fertility."
"After all, we’re considered old friends, come out and show yourself."
At this moment, the White Bear, upon hearing these words, had the panic in its eyes gradually fade.
It then assumed a calm expression, saying, "Radiance, why do you choose to believe these few humans over my words?"
The God of Radiance chuckled softly, "If you hadn’t spoken, I might have been skeptical."
"But since you said those words, I’m thoroughly convinced that you are indeed the reincarnated consciousness of the God of Fertility."
"Do you even know who sealed you?"
The White Bear’s face was full of confusion, "Who?"
The God of Radiance smiled, "This one is Saint Master Han Xing, also my master."
The White Bear was stunned, eyes filled with disbelief, "Radiance, are you crazy?"
"You actually recognize this human as your master, he’s just a Legend!"
"I think you’ve been scared silly by the God of Light!
Nevertheless, the God of Radiance maintained a faint smile, "Of course I’m not crazy."
"The God of Light has already been dealt with by my master."
"Moreover, my master even allowed me to devour the rules of the God of Light, and my power has undergone a metamorphosis."
"Now, aside from the True God, there’s no other Divine Spirit that’s a match for me."
The White Bear listened, a look of bewilderment in its eyes.
"Radiance, what are you saying?"
"The God of Light had devoured the Dawn, even the True God wouldn’t dare claim a hundred percent chance of defeating such an existence."
"How is it possible for these few humans to achieve this?"
Knowing the White Bear’s disbelief, the God of Radiance immediately unleashed his aura.
In the next moment, a terrifying pressure enveloped them.
The White Bear was suddenly shocked, speaking with a tremor, "The aura of Light..."
"The limit of a Divine Spirit!"
"Heavens, you actually did take down the God of Light!"
The God of Radiance chuckled, "Don’t misunderstand."
"I said, it wasn’t me who took down the Light, but my master, Saint Master Han Xing."
At this moment, the White Bear gazed at Han Xing, with unprecedented seriousness in its eyes.
Despite being unable to imagine how this Legendary human could take down the God of Light,
The God of Radiance spoke with such certainty and sincerity that it couldn’t help but fully believe it.
At this moment, the White Bear sighed helplessly, "Radiance, you really lucked out, meeting a freak who spared you from a devoured fate."
"Whilst I can only eke out my existence, preserving the last sliver of consciousness in this godforsaken place."
The God of Radiance also found it incredibly unbelievable, "Fertility, I never expected, this planet, to actually be your doing,"
"After all, we are old friends, and you’ve been putting on an act in front of me for a thousand years, you’ve really got some skill!"
The White Bear said helplessly, "What could I do? This last bit of divine sense was my final hope."
"I couldn’t possibly place this hope on you."
The God of Radiance acknowledged that there was truth in those words.
Han Xing, standing by, interjected, "Alright, save the reminiscing for later, you can talk privately."
"First, tell me how you got here, and what your purpose is."
Han Xing looked at the Great White Bear.
The White Bear understood that in this place, the person with the most authority was this human.
It organized its memories, then slowly spoke.
"Back then, I saw Life devour vitality, then devour Spring, just a step away from becoming a True God."
"I knew the next one to die would definitely be myself."
"Unwilling to await death like that, I ventured into the Void to seek a sliver of hope."
"By a stroke of luck, I found the corpse of an Ancient Fierce Beast."
"Thus, I made some preparations beforehand."
"Later, I returned to that Forbidden Land, quietly waiting for my final moment."
"After being slain by Life, I devoured all the rules and Power."
"And she surely doesn’t know that I left my last hint of consciousness inside this Fierce Beast’s body, only gradually recovering a millennium ago.
"I didn’t expect that upon awakening, I’d see Radiance here too."
After hearing this, Han Xing also understood the secret of why the God of Fertility had arrived here.
It seemed that even among the Divine Spirits, the struggle over rules was quite brutal.
The weaker side has no choice but to await death, then be utterly consumed, down to the very last drop.
The God of Radiance also gazed helplessly, "Perhaps, this is the commonality among us defeated ones."
The Great White Bear nodded, speaking with a pleading tone, "Radiance, I’m now left with just the last bit of memory,"
"Please spare me, I won’t be a threat to you."
At this moment, Radiance didn’t speak but looked towards Han Xing beside him.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, "I can spare you, but for that, what price are you willing to pay?"
The Great White Bear was stunned, realizing Han Xing’s intentions.

chapters.title: Chapter 853 - 457: The Great White Bear’s Secret (Part 3)
paragraphs: A moment later, a bitter smile appeared on its bear-like face and it said, "I only have a sliver of consciousness left, what more can I give you?"
Han Xing chuckled, "Really? Feel free to think it over before you answer."
"If you can tell me something that piques my interest, I might just reward you with a complete rule."
The Great White Bear froze in place upon hearing this.
With an incredulous look, it asked, "What did you just say?"
"A complete rule!"
Han Xing nodded, "I shouldn’t have to explain what a complete rule signifies."
"With the rule suppression of the Holy Spirit Realm, even if you can’t break through to the Divine Realm, it would still grant you the power of a top demigod."
However, the Great White Bear excitedly responded, "No, if I get a complete rule, I could instantly wield divine-level power!"
Han Xing questioned, "Instantly possess divine power?"
"Can you ignore the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm?"
Yet, the White Bear stated, "A rule is a rule; no one can break it."
"Under the shroud of a rule, no one can ascend to the Divine Realm."
"But I’m different. I fell from the Divine Realm, so this rule doesn’t apply to me."
Hearing this, Han Xing pondered.
So that’s how it is, there’s a way to evade rule suppression through this method?
Han Xing fell silent.
However, the Great White Bear was thoroughly intrigued.
It longed desperately for the day it could return to the Divine Realm, and then seize the opportunity to reclaim everything it once had!
"This... Saint Master Han Xing, do you truly have a complete rule?"
Han Xing glanced at it and nodded.
Indeed, he possessed a system-rewarded complete rule named Serpent.
The Great White Bear didn’t doubt it, seeing as the God of Radiance was already nearing the True God Realm.
The Great White Bear pondered for a moment and said through gritted teeth, "How about I trade you the location of the Divine Treasure Vault for a complete rule?"
"The Divine Treasure Vault?
Han Xing contemplated briefly and shook his head, "The value of the Divine Treasure Vault doesn’t match that of a complete rule."
The Great White Bear nodded, "I know!"
"But what if I told you it’s not just one, but three Divine Treasure Vaults?"
At that moment, it wasn’t just Han Xing.
Others in the vicinity turned their gazes over to them.
The Great White Bear said, "Yes, aside from my own Fertility God’s Treasure Vault, I also know the locations of the Mother of Life’s and the Love God’s Vaults."
The God of Radiance was taken aback, "Wow, you even know the Love God’s Vault location?"
The Great White Bear nodded, "When I sensed Life was plotting against me, I started preparing and gathering all information about her."
"The Mother of Life, that vile being, surely has no idea I know her location."
"As for the Love God’s Vault, that was merely an accidental discovery..."
The Great White Bear looked at Han Xing and said, "So I use the information of these three vaults to exchange for a chance."
"A chance to return to the Divine Realm!"
After hearing this, Han Xing was indeed tempted.
Previously, they had opened a Divine Treasure Vault and reaped considerable rewards.
One should know, even a weak god like the God of Tricks had vast precious treasures in his vault,
with materials sufficient for Han Xing to set up three to four hundred Defense Towers.
But the Fertility, Life, and Love God were far stronger than the God of Tricks.
If he could plunder all three of their vaults, his territory’s strength would significantly soar.
However, Han Xing shook his head, "It’s not enough."
The White Bear was taken aback, "Not enough?"
"Yes, the locations of three vaults are valuable, but they aren’t readily accessible, unlike a complete rule."
The White Bear fell into deep thought.
It understood the rarity of a complete rule, even among Divine Spirits.
An ordinary Divine Spirit could ascend to the True God Realm, gaining immortality by devouring ten of the same tier rules.
After a mental struggle, the White Bear slowly said, "Three vaults are my deepest secret."
"If you need me to pledge loyalty like Radiance, it’s not out of the question either."
"Provided I can return to the Divine Realm."
However, Han Xing shook his head, "I don’t need you to fight for me."
"A Divine Spirit doesn’t offer substantial help."
"I need you to do something for me."
The White Bear asked, "What is it?"
Han Xing said, "In the future, I might bring a group of Human Race over here, I need you to swear by the Supreme Law."
"Until new Divine Spirits emerge from among the group I bring, you must protect them."
"Let them become the masters of this planet."
Upon hearing this request, not only the White Bear, but others present also froze.
They all realized something.
Han Xing was planning an escape route for the future of the Human Race.
Simultaneously, they understood Han Xing’s inner thoughts.
It’s very likely he didn’t believe he could stand against those terrifying enemies.
He was doing his utmost to preserve a spark for the Human Race.
At this moment, the team members behind him showed a hint of concern in their eyes.
The White Bear replied, "If it’s just to protect the Human Race, I can agree."
Han Xing nodded, "Alright."
"Then let’s swear by the Supreme Rule."

The God of Radiance was taken aback, "Wow, you even know the Love God’s Vault location?"
The Great White Bear nodded, "When I sensed Life was plotting against me, I started preparing and gathering all information about her."
"The Mother of Life, that vile being, surely has no idea I know her location."
"As for the Love God’s Vault, that was merely an accidental discovery..."
The Great White Bear looked at Han Xing and said, "So I use the information of these three vaults to exchange for a chance."
"A chance to return to the Divine Realm!"
After hearing this, Han Xing was indeed tempted.
Previously, they had opened a Divine Treasure Vault and reaped considerable rewards.
One should know, even a weak god like the God of Tricks had vast precious treasures in his vault,
with materials sufficient for Han Xing to set up three to four hundred Defense Towers.
But the Fertility, Life, and Love God were far stronger than the God of Tricks.
If he could plunder all three of their vaults, his territory’s strength would significantly soar.
However, Han Xing shook his head, "It’s not enough."
The White Bear was taken aback, "Not enough?"
"Yes, the locations of three vaults are valuable, but they aren’t readily accessible, unlike a complete rule."
The White Bear fell into deep thought.
It understood the rarity of a complete rule, even among Divine Spirits.
An ordinary Divine Spirit could ascend to the True God Realm, gaining immortality by devouring ten of the same tier rules.
After a mental struggle, the White Bear slowly said, "Three vaults are my deepest secret."
"If you need me to pledge loyalty like Radiance, it’s not out of the question either."
"Provided I can return to the Divine Realm."
However, Han Xing shook his head, "I don’t need you to fight for me."
"A Divine Spirit doesn’t offer substantial help."
"I need you to do something for me."
The White Bear asked, "What is it?"
Han Xing said, "In the future, I might bring a group of Human Race over here, I need you to swear by the Supreme Law."
"Until new Divine Spirits emerge from among the group I bring, you must protect them."
"Let them become the masters of this planet."
Upon hearing this request, not only the White Bear, but others present also froze.
They all realized something.
Han Xing was planning an escape route for the future of the Human Race.
Simultaneously, they understood Han Xing’s inner thoughts.
It’s very likely he didn’t believe he could stand against those terrifying enemies.
He was doing his utmost to preserve a spark for the Human Race.
At this moment, the team members behind him showed a hint of concern in their eyes.
The White Bear replied, "If it’s just to protect the Human Race, I can agree."
Han Xing nodded, "Alright."
"Then let’s swear by the Supreme Rule."

chapters.title: Chapter 854 - 458: Opening the Fertility God’s Treasure Vault
paragraphs: Han Xing added another sentence.
"However, there’s one thing, that Power of Rules, I can’t give it to you immediately."
"This time, I am going to a place. If I find new Power of Complete Rules there, I’ll give it to you then."
Han Xing had one complete Rule, but he can’t give it to the White Bear now.
He still needed 9 more to break through to Demigod himself, at least he has to satisfy his own breakthrough needs first, and then he can give to the White Bear, completing the bargain.
The locations of the three treasure vaults, can only be said to be neither a loss nor a gain.
The White Bear didn’t mind after hearing this and nodded.
After all, it also knew how precious a complete Power of Rules was.
"That’s fine, I’ll just wait for the good news from Saint Master Han Xing."
The White Bear hadn’t finished its sentence.
At that moment, the God of Radiance slapped over, spinning the Great White Bear hundreds of times.
Then it crashed heavily onto the ground.
"Bang!"
The Great White Bear lay on the ground, covering its face, angrily looking at the God of Radiance and said, "Radiance, why did you slap me?"
The God of Radiance retorted angrily, "Slap you for not having the tact!"
"Do you know the locations of the three treasure vaults and yet require my master to give you a complete Rule?"
"If it weren’t for the master’s grace, you’d be gone by now, understand?"
"Do you still think you’re the God of Fertility?"
After being scolded by the God of Radiance, the Great White Bear was dumbfounded.
At this point, it seemed to realize something.
Indeed, it was no longer the God of Fertility.
Now, it was just a little Legend being manipulated by others...
To bargain with such an entity capable of slaying the God of Light, it truly was risking its life unnecessarily!
It knew this was a reminder from the God of Radiance.
Even though Han Xing didn’t have that idea.
Han Xing spoke, "Radiance, no need to treat it like this."
"A bargain is a bargain. When I receive the new Power of Rules, I’ll have it tell me the location of the vaults."
However, the Great White Bear had already made a decision.
It said, "Saint Master Han Xing, Radiance is right, I indeed lost perspective."
"I can tell you the locations of the three treasure vaults first, and when you have extra Power of Rules later, just give me one."
Before Han Xing could speak, the Great White Bear said, covering its swollen cheek, "Besides, I trust that Saint Master Han Xing isn’t someone who goes back on his word."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing laughed, "Alright, I’ll remember this Power of Rules for you."
The White Bear smiled and nodded, "Then, I’ll tell Saint Master Han Xing the locations of the three treasure vaults now."
At this moment, all team members, including the God of Radiance, began to listen intently.
The White Bear said, "The first one, which is the Mother of Life’s treasure vault, is within the Void Turbulence, on a member of the Void Royal Family."
Han Xing was surprised, "Void Royal Family, the Mother of Life’s vault is mobile?"
The White Bear nodded, "Yes, she was smart and forged a pact with this member of the Void Royal Family to help manage the gate of her vault. In return, the Mother of Life granted it immense power."
"This member of the Void Royal Family is named Izat."
"I’ve also inquired about its typical range of activity, it’s inside a little world on the brink of extinction, deep within the Void."
"Specific location..."
After the White Bear finished speaking, Han Xing nodded understandingly.
The location of the Mother of Life’s treasure vault was truly hidden well.
If the White Bear hadn’t mentioned it, perhaps no one would think it would be hidden in such a place.
"Keep going," Han Xing said.
The White Bear nodded, "The second vault, the Love God’s vault, is hidden on a Space Fragment within an Anomalous Space Rift."
"Specific coordinates are..."
The White Bear said a location.
However, Han Xing asked in confusion, "Anomalous Space Rift, is it the place where those Evil Gods reside?"
The White Bear shook its head and said, "No, Anomalous Space Rifts are like passageways, generally hard to open."
"Only through Anomalous Space Rifts can one reach the Alternate Space, which is where those Evil Gods reside."
Everyone nodded in understanding.
Han Xing continued to ask, "Finally, it’s your vault, right?"
The White Bear nodded.
The God of Radiance asked, "Fertility, where is your vault hidden? It shouldn’t be here, right?"
The Great White Bear heard, then showed a simple-minded smile.
It shook its head and said, "Naturally, my vault is carried with me."
"It’s hidden in the central region of this planet."
After the White Bear spoke, the God of Radiance on the side was immediately unsettled.
"Fertility, are you serious about what you said?"
"All these years, I’ve used Divine Power to explore several times and never found the vault you mentioned!"
The White Bear glanced at Radiance, with a hint of humor in its eyes.
At this moment, the God of Radiance’s eyes were completely widened.
He stayed here for years, yet never found the God of Fertility’s vault.
Doesn’t this further prove his incompetence?
"Ahhh! How is this possible!"
Ignoring the God of Radiance.
The Great White Bear turned around, swinging its massive buttocks in front of everyone.
"Let’s go, I’ll take you to open my vault."
After these words, the Great White Bear took huge steps forward.
Everyone followed the White Bear.
Before long, they arrived at the foot of the snowy mountain ahead.
Here, there seemed to be a bottomless rift.
At the bottom of the rift, a hint of flowing red magma could be seen.
Without speaking, the White Bear was the first to leap, jumping into this rift.

chapters.title: Chapter 855 - 458: Opening the Fertility God’s Treasure Vault (2)
paragraphs: After more than a minute, everyone saw the White Bear plunge into the lava and disappear from sight.
The group exchanged glances, and Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain, "Are we jumping into lava again?"
"Do these gods all like to hide their treasure vaults in lava?"
He still remembered that the last time they raided the God of Tricks’ treasure vault, it was the same scenario.
However, the lava on this planet was naturally not as fierce as that in the Abyss Realm.
Moreover, this time they didn’t have to resist the lava’s temperature themselves.
The God of Radiance directly released divine power, wrapping everyone within it.
The next moment, as if the space shifted, they were directly brought to the depths of the lava below.
In an instant, they found themselves in a world of deep red,
At this moment, the God of Radiance traversed the lava as if it were flat ground.
With each flash, they could instantly cross tens of thousands of kilometers.
This was the mobility of a Divine Spirit Level being.
At full power, the God of Radiance could even instantly move millions of kilometers.
At this moment, the White Bear swimming ahead felt the powerful aura behind it and showed a look of envy in its eyes.
It turned its head and said, "Radiance, you’ve really struck it lucky this time."
"Not only did you not die by the hand of the Light, but you’ve also absorbed his Power of Rules. You’re not far from the True God Realm now, are you?"
Radiance chuckled lightly, "Almost, but all this is thanks to the master’s gift."
Once again, envy appeared in the White Bear’s eyes.
And it didn’t look down on the God of Radiance for calling Han Xing ’master’.
If there was someone who could help it reach the True God Realm, it wouldn’t mind acknowledging him as its master, or even as its father!
After all, True Gods are eternal entities.
At this realm, there is essentially no worry about any creature being able to threaten one’s safety.
Though the White Bear was envious, it said nothing more and continued to lead the way ahead quietly.
Soon, they reached the very bottom of the lava.
A brand new landscape appeared here.
The White Bear carefully dismantled a divine power seal here.
A dark passage leading deeper underground appeared before them.
In this passage, the group continued forward for a long time.
Almost an hour later, they had switched four or five passages, yet they still hadn’t reached the location of the Divine Treasure Vault that the White Bear mentioned.
At this point, the God of Radiance impatiently said, "Fertility, just tell me the location, and I’ll take you there directly, won’t I?"
"This planet doesn’t have anything that can threaten my power."
The White Bear was stunned.
Damn! That kind of makes sense!
After being slain by the Mother of Life for so long, it had already forgotten the mighty power of the Divine Spirit Level.
Especially since it was the God of Radiance, on the verge of breaking into the realm of True God.
At this moment, everyone else was staring speechlessly at the White Bear.
It turned out that this guy actually forgot.
They genuinely thought there was some terrifying restriction here.
The God of Radiance extended his divine power, enveloping the White Bear.
Then the White Bear provided a location.
The God of Radiance closed his eyes, sensing carefully.
The next moment, radiant divine power overflowed his entire body.
Light burst forth from the depths, directly enveloping the entire planet.
On the surface of the planet, billions of creatures shivered, as if they were being suppressed by a force from deep within their souls, unable to dare make any movement.
The God of Radiance’s divine power covered every corner of the planet.
Nothing could hide from it.
In the next moment, the God of Radiance opened his eyes.
Combined with the White Bear’s coordinates, he had already detected the location of the treasure vault.
Then, seven figures disappeared from where they stood.
"Swish!"
When they reappeared, they had already arrived at the core region beneath the continent.
This place was a void, unexpectedly devoid of any other matter.
Only a black metal gate appeared in front of them.
This gate contained a strong spatial fluctuation.
The methods these deities used to store treasures were pretty much the same — create an isolated space of their own and then construct a door.
"Wait a moment, I’ll remove the divine power seal on the gate for you."
After saying that, the White Bear stepped forward.
With a light flick of its paw, the divine power seal on the door was lifted.
A system prompt appeared.
[The Divine Door is slowly opening...]
Then, six people and a bear stepped into the vault.
[You have entered the hidden area: Fertility God’s Treasure Vault.]
Upon seeing the system prompt, Han Xing’s face lit up with joy.
The interior, just like the God of Tricks’ vault, was piled high with countless gems and precious metals.
Cheng Jianyong looked at the dazzling array of precious materials in the vault and exclaimed, "White, you’ve got quite the stash of good stuff here!"
The Great White Bear glanced at Cheng Jianyong, a bit pained as it said, "These are the fruits of millennia of my effort. Among them are some precious items that I myself am reluctant to use."
"Also, I am female."
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "We’re all buddies here, what’s mine is yours."
Under the White Bear’s helpless gaze, Han Xing directly said, "Pack it up."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong shouted joyfully, "Wuhu! Time to haul the treasure!"
The next moment, the team eagerly rushed towards the pile of precious items,
[Obtained Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*7243...]
[Obtained Philosopher’s Stone*10831.]
[Obtained Waveless Metal*29231.]
Watching the rapidly increasing materials in the backpack, a constant look of joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 856 - 458: Opening the Fertility God’s Treasure Vault_3
paragraphs: Gotta say, this sensation of raiding a house feels as exhilarating as ever.
The Great White Bear stood to the side, face full of agony, after all, this was its life’s savings,
only to be packed up like looted goods by these people all at once.
The most outrageous part was, they didn’t even spare the chandeliers on the walls and the floor!
It was like locusts swarming over everything.
Almost stripping the very walls of the vault bare!
The White Bear kept taking deep breaths, trying hard to stay calm.
"Calm down, calm down!"
"These things are just material possessions."
"I must trust in Saint Master Han Xing, who will eventually bring me a complete rule."
Thinking of this, the pangs of his heart gradually lessened.
Five minutes later.
The group had almost cleaned out the perimeter area of this treasure vault.
The team members, faces flushed with excitement, came over happily to report their haul to Han Xing.
Han Xing tallied up the numbers.
Among them, alone for the Philosopher’s Stones, they collected nearly ten million here.
The various other elemental stones and Ancient Elf Secret Ingots add up to around seven or eight million.
The current haul by itself had already surpassed the God of Tricks’ treasure vault!
Looking toward the White Bear at the back, Han Xing said satisfactorily, "Not bad, God of Fertility, didn’t expect you to have hoarded such precious materials in secret."
The White Bear forced a smile.
Han Xing and others continued to search the inner area.
Inside, they again found precious materials equivalent to half of the perimeter area, along with two or three Divine Artifacts they couldn’t use.
These Divine Artifacts were mostly armor parts.
Since they were currently wearing a full set of Abyssal Magical Artifacts, there was no need to switch them out.
However, when they get out, they could place them in Xingyu City’s equipment store as a new store treasure.
Han Xing had it all planned; whoever is the first to break through to Legend will be rewarded with a Divine Artifact.
After all, all these players have signed a lifelong contract with him, so loyalty isn’t a concern.
Seeing these Divine Artifacts, the players would certainly be motivated to level up.
Han Xing was very pleased with this idea, nodding his head in satisfaction.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, shouldn’t the materials in this vault be enough to set up over five hundred Calamity Towers?"
Han Xing nodded, "Should be enough."
"Once we get the chance, we’ll loot the other two Divine Spirits’ treasure vaults too, and the number of Defense Towers will be enough to instantly kill a True God."
Upon hearing this, everyone was filled with anticipation.
A True God was a looming threat over them.
With the power to deal with a True God, they wouldn’t have to worry as much.
Han Xing said, "Alright, let’s not dwell on this now, let’s check out the other spoils."
Saying that, Han Xing took out two Divine Formats.
These were also found in the God of Fertility’s treasure vault.
Two rhombic crystals hovered in the air, radiating dazzling light.
In front of everyone’s eyes appeared the attributes of these two Divine Formats.
[Divine Format·Reproduction]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: Legends and above can significantly increase their Divine Power Value by absorbing the Divine Power contained in the Divine Format, with an increase range of 3000~3500.
[Effect 2]: Any profession, upon reaching level 60, can use this Divine Format to break through to Demigod, controlling part of the ’Reproduction’ Law.
[Divine Format·Compassion]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: Same as above.
[Effect 2]: Same as above.
Seeing the attributes of these two Divine Formats, Han Xing glanced at the White Bear and said, "Are these two Divine Formats also part of your backup plan?"
The White Bear awkwardly nodded, "Yes, the Power of Rules contained in my Reproduction Divine Format is not much, even if the Mother of Life devours my Power of Rules, she won’t notice."
Han Xing nodded, then tossed the [Reproduction] Divine Format to the White Bear.
The White Bear was flabbergasted as it caught it.
"This..." It hesitated to accept.
Han Xing said bluntly, "Just take it.
The White Bear stopped refusing and put the Divine Format away.
Han Xing also stored away the other[Compassion] Divine Format in his backpack.
He didn’t absorb it immediately.
Because Han Xing remembered what the Ancient Tree once told him.
Once the Power of Rules from a Divine Format is absorbed, it will be sensed by a Rule Master.
Not only will his coordinates be exposed, but it might also attract retaliation.
Han Xing planned to make this place a fallback option, so he wouldn’t absorb it here.
He intended to find a chance, and once he had accumulated enough Divine Formats, absorb them in one go.
Just then, everyone returned from scouring the Fertility God’s Treasure Vault a few more times.
The team members were still somewhat unsatisfied.
They even thought about looting ten or a hundred more Divine Treasure Vaults!
Suddenly remembering something, Han Xing asked, "Radiance, what about your treasure vault?"
Upon hearing Han Xing mention it, the God of Radiance’s body instantly stiffened.
The White Bear, on the other hand, wore a gloating smile.
The God of Radiance strained to say, "Master, my treasure vault is near a forbidden zone, I’m unable to take you there now."
"Forbidden zone?"
Han Xing was puzzled.
The God of Radiance nodded, then glanced at the White Bear beside him,
Han Xing understood his meaning and didn’t press further.
Instead, he changed the topic, asking, "Then do you know where the God of Light’s treasure vault is?"
Han Xing had defeated the God of Light too quickly.
He hadn’t had the chance to ask where the vault was before killing the God of Light.
But in that situation, the God of Light knew he would die and wouldn’t have disclosed the vault’s location anyway.
Hearing this question, the God of Radiance’s eyes reflected a thoughtful look.

sentences.text: Gotta say, this sensation of raiding a house feels as exhilarating as ever.
The Great White Bear stood to the side, face full of agony, after all, this was its life’s savings,
only to be packed up like looted goods by these people all at once.
The most outrageous part was, they didn’t even spare the chandeliers on the walls and the floor!
It was like locusts swarming over everything.
Almost stripping the very walls of the vault bare!
The White Bear kept taking deep breaths, trying hard to stay calm.
"Calm down, calm down!"
"These things are just material possessions."
"I must trust in Saint Master Han Xing, who will eventually bring me a complete rule."
Thinking of this, the pangs of his heart gradually lessened.
Five minutes later.
The group had almost cleaned out the perimeter area of this treasure vault.
The team members, faces flushed with excitement, came over happily to report their haul to Han Xing.
Han Xing tallied up the numbers.
Among them, alone for the Philosopher’s Stones, they collected nearly ten million here.
The various other elemental stones and Ancient Elf Secret Ingots add up to around seven or eight million.
The current haul by itself had already surpassed the God of Tricks’ treasure vault!
Looking toward the White Bear at the back, Han Xing said satisfactorily, "Not bad, God of Fertility, didn’t expect you to have hoarded such precious materials in secret."
The White Bear forced a smile.
Han Xing and others continued to search the inner area.
Inside, they again found precious materials equivalent to half of the perimeter area, along with two or three Divine Artifacts they couldn’t use.
These Divine Artifacts were mostly armor parts.
Since they were currently wearing a full set of Abyssal Magical Artifacts, there was no need to switch them out.
However, when they get out, they could place them in Xingyu City’s equipment store as a new store treasure.
Han Xing had it all planned; whoever is the first to break through to Legend will be rewarded with a Divine Artifact.
After all, all these players have signed a lifelong contract with him, so loyalty isn’t a concern.
Seeing these Divine Artifacts, the players would certainly be motivated to level up.
Han Xing was very pleased with this idea, nodding his head in satisfaction.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, shouldn’t the materials in this vault be enough to set up over five hundred Calamity Towers?"
Han Xing nodded, "Should be enough."
"Once we get the chance, we’ll loot the other two Divine Spirits’ treasure vaults too, and the number of Defense Towers will be enough to instantly kill a True God."
Upon hearing this, everyone was filled with anticipation.
A True God was a looming threat over them.
With the power to deal with a True God, they wouldn’t have to worry as much.
Han Xing said, "Alright, let’s not dwell on this now, let’s check out the other spoils."
Saying that, Han Xing took out two Divine Formats.
These were also found in the God of Fertility’s treasure vault.
Two rhombic crystals hovered in the air, radiating dazzling light.
In front of everyone’s eyes appeared the attributes of these two Divine Formats.
[Divine Format·Reproduction]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: Legends and above can significantly increase their Divine Power Value by absorbing the Divine Power contained in the Divine Format, with an increase range of 3000~3500.
[Effect 2]: Any profession, upon reaching level 60, can use this Divine Format to break through to Demigod, controlling part of the ’Reproduction’ Law.
[Divine Format·Compassion]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: Same as above.
[Effect 2]: Same as above.
Seeing the attributes of these two Divine Formats, Han Xing glanced at the White Bear and said, "Are these two Divine Formats also part of your backup plan?"
The White Bear awkwardly nodded, "Yes, the Power of Rules contained in my Reproduction Divine Format is not much, even if the Mother of Life devours my Power of Rules, she won’t notice."
Han Xing nodded, then tossed the [Reproduction] Divine Format to the White Bear.
The White Bear was flabbergasted as it caught it.
"This..." It hesitated to accept.
Han Xing said bluntly, "Just take it.
The White Bear stopped refusing and put the Divine Format away.
Han Xing also stored away the other[Compassion] Divine Format in his backpack.
He didn’t absorb it immediately.
Because Han Xing remembered what the Ancient Tree once told him.
Once the Power of Rules from a Divine Format is absorbed, it will be sensed by a Rule Master.
Not only will his coordinates be exposed, but it might also attract retaliation.
Han Xing planned to make this place a fallback option, so he wouldn’t absorb it here.
He intended to find a chance, and once he had accumulated enough Divine Formats, absorb them in one go.
Just then, everyone returned from scouring the Fertility God’s Treasure Vault a few more times.
The team members were still somewhat unsatisfied.
They even thought about looting ten or a hundred more Divine Treasure Vaults!
Suddenly remembering something, Han Xing asked, "Radiance, what about your treasure vault?"
Upon hearing Han Xing mention it, the God of Radiance’s body instantly stiffened.
The White Bear, on the other hand, wore a gloating smile.
The God of Radiance strained to say, "Master, my treasure vault is near a forbidden zone, I’m unable to take you there now."
"Forbidden zone?"
Han Xing was puzzled.
The God of Radiance nodded, then glanced at the White Bear beside him,
Han Xing understood his meaning and didn’t press further.
Instead, he changed the topic, asking, "Then do you know where the God of Light’s treasure vault is?"
Han Xing had defeated the God of Light too quickly.
He hadn’t had the chance to ask where the vault was before killing the God of Light.
But in that situation, the God of Light knew he would die and wouldn’t have disclosed the vault’s location anyway.
Hearing this question, the God of Radiance’s eyes reflected a thoughtful look.

chapters.title: Chapter 857 - 459: Small World in the Void
paragraphs: The God of Radiance replied, "For us gods, our treasure vaults are the deepest secrets in our hearts. We rarely ever speak of them to other beings."
"However, when I was absorbing the Power of Rules belonging to the God of Light, I seem to have absorbed a fragment of the memories buried deep in his mind as well."
"I think I saw, in the Void, a small, prosperous world. The God of Light often went there..."
"That was also his most profound memory."
"I don’t know if that’s where the Light treasure vault is located, but I imagine that place must be extremely important to him."
Han Xing nodded slightly. "Do you know the coordinates?"
The God of Radiance replied, "I only know the general coordinate range. It’s extremely far from here."
After hearing this, Han Xing didn’t continue asking.
He could always go searching for it later when the opportunity arose.
With this, he had essentially grasped the locations of three Divine Treasure Vaults.
If he could loot them all, Han Xing’s strength would skyrocket.
Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh that this trip through the Void had already been worth it up to now.
He had not only gained a Top-tier Divine Level enforcer, and within four or five years the other party could even break through to True God.
Now he had also stripped a god’s treasure vault and learned the coordinates of three more vaults.
It was truly a huge haul.
Han Xing looked toward the God of Radiance beside him and said, "Radiance, I’ll give you half a day. Deal with everything here, and erase all fluctuations outside as well."
"Don’t let any being sense that our aura has ever passed through this place."
"I’ll wait for you in the deeper Void ahead."
The God of Radiance understood what Han Xing meant and said respectfully, "Understood, master."
As his words fell, six people and one bear all appeared on the planet’s surface.
Since everything here had already been searched, and everything that needed to be checked had been checked,
Han Xing had no reason to linger.
He led the group and directly flew out from within the beast’s body.
Below, two figures watched Han Xing and the others depart.
The Great White Bear and the God of Radiance stood side by side.
As the God of Fertility, the Great White Bear was now looking at the God of Radiance with a complicated gaze.
"Radiance, can you tell me now what you’re thinking?"
The Great White Bear said, "How did you end up recognizing that human as your master? That’s not like your style at all."
After hearing this, a faint smile flashed in the eyes of the God of Radiance. "Reproduction, you don’t understand."
"In that human, I saw the shadows of those two. He very likely might become the third existence to break the Rule."
Hearing this, the Great White Bear seemed to recall some terrifying matter. "You mean..."
"He’s also an existence like Hunter and the Demon Emperor?"
The God of Radiance lightly laughed and nodded.
The Great White Bear suddenly nodded in realization. "If he can become the third existence in history to break the Rule, then he is indeed worth throwing our lot in with."
Then the Great White Bear pondered again. "But even if he can break the Rule, so what?"
"You should know that even Hunter and the Demon Emperor have already failed."
"There’s no way he can stop the Era of Extinct Gods from descending."
After hearing this, the God of Radiance also nodded. "That’s true. Hunter and the Demon Emperor could break the Rule, but they could not defy the world itself..."
"But this Han Xing is different. On him, I’ve discovered something distinct."
The Great White Bear asked in puzzlement, "Something distinct?"
"You’re referring to the Power with which he slew the God of Light?"
The God of Radiance shook his head. "No."
"The Power with which he beheaded the God of Light is indeed terrifying, but that is not the most special thing about him."
"It’s very likely that even he himself has yet to realize the special nature on his own body."
The confusion in the Great White Bear’s eyes deepened. "Special nature—what is it?"
The God of Radiance continued to shake his head. "I don’t know, because I’m still not very sure right now."
"After all, before him, no one has ever reached this kind of degree."
"I don’t know whether he will walk that path or not."
The Great White Bear rolled his eyes at him. "All mysterious and secretive... forget it, I’m too lazy to bother with you."
"Let’s hope your choice this time isn’t wrong...
Finished speaking, the Great White Bear lay back down in the polar environment and entered hibernation.
Half a day later.
The Divine Demon Battleship floated in midair, like a ship sailing through the deep cosmos.
After a short while, a beam of light rapidly shot over from behind.
The beam of light drilled straight into the cabin of the Divine Demon Battleship and appeared before Han Xing.
It was precisely the God of Radiance.
As soon as he saw Han Xing, he spoke with a smile. "Master, I’ve already erased all traces in the rear."
"I’ve checked over and over. Even the God of Light’s aura has been cleared by me again and again."
"There shouldn’t be any other powerhouse who discovers that a god once fell in that place."
Han Xing nodded slightly. "Radiance, you did well."
"Since you’ve returned, we’re heading to the next place."
The God of Radiance asked tentatively, "Where is the next place?"
Han Xing did not answer.
Instead, he took three items out of his backpack.
They were, respectively, a Longbow that had lost its Divine Power.
A broken Arrow.
And a rusty key.
These three items represented three places he needed to go.
At this moment, in the Void, all three items began to emit a faint Divine Power fluctuation.
As though they were guiding Han Xing toward some destination.
Han Xing carefully sensed them. Through the aura fluctuations on the items, and the guidance transmitted from the unseen depths,
he could determine where these things wanted to go, and how far those places were from their current position.
A moment later, Han Xing nodded in realization.

chapters.title: Chapter 858 459: Small World in the Void (Part 2)
paragraphs: It's clear that these three items are located in different positions and are extremely far apart.
The nearest one is the [Longbow of the Night Goddess]
This weapon can lead them to the location of the Goddess Palace of the Night.
The second furthest is the [Palace of the Barbaric God].
The farthest is the area of [Land of Divine War].
After contemplating for a moment, Han Xing initially wanted to head directly to the Night Goddess's palace.
However, he was concerned that the goddess might also be there.
Before going, he wanted to ask the God of Radiance about the power of the Night Goddess.
Upon hearing Han Xing's question.
The God of Radiance began to sift through his memories.
Then, he shook his head and said, "Regarding the Night Goddess, my memories are not very clear."
"I only know she is a deity older than us, one of the earliest beings to become a Divine Spirit."
"Moreover, deities from her era are very low-key, never seeking to devour the Power of Rules from other deities to break through to a higher realm."
"However, as far as I know, the Dark Night has not broken through to the True God Realm."
"Because her counterparts in the same system, Black Shadow and Netherworld, are still alive."
Han Xing nodded.
As long as she is not a True God, he felt much relieved.
The God of Radiance added, "However, it is important to note that the Night Goddess has formidable combat power, with virtually no opponents in the Divine Realm."
Han Xing listened and curiously asked, "Oh? Compared to you now, who is stronger?"
The God of Radiance pondered for a while, then laughed, "I should have a slight advantage."
Han Xing nodded and said, "Alright."
Cheng Jianyong on the side asked, "Brother Xing, is the next place where we need to find the Night Goddess's resting chamber, or palace?"
Han Xing glanced at him, "Yes."
"But when we get near the Night Goddess Palace, watch what you say. Be careful she hears and gets angry, then decides to hunt you down."
Cheng Jianyong embarrassedly scratched his head, "I'm just curious."
"Speaking of which, this is the first time we're going to a deity's palace. I wonder what treasures might be inside?"
Upon hearing this, a sense of expectation arose within the group.
After all, it was a deity's palace, which might contain riches comparable to the Divine Treasure Vault.
Then, Han Xing nodded and said, "Alright, it's time to prepare for Teleportation."
"As planned, it might take us seven consecutive days of Teleportation to reach there."
The group secretly smacked their tongues.
Really far!
Even the Divine Demon Battleship, with such high mobility, would take a full seven days!
Seven days of travel, comparable to their past four years!
Han Xing didn't say much else and instead spoke to the God of Radiance nearby, "Next, we will perform the Teleportation action."
"The energy in the Void will enter a frenzied state due to the warp fluctuations. I need you to release Divine Power to block the surging Void Energy."
Though the God of Radiance hadn't heard of the Teleportation before.
He understood Han Xing asking him to release Divine Power to block Void Energy.
"Alright, Master." The God of Radiance nodded.
At the same time, Han Xing directly pressed the Teleportation button.
Broadcast voice appeared.
"Entering warp state, countdown starts in five seconds, initiating warp."
"Five..."
"Four..."
At this moment, the God of Radiance finally understood what Han Xing meant by energy frenzy.
The moment he pressed the button.
Tens of thousands of kilometers of spatial energy was disturbed, an endless energy frenzy surged towards the Divine Demon Battleship!
Even the God of Radiance was amazed; even he hadn't experienced such a scene.
He hurriedly unleashed radiant light, shielding the surrounding Divine Power.
"Buzz!"
Towering radiance enveloped the entire Divine Demon Battleship.
With the Divine Power Barrier from the God of Radiance, the group immediately felt the pressure ease.
Meanwhile.
The countdown for the Divine Demon Battleship had also finished.
In the next instant, this vast structure over a thousand kilometers long vanished from its original place.
The God of Radiance was astonished as he looked at the holographic screen, at the scene like a space-time tunnel.
This was his first time entering the warp state.
The God of Radiance couldn't resist his curiosity, and wondered aloud, "Master, how have you mastered such a miraculous mighty power?"
"It's terrifying, already comparable to my Movement Speed!"
Han Xing replied flatly, "The top-tier technology of the Abyss Race, not my Power."
"However, the battleship's travel distance isn't as far as mine."
After hearing this, the God of Radiance nodded as well.
He lightly murmured about the Abyss Realm...
In the next moment.
The Divine Demon Battleship emerged from the space-time tunnel.
Like a sailboat breaking through giant waves.
Instantly, turbulent energy surged.
The God of Radiance directly released Divine Power, isolating all energy surges miles away!
He was a being on the verge of reaching True God Level,
He had this capability.
The group comfortably sat inside the battleship.
Allowing the Void Energy to constantly tremble, they didn't feel a trace of disturbance inside.
Then, the Divine Demon Battleship smoothly sailed out of the storm zone.
Cheng Jianyong came over and patted the God of Radiance's shoulder, saying, "Pretty good, Old Guang."
The God of Radiance smiled, not minding Cheng Jianyong's gesture.
With Divine Level power, their upcoming Teleportation would be smooth sailing.
Then, was repeated warp and continuous rapid progress.
Time flew, and five days had passed.
At this moment, the Divine Demon Battleship still maintained in a terrifying movement state.

chapters.title: Chapter 859 - 459: Small World in the Void_3
paragraphs: There’s no denying it, the Endless Void truly lives up to its name, it’s boundless and limitless.
In the Holy Spirit Realm, if you teleport continuously for five days, it’s already enough for Han Xing to travel from the southernmost point to the northernmost point.
This isn’t to say that the Holy Spirit Realm isn’t big.
On the contrary, this world is already absurdly large.
And according to those top-tier beings, the Holy Spirit Realm is still expanding,
compared to ten thousand years ago, it has at least expanded by a third in volume.
At this rate, in another tens or even hundreds of thousands of years, the volume of the Holy Spirit Realm is expected to swell by hundreds of times.
The journey through the Endless Void is destined to be monotonous.
But fortunately, traveling together, it’s not boring.
Cheng Jianyong wandered idly around the battleship cockpit.
At this moment, through the ship’s virtual external screen, he saw something different.
"Whoa... what’s that?"
Cheng Jianyong suddenly looked outside, puzzled, pointing ahead: "Brother Xing, come over quickly, I think I’ve found something."
Han Xing heard the call, walking over to Cheng Jianyong’s side.
Following Cheng Jianyong’s direction, Han Xing saw a strange sphere appearing in the void ahead.
The sphere was emitting intermittent flashes of light.
All along their journey, it was just void upon void.
This was the first time they’d encountered such an object in the void.
"Let’s go, take a closer look."
Having said that, Han Xing directly maneuvered the Divine Demon Battleship closer.
The team members also approached the cockpit’s edge, gazing at the black sphere ahead.
As the battleship got closer, everyone realized that the black sphere was bigger than they had imagined.
Its diameter alone was over a thousand kilometers.
And when Han Xing focused his gaze, he discovered that it was filled with all kinds of void catastrophes.
Silent Annihilation Lightning and the Flame of Conflagration were rampant, Withered Snowflakes and Fury Heart Storm covered the entire sphere.
And the light from the sphere was the result of these catastrophes bursting out.
"Whoa... what’s the situation with this sphere, how can there be catastrophes erupting inside?" Han Xing was full of confusion.
The God of Radiance walked over, well-versed in many things, and explained: "Master, that is a small world in the process of forming."
"A small world?" Han Xing was immediately taken aback.
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, the small world inside is undergoing its first catastrophe since its creation."
"Only after destruction can rebirth occur."
"After the terrifying calamity at the beginning of the world, some basic elements will appear in that world."
"And these basic elements are the foundation for life to arise."
"Then, this small world will gradually evolve, beginning to expand its area, becoming a new world with relatively perfected rules."
Hearing this, everyone became thoughtful.
Han Xing asked, "Radiance, do you mean that if this small world continues to evolve, it could eventually become a Great World like the Holy Spirit Realm?"
But the God of Radiance merely smiled and shook his head, "Not exactly."
"Master, you have to understand, the Holy Spirit Realm is unique."
"From those forbidden beings who have reached a terrifying level, yet still must return to the Holy Spirit Realm, you can see."
"That main realm has an unparalleled attraction to them."
"Like the void, countless small worlds are born every moment, and countless worlds face destruction too."
"So, how this small world ultimately evolves, we cannot predict."
Han Xing nodded, his understanding of the void deepening.
"Let’s go, get a closer look."
With that said, Han Xing maneuvered the Divine Demon Battleship toward the small world.
At this moment.
The small sphere appeared to be less than a hundred kilometers in diameter.
But as the Divine Demon Battleship approached, everyone felt a terrifying attraction.
Boom!
The Divine Demon Battleship suddenly tilted, as if it was about to be swept away by that terrifying pull.
The calamity defense towers on the ship kept trembling.
A red light appeared above everyone’s head.
"Alert! Alert!"
"Unknown energy pull encountered, battleship engine system malfunction!"
"Please move away from the energy’s area as quickly as possible!"
Hearing this alert, everyone’s faces changed.
"Damn, what’s happening?"
"Even the Divine Demon Battleship is about to be sucked in!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
However, Han Xing didn’t panic.
He glanced at the God of Radiance, signaling him to take action.
The God of Radiance understood, then directly released divine power, enveloping the entire Divine Demon Battleship.
"Buzz!"
An immense radiance erupted.
At the same time, the terrifying pull disappeared.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief simultaneously.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim at this moment, "Just a newly-formed small world has such terrifying attraction, isn’t this a bit too absurd?"
The God of Radiance laughed, "Normally, these small worlds wouldn’t have this kind of attraction; it’s because the energy within this small world is already out of control."
"Out of control?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes."
"In the void, the birth of any small world is random, uncontrollable."
"This small world may encounter various accidents and catastrophes midway."
"The various energies and rules within it become extremely chaotic."
"Severely, it might lead to world collapse and direct disappearance into the void."
"If it can endure, it’ll be akin to rebirth; if not, perishing in the womb is normal."
Han Xing pondered, "Radiance, can this small world withstand the catastrophes inside?"
The God of Radiance focused his gaze, after observing for three seconds, he shook his head, "No, the basic rules inside have already been destroyed."

chapters.title: Chapter 860 - 460: Fantasy Level Artifact, Divine Level Puppet
paragraphs: The God of Radiance shook his head and said, "No, it’s over. The basic Rules of this small world have already been broken."
"If this keeps going, even if it survives this wave of heavenly calamity, it’ll lose the ability to keep expanding."
"And judging from this situation, this small world will most likely be directly wiped out in this wave of calamity."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this.
He remained where he was, observing the internal condition of this small world.
Through the thin World Barrier, he could see that the inside was filled with clumps of gaseous mist.
At the same time, waves upon waves of world-ending disasters were sweeping through the interior.
The small World Barrier was covered with dense cracks.
It was indeed as the God of Radiance had said. At this rate, this small world most likely wouldn’t be able to hold on.
The other team members were watching with full concentration as well.
Observing the birth of a small world like this, and then personally watching the scene of its Destruction, was an experience they had never had before.
However, at this moment, as Han Xing looked at this small world...
He noticed that cracks were appearing again and again, and again and again being repaired.
Although the speed of repair was far behind the speed at which the cracks appeared...
Han Xing could still see this world’s struggle and unwillingness to submit.
It was exhausting everything it had to resist these calamities in the Chaos, refusing to give up until the very last moment.
In Han Xing’s heart, a different kind of understanding suddenly arose.
After a moment of contemplation, Han Xing turned around and asked, "Radiance, in a situation like this, can we intervene artificially?"
"For example, we make a move and help this world get through this tribulation?"
The God of Radiance froze for a moment when he heard this. "In theory, we can, but no one has ever done so."
"Because this seems to touch on a certain taboo. It might trigger some kind of powerful backlash, and in serious cases, even a Divine Spirit could fall on the spot!"
The God of Radiance seemed extremely apprehensive about this so-called taboo.
He continued, "Moreover, if this small world can’t rely on its own Power to pass this tribulation..."
"Then when the greater calamities come later, this world will basically have no chance of making it through."
Han Xing nodded.
After observing for a while longer, he found that even more cracks had appeared on the shell of this small world.
In this state, it clearly meant that it had truly exhausted all its potential.
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly said, "Radiance, you should make a move and try."
Radiance pointed at himself. "Huh? Me?"
Han Xing nodded. "Didn’t you just say we might provoke some kind of taboo Power?"
"I’m still too weak right now. If we really provoke that kind of Power, I won’t be able to block it."
"So if it’s not you, then who else is going to do it?"
The God of Radiance’s face was full of speechlessness.
Yes, that was the logic.
But saying it that bluntly... wasn’t that a bit much?
You’re afraid of provoking that taboo Power—do you think I’m not afraid?
Though that’s what he thought in his heart, the God of Radiance still obediently made his move.
At this point, he basically already obeyed Han Xing’s words unconditionally.
Boundless Divine Power of Radiance passed through this world’s fragile Barrier and seeped into its interior.
This was only a newborn small world.
The Divine Power of the God of Radiance was enough to completely envelop it.
As his Divine Power Burst forth...
All those terrifying calamities inside were completely neutralized by the God of Radiance’s Divine Power.
A dozen seconds later.
All the calamities inside had vanished without a trace.
The God of Radiance withdrew his Divine Power, then clapped his hands and said, "It worked, Master."
Before Han Xing could reply...
He suddenly saw the God of Radiance’s expression twist drastically, then his body jerked. As if struck by a heavy blow, his whole person was sent flying backward!
"Bang!"
The God of Radiance flew back dozens of kilometers, even smashing through the main hatch of the cockpit, and continued flying into the interior of the battleship.
"Radiance!
A flash of terror appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
He turned into a streak of flowing light and quickly gave chase.
The change came too fast; the other team members hadn’t even had time to react.
They rushed after him as well.
At this moment, the God of Radiance had crashed into a rest room in the cabin.
A trace of pale golden blood seeped from the corner of his mouth.
At the same time, a terrifying Power of Rules from the Void descended, surging entirely into the God of Radiance’s body.
Radiance’s eyes snapped open, and his consciousness returned in an instant.
In that moment, the recovery capability of a Top-tier Divine Level being was on full display!
Seeing Han Xing rushing over at extreme speed, the God of Radiance patted his chest and said,
"Master, I’m fine."
Han Xing appeared beside Radiance and let out a sigh of relief.
Then he hurriedly asked, "What happened? Did we really provoke that taboo Power?"
The God of Radiance shook his head. "I’m not entirely sure. I only felt that at the final moment, a certain Power suddenly Attacked my Divine Body."
"Mixed in with it was an extremely vast Power."
"That Power was simply unstoppable. It felt like it could completely erase me in an instant!"
"I have a feeling it was only because we interfered with a small world."
"If I had interfered with a slightly larger world just now, I might have fallen on the spot!"
Hearing this, Han Xing frowned. "That serious? You’re someone who’s about to break through to the True God realm."
"To erase you in an instant—just how terrifying must that Power be?"
The God of Radiance nodded. "Master, there are simply too many powerful taboos and secrets in the Void."
"Once you become a True God, you may be undying and imperishable."
"But in the Void, there are far too many bizarre Powers that can even ignore Rules and directly wipe you out."
"So no matter how high a realm we reach, we must never underestimate the Void."

chapters.title: Chapter 861 - 460: Fantasy Level Item, Divine Level Puppet_2
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded thoughtfully.
At that moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Due to saving an unknown small world, you will receive a reward from that world: World Mark +5 layers]
Seeing this prompt, Han Xing paused for a moment.
Hmm... By letting Radiance intervene, I can still receive rewards?
Another World Mark?
What on earth is this thing used for?
Han Xing was full of doubts.
And as he pondered, a second system prompt appeared.
[Master of the Human Race, Han Xing, you have accumulated 80 layers of World Marks. After collecting 100 layers, you will receive a special reward: World Will *1.]
Seeing this system prompt, Han Xing suddenly felt goosebumps.
"Damn!"
He exclaimed directly.
The team members looked at Han Xing in confusion.
However, none of them could understand the shock in Han Xing’s heart right now.
Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh: "So that’s it... so that’s how it is!"
He still clearly remembered finding a Godslaying-level weapon blueprint in that ruined civilization’s laboratory: [Celestial Rail Strike Device]
This blueprint is even higher in level than the Divine Demon Battleship!
Even within that race, this blueprint remained only a concept.
If it could be crafted, it would definitely have much greater power than any other defense tower in Han Xing’s territory.
However, the last key material, [World Will], Han Xing had no clue at all until now.
He was about to give up, but unexpectedly, he suddenly received a clue.
"Great, just 20 more layers to go!"
Han Xing was extremely excited; with 20 more layers, he would receive a [World Will] reward!
Then he could build the first-ever [Celestial Rail Strike Device].
It’s important to know that even for that race, this weapon remains at the concept stage.
Han Xing decided that when encountering such small worlds again later, he would decisively take action.
To obtain more World Mark rewards!
However, he also knew that with his current strength, he could not withstand such backlash.
Didn’t he see that even the God of Radiance almost perished?
At this time, Han Xing turned his gaze to the God of Radiance.
Though the God of Radiance had suffered a heavy blow, he had restored himself in a short time.
"Radiance, you can do it," Han Xing suddenly said.
The team members were perplexed.
Then, this handsome God of Radiance suddenly had a bad premonition.
He seemed to understand something, and his eyelid twitched wildly.
Next, Han Xing continued to maneuver the Divine Demon Battleship for teleportation actions.
However, during the subsequent process, they did not encounter any new small worlds.
This left Han Xing feeling a bit disappointed.
And this also made the always vigilant God of Radiance breathe a sigh of relief.
Time flew by, and soon it was two days later.
On this day, the Divine Demon Battleship arrived near the location indicated by [Dark Night Goddess Longbow].
Han Xing said, "We’re at location."
Upon hearing this, the bored team members suddenly perked up.
"Wuhu, finally here!" Cheng Jianyong stretched his limbs.
Shen Yun also excitedly said, "Finally, we can see what the legendary Goddess Palace looks like."
However, after circling the area for about half an hour, Han Xing still didn’t see the palace anywhere.
At this moment, Han Xing took out the [Dark Night Goddess Longbow] and found that the guiding aura on the longbow was precisely around here.
Yet, they couldn’t find it no matter how hard they tried.
Han Xing instinctively looked towards the God of Radiance beside him.
The God of Radiance stepped forward, coughed twice, and said, "Master, I do not sense other Divine Spirits around here."
"If the Dark Night Goddess’s palace is indeed at this location, then this situation presents two possibilities.
"One possibility is the Dark Night Goddess may not be in her palace and has thus activated its hidden state."
"Another possibility is that the Dark Night Goddess does not wish for you to find her, she may have blocked the palace’s perception."
"Like these ancient deities of the Dark Night, if they do not wish to be found, even a True God cannot locate them."
Han Xing nodded upon hearing that.
Then, in a flash, he appeared outside the battleship, with a flesh body standing in the void.
At this time, Han Xing stood as the battleship penetrated, raising the Dark Night Goddess’s longbow above and shouted loudly: "Dark Night Goddess, is this your longbow?"
"I have brought it to you!"
The sound echoed in the void.
(Void is not the universe, and sound can be transmitted.)
However, no reaction came from the void no matter how long he shouted.
Han Xing frowned slightly, looking oddly at the black longbow in his hand.
"Could it be a mistake?"
And just as he was puzzled,
The surrounding void suddenly vibrated.
Like waves surging.
Han Xing saw a colossal palace emerge from the violent void energy.
This palace was immensely colossal and appeared to be built atop a Sky Island.
Mansions and towers; the tops of the buildings were carved with giant black pythons.
It conveyed a sense of sternness mixed with a touch of ominous style.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[You have discovered the Dark Night Goddess’s palace, World Influence +1023, Legendary Points +10.]
At this moment, not only Han Xing, but also other team members heard the system prompt,
They all walked out of the battleship.
The God of Radiance appeared together with the team members beside Han Xing.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Is this the Shadow Goddess’s palace? It’s grand indeed!"
"It looks just like a palace!"
