Upon hearing this, the bored team members suddenly perked up.
"Wuhu, finally here!" Cheng Jianyong stretched his limbs.
Shen Yun also excitedly said, "Finally, we can see what the legendary Goddess Palace looks like."
However, after circling the area for about half an hour, Han Xing still didn’t see the palace anywhere.
At this moment, Han Xing took out the [Dark Night Goddess Longbow] and found that the guiding aura on the longbow was precisely around here.
Yet, they couldn’t find it no matter how hard they tried.
Han Xing instinctively looked towards the God of Radiance beside him.
The God of Radiance stepped forward, coughed twice, and said, "Master, I do not sense other Divine Spirits around here."
"If the Dark Night Goddess’s palace is indeed at this location, then this situation presents two possibilities.
"One possibility is the Dark Night Goddess may not be in her palace and has thus activated its hidden state."
"Another possibility is that the Dark Night Goddess does not wish for you to find her, she may have blocked the palace’s perception."
"Like these ancient deities of the Dark Night, if they do not wish to be found, even a True God cannot locate them."
Han Xing nodded upon hearing that.
Then, in a flash, he appeared outside the battleship, with a flesh body standing in the void.
At this time, Han Xing stood as the battleship penetrated, raising the Dark Night Goddess’s longbow above and shouted loudly: "Dark Night Goddess, is this your longbow?"
"I have brought it to you!"
The sound echoed in the void.
(Void is not the universe, and sound can be transmitted.)
However, no reaction came from the void no matter how long he shouted.
Han Xing frowned slightly, looking oddly at the black longbow in his hand.
"Could it be a mistake?"
And just as he was puzzled,
The surrounding void suddenly vibrated.
Like waves surging.
Han Xing saw a colossal palace emerge from the violent void energy.
This palace was immensely colossal and appeared to be built atop a Sky Island.
Mansions and towers; the tops of the buildings were carved with giant black pythons.
It conveyed a sense of sternness mixed with a touch of ominous style.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[You have discovered the Dark Night Goddess’s palace, World Influence +1023, Legendary Points +10.]
At this moment, not only Han Xing, but also other team members heard the system prompt,
They all walked out of the battleship.
The God of Radiance appeared together with the team members beside Han Xing.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Is this the Shadow Goddess’s palace?
It’s grand indeed!"
"It looks just like a palace!"

chapters.title: Chapter 862 - 460: Fantasy Level Item, Divine Level Puppet_3
paragraphs: The other team members also expressed their emotions.
Han Xing looked at the God of Radiance and asked, "Did you sense any other Divine Spirit’s presence inside?"
The God of Radiance closed his eyes and carefully sensed.
Then he shook his head and said, "Master, I did not sense anything."
"There is no presence of any living being inside this palace."
Hearing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Cheng Jianyong impatiently said, "Then what are we waiting for, let’s rush over and, um, explore it all!"
At this time, the God of Radiance added, "However, we still cannot let our guard down."
"It’s also possible that the Dark Night Goddess used some means to hide her presence, so I didn’t sense it."
Hearing this, the team members’ steps, which were about to advance, stopped in mid-air.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing said, "Let’s go ahead. Since this palace responded to my call, it means that the other side does not intend to attack us."
"However, if something feels off, remember to use the Oracle Throne’s teleportation function to escape immediately."
The team members nodded upon hearing this.
Then, under the lead of the God of Radiance,
their group landed on the Sky Island of the Shadow Goddess.
This Sky Island was entirely black.
Both the floor and the walls were a deep black color.
At this moment, the six of them appeared outside the palace.
A series of high city walls blocked them, and below the walls was a pitch-black iron gate.
The team members looked around curiously at everything.
After all, this was also their first time entering the abode of another Divine Spirit.
Tap! Tap!
The footsteps of the five people echoed, as if stepping on tiles.
And when Han Xing looked at the floor beneath his feet, a system prompt appeared.
[Black Abyss Stone Floor (Red): Can be decomposed into 10 pieces of Black Abyss Stone.]
[Black Abyss Stone (Red): An extremely hard stone, seemingly the main material for crafting certain Divine Artifact level items or mechanical constructs.]
Upon seeing this note from the system, Han Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
"Oh my, using Divine Artifact level materials to make flooring, how extravagant!
Han Xing turned around and asked the God of Radiance, "Radiance, do you know what Black Abyss Stone is used for?"
The God of Radiance recalled in his mind, then nodded, "I have some impression."
"That was a million years ago, right? We discovered a vast world in the Void."
"The Power in that world was extremely strong, and Divine Spirit level powers were numerous."
"They even had puppet creatures on par with Divine Spirits, or even True God levels."
"After dismantling those puppet creatures, we found an extremely hard metal called Black Abyss Stone."
"Even for us, it took a great effort to destroy that great world..."
The God of Radiance seemed to realize he had said something he shouldn’t have and quickly covered his mouth.
At the same time, he looked fearfully overhead.
However, after hearing the God of Radiance’s words, Han Xing gave him a deep look.
Cheng Jianyong commented with great interest, "Radiance, you seem to have mentioned something quite astounding just now."
"What’s the deal with that great world?"
The God of Radiance shook his head vigorously, almost as if he was afraid Cheng Jianyong would continue speaking.
Han Xing interrupted Cheng Jianyong, "Let me handle this."
Cheng Jianyong nodded.
Han Xing looked towards the God of Radiance.
"Radiance, I’m going to ask you some questions next. Nod if you can answer, shake your head if you can’t."
The God of Radiance nodded.
Han Xing asked.
"You just mentioned that great world had Divine Spirit, even True God level puppet constructs?"
The God of Radiance seemed capable of answering this.
He nodded.
Han Xing continued to ask, "Then, is there still a way to obtain the crafting methods of those Divine Spirit level puppets?"
The God of Radiance pondered for a moment, then nodded again.
Han Xing’s heart leapt with joy,
"How can we get them?"
The God of Radiance shook his head.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing frowned and continued asking, "Is it that you can’t answer, or you don’t know?"
The God of Radiance replied, "I can’t say...
"However, I can inadvertently give you a direction."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing knowingly nodded and stopped pressing further.
Then, everyone exchanged glances, their eyes filled with intense joy!
Oh my!
The God of Radiance really seems to know the method for crafting those so-called Divine Spirit level puppets!
What does this mean?
This means Han Xing and the others are about to strike it rich!
This palace is so vast, how many materials for Divine Level mechanical constructs must be inside!
If they scour the place entirely,
he might even directly create an army of divine level puppets!
Noticing the somewhat urgent breaths of the other team members,
Han Xing chuckled and said, "Alright, let’s get to work!"
"Take everything movable with us!"
The team members, hearing this, immediately began to gear up.
Cheng Jianyong promptly patted his chest and said, "Rest assured, Brother Xing, I won’t leave a single corner untouched, not even a stone will be missed!"
Upon hearing this, the team members knowingly laughed.
With that said, the five of them directly released their Divine Power, collecting all these floor pieces.
The system prompts continuously appeared.
[Obtained [Black Abyss Stone Floor]*37... ]
[Obtained [Black Abyss Stone Floor]*27... ]
[Obtained... ]
Before long, all the [Black Abyss Stone Floor] on this nearby street were collected by everyone!
The team members were full of joy.
Right in the area at the palace entrance, they had already harvested more than three thousand floor pieces, which, when decomposed, amounted to over thirty thousand [Black Abyss Stones]!
Although they did not know how many [Black Abyss Stones] are needed to craft a Divine Spirit level puppet,
but in any case, these are Divine Artifact level materials!

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 461: Dangerous Dark Night Goddess
paragraphs: Meanwhile, the God of Radiance stood to the side, staring at the bare ground, his face full of speechless disbelief.
Then they arrived at the foot of the city wall.
A deep black metal gate appeared before everyone.
As usual, Han Xing cast his gaze over.
[Black Emperor Stone Gate (Color): Can be dismantled into 2000 Black Emperor Stones.]
[Black Emperor Stone (Color): A Fantasy Level material that only exists in Legend, and is quite rare throughout the entire Void, possessing extremely mysterious and unfathomable properties.]
"Holy shit! Color, and what is Fantasy Level?!"
Han Xing cried out in surprise.
The team members heard this and all turned their eyes over, seeing the Introduction of this metal gate.
In an instant, everyone’s breathing stalled.
This was also the first time they had encountered a Color Level item.
Han Xing tried to rip down this [Black Emperor Stone Gate].
However, he found that this gate seemed to be one with the entire Sky Island.
Even with Han Xing’s Divine Power strength, he couldn’t wrench this gate free.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing looked at the God of Radiance beside him and said, "Radiance, lend a hand."
The God of Radiance was stunned for a second, but he understood what Han Xing meant.
He could only shake his head helplessly for a moment.
To think that a dignified Divine Spirit like him would actually be doing something like tearing off someone else’s front gate.
In all his growth as the God of Radiance, he had never done anything like this.
But since it was Han Xing’s order, he couldn’t disobey.
So, endless rays of light burst forth from the God of Radiance.
He seemed to be forcibly separating this gate.
Rumble, rumble, rumble!
The entire palace kept shaking.
After a while, that metal gate broke free from the wall.
Han Xing was overjoyed. He gave the God of Radiance a thumbs-up and said, "Radiance, nicely done!"
Then he directly stowed the gate into his backpack.
[Obtained [Black Emperor Stone Gate (Color)] *1...]
At this moment, Han Xing turned his gaze to the city wall beside him.
[Black Gold Stone Wall (Red): Due to a special restriction, cannot be dismantled.]
[Black Gold Stone (Boom): An extremely hard metal that can be used to build certain Divine Level constructions or special materials.]
"Black Gold Stone? Another new material?"
Han Xing’s joy spiked instantly; he looked over at the God of Radiance.
Only to see the God of Radiance wave his hands repeatedly, saying, "Master, this wall can’t be torn down!"
"The wall and this palace are one piece—if you tear it off, you’ll wreck the whole palace structure!"
"The Dark Night Goddess will sense it!"
Han Xing heard this and could only shake his head regretfully.
"Alright then, let’s head inside and take a look."
The team members also felt extremely regretful.
This wall encircled the entire palace—if they could tear it all off, the amount of [Black Gold Stone] they could get would be astronomical!
But the moment they crossed the gate and stepped into this ancient palace, all the regret vanished from their eyes.
Each of them was directly shocked by the scene before them.
A huge pile of dazzling materials appeared right in front of them!
[Black Abyss Stone Floor (Red): Can be dismantled into 10 Black Abyss Stones]
[Black Gold Stone Stairway (Red): Can be dismantled into 100 Black Gold Stones (Red)]
[Black Emperor Stone Statue (Color): Can be dismantled into 1000 Black Emperor Stones (Color)]
Inside this city, most of the buildings were made out of these three kinds of materials.
Aside from the relatively few Color Black Emperor Stone materials, all the Red items were everywhere they looked!
Even Shen Yun couldn’t help crying out, "Holy shit! So many Divine Artifacts!"
So many Divine Artifact Materials—this was something they had never experienced in their entire lives!
Even riding on the back of a beast, they had never looted this much stuff.
Cheng Jianyong shouted excitedly, "We’re rich, we’re rich!"
"This haul is really a fortune!
"Brothers, charge! Empty the whole place!"
At this moment, the five of them were like bandits entering a village.
They started crazily scooping all the floors, statues, stairways into their backpacks!
Except for the structural buildings that couldn’t be dismantled, they practically didn’t spare a single corner.
Wherever they passed, only a layer of bald, naked ground was left.
[Obtained [Black Emperor Stone Statue (Color)] *1...]
[Obtained [Black Gold Stone Stairway (Red)] *8...]
[Obtained [Black Abyss Stone Chandelier (Red)] *2...]
[Obtained...]
The system notifications were crazily spamming the screen.
Meanwhile, the God of Radiance in the rear was completely dumbstruck.
He couldn’t help wiping the sweat off his forehead, muttering in his heart.
"If the Dark Night Goddess comes back and sees her palace trashed into this hellhole, I wonder if she’ll freak out..."
At this moment, the God of Radiance suddenly seemed to think of something, his expression changing.
"Wait, that’s not right!"
"Master and his companions are only Legend and Demigod, their auras aren’t strong."

"But I’m a Divine Spirit, my remaining aura is extremely obvious. When the Dark Night Goddess comes back she’ll definitely think I’m the one who messed up her palace, she’ll definitely come after me."
"Holy shit!"
The God of Radiance jolted in shock, a sudden chill creeping up in his heart.
Yet in the next second, he realized he was overreacting a bit.
"Hold on, I’m at least a Top-tier Divine Level existence now, one way or another."
"And I’m about to break through to True God."
"The Night Goddess is at most Top-tier Divine Spirit strength—why the hell should I be scared of her?"
Thinking this, the God of Radiance suddenly felt more confident.
He followed behind Han Xing and the others, keeping watch over the surroundings.
In no time, Han Xing and the others had stripped this stretch of street of its floors, statues, and steps.
Now, everyone stopped where they were, looking around at this palace.
The God of Radiance thought they were finally done looting, so he probed, "Master, have you already looted enough?"

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 461: The Dangerous Dark Night Goddess (2)
paragraphs: However, Han Xing sighed and shook his head saying, "Can’t fit anymore."
The team members also nodded, "I can’t fit anymore either."
Each of them had a backpack with 1600 slots.
Altogether, that’s eight thousand backpack slots!
Excluding some materials accumulated earlier, there were still nearly 6000 slots of space left.
But even so, with so much space, they filled it up entirely.
From this, one can imagine how many [Black Abyss Stones], [Black Gold Stones], [Black Emperor Stones] they collected!
Han Xing tallied up the items: the floors, doors, stairs, statues, stone pillars.
If they were all dismantled.
[Black Abyss Stone] could be dismantled into a total of 12 million pieces.
[Black Gold Stone] could be dismantled into 7.8 million pieces.
While [Black Emperor Stone], around 300,000 pieces.
At this moment, the God of Radiance sighed in relief.
Just when he thought that Han Xing and the team would stop, Han Xing said, "Radiance, wait for us here."
"We need to go back to the Divine Demon Battleship first, send the materials from our backpacks back, then come back and continue searching."
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance was jaw-droppingly stunned.
What the heck! You still want to search?
Han Xing didn’t explain further, but instead led everyone towards the Divine Demon Battleship.

At this time, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel fortunate saying, "Luckily, when we left, we brought Ten Thousand Stars City along, which still has several storage boxes, now we can recklessly load these materials."
Everyone’s faces showed joy.
They returned to the Divine Demon Battleship and opened the storage boxes.
Put all the materials from the backpacks inside.
Then, they appeared inside the Night Goddess’s palace again, starting the dismantling process.
After doing this four times, they finally moved everything out of the Night Goddess Palace that could be carried.
Han Xing checked the quantity again.
If all these items were dismantled.
The quantity of [Black Abyss Stone] would be roughly 60 million.
The quantity of [Black Gold Stone] would be 40 million.
As for the highest level [Black Emperor Stone (Color)], it would barely reach 1 million.
Han Xing sighed at this moment, "Although I don’t know how much material is needed to create such a Divine Level puppet.
"But with all we collected this time, isn’t it enough for us to create a few Divine Level puppets?"
The team members nodded with smiles.
Han Xing looked around, confirmed again, and after confirming there were no oversights, clapped his hands saying, "Let’s go, let’s check the inside of the palace."
At this moment, having cleared the outskirts of the Night Goddess’s palace, Han Xing was finally about to step inside the goddess’s palace.
At this moment, upon entering the palace, a large door adorned with black python motifs appeared once again.
Han Xing had the God of Radiance try to take it, but after realizing it was impossible, he shook his head with regret.
At this juncture, the palace door slowly opened.
Upon entering, various prompts appeared again inside.
[Black Abyss Stone Rockery (Red): Due to some special restriction present, it cannot be dismantled.]
[Black Gold Stone Pavilion (Red): Due to some special restriction present, it cannot be dismantled.]
[Black Emperor Stone Sculpture (Color): Due to special restriction present, it cannot be dismantled.]
Everyone looked around.
Discovered that there were still many buildings made of [Black Emperor Stone] inside the palace.
However, they were all integrated with the palace itself.
So they couldn’t take them away, feeling a bit regretful in their hearts.
Han Xing then said, "Search again, see if we can find anything."
Upon hearing this, the team members started moving.
Continued to search inside the palace.
Han Xing found quite a lot of interesting things inside.
The architectural style here was classic and elegant.
But whether it was the decorative statues, rockeries, or even the water in the pools, they were all black.
In this palace, there was no second color tone.
It seemed to be completely shrouded by the night.
The six of them wandered around, like strolling, enjoying the scenes inside the Night Goddess’s palace.
Occasionally pocketed a few small stones, feeling leisurely and carefree.
Shen Yun happily said at this moment, "Luckily the Night Goddess isn’t home, otherwise we wouldn’t be able to easily collect these things."
The team members nodded in agreement.
As they walked.
They wandered to the backyard of the palace.
On the ground here, there flowed many black rivers, the water as black as ink, the surface as pure as a mirror, able to reflect the figures of everyone.
Above the small rivers, there were bridges made of [Black Emperor Stone].
Beside them were pavilions made of [Black Abyss Stone].
It was full of classic and elegant atmosphere here.
Just then.
Han Xing suddenly noticed there was a faint silhouette sitting inside a pavilion ahead.
Cheng Jianyong also noticed the pavilion’s scene, wondering aloud.
"Hey, there seems to be someone there?"
Everyone immediately looked over.
But because there were Divine Artifact energies everywhere, it seemed that some blocking force existed within the pavilion.
So they couldn’t clearly see who that silhouette was.
Nor could they sense the aura of that silhouette.
However, encountering a silhouette in such a place was an eerie thing no matter what.
Even the God of Radiance heightened his alert.
As they approached, they suddenly saw a petite figure dressed in a gauzy long dress sitting on a bench in the pavilion.
Sensing everyone’s presence, the silhouette slowly turned around.
Then, they saw a face with exquisitely beautiful features, with a faint smile at the corners of her lips, slightly immature.

sentences.text: However, Han Xing sighed and shook his head saying, "Can’t fit anymore."
The team members also nodded, "I can’t fit anymore either."
Each of them had a backpack with 1600 slots.
Altogether, that’s eight thousand backpack slots!
Excluding some materials accumulated earlier, there were still nearly 6000 slots of space left.
But even so, with so much space, they filled it up entirely.
From this, one can imagine how many [Black Abyss Stones], [Black Gold Stones], [Black Emperor Stones] they collected!
Han Xing tallied up the items: the floors, doors, stairs, statues, stone pillars.
If they were all dismantled.
[Black Abyss Stone] could be dismantled into a total of 12 million pieces.
[Black Gold Stone] could be dismantled into 7.8 million pieces.
While [Black Emperor Stone], around 300,000 pieces.
At this moment, the God of Radiance sighed in relief.
Just when he thought that Han Xing and the team would stop, Han Xing said, "Radiance, wait for us here."
"We need to go back to the Divine Demon Battleship first, send the materials from our backpacks back, then come back and continue searching."
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance was jaw-droppingly stunned.
What the heck!
You still want to search?
Han Xing didn’t explain further, but instead led everyone towards the Divine Demon Battleship.

At this time, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel fortunate saying, "Luckily, when we left, we brought Ten Thousand Stars City along, which still has several storage boxes, now we can recklessly load these materials."
Everyone’s faces showed joy.
They returned to the Divine Demon Battleship and opened the storage boxes.
Put all the materials from the backpacks inside.
Then, they appeared inside the Night Goddess’s palace again, starting the dismantling process.
After doing this four times, they finally moved everything out of the Night Goddess Palace that could be carried.
Han Xing checked the quantity again.
If all these items were dismantled.
The quantity of [Black Abyss Stone] would be roughly 60 million.
The quantity of [Black Gold Stone] would be 40 million.
As for the highest level [Black Emperor Stone (Color)], it would barely reach 1 million.
Han Xing sighed at this moment, "Although I don’t know how much material is needed to create such a Divine Level puppet.
"But with all we collected this time, isn’t it enough for us to create a few Divine Level puppets?"
The team members nodded with smiles.
Han Xing looked around, confirmed again, and after confirming there were no oversights, clapped his hands saying, "Let’s go, let’s check the inside of the palace."
At this moment, having cleared the outskirts of the Night Goddess’s palace, Han Xing was finally about to step inside the goddess’s palace.
At this moment, upon entering the palace, a large door adorned with black python motifs appeared once again.
Han Xing had the God of Radiance try to take it, but after realizing it was impossible, he shook his head with regret.

Upon entering, various prompts appeared again inside.

[Black Emperor Stone Sculpture (Color): Due to special restriction present, it cannot be dismantled.]
Everyone looked around.
Discovered that there were still many buildings made of [Black Emperor Stone] inside the palace.
However, they were all integrated with the palace itself.
So they couldn’t take them away, feeling a bit regretful in their hearts.
Han Xing then said, "Search again, see if we can find anything."
Upon hearing this, the team members started moving.
Continued to search inside the palace.

The architectural style here was classic and elegant.
But whether it was the decorative statues, rockeries, or even the water in the pools, they were all black.
In this palace, there was no second color tone.
It seemed to be completely shrouded by the night.

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 461: The Dangerous Dark Night Goddess (Part 3)
paragraphs: "Uh... little girl?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Indeed, the figure’s appearance really looked like a girl around eleven or twelve years old.
However, when Radiance saw the little girl’s face, he immediately entered battle state.
"Master, be careful!"
He instantly used divine power to protect everyone, and quickly distanced himself from the little girl.
Cheng Jianyong asked confusedly, "Radiance, who is this little girl? Why are you so terrified?"
Before the God of Radiance could speak.
The little girl chuckled softly,
"Hee~"
"You guys, as soon as you arrived, started destroying everything in My palace, not even sparing My floor."
"Now, you still ask who I am?"
Her voice was incredibly ethereal, with a terrifyingly enchanting aura concealed within.
Just hearing this voice, everyone couldn’t help but fall into it.
If one’s mind is not strong, they might even willingly kneel at this little girl’s feet.
However, they weren’t ordinary legendary powerhouses, and instantly pulled themselves out of that enchanting state.
At this moment, everyone realized something, and their hearts were startled!
This little girl is the Dark Night Goddess!
"Oh boy... How did the Dark Night Goddess end up looking like this?"
"Aren’t they saying she’s over ten thousand years old?"
Cheng Jianyong felt deeply shocked.
Other team members also felt perplexed.
However, the God of Radiance nodded solemnly, "It is her."
"The Dark Night Goddess has two forms, one is the goddess form, which is what the world usually sees."
"The other is this permanent form you’re seeing now."
At this moment, the youthful Dark Night Goddess lifted her black dress and looked at the God of Radiance with interest and said.
"Radiance, after so many years, I thought Light had already consumed you."
"It seems you’re the final winner?
The God of Radiance did not reply, maintaining his strong vigilance.
He knew better than anyone the power of these ancient gods!
Don’t be fooled by this smiling girl’s seemingly harmless demeanor, but the God of Radiance knew.
Once she transforms into that form, her combat power is terrifying!
Even though he is now a top-tier divine spirit, he doesn’t dare claim he can match the Dark Night Goddess.
The Dark Night Goddess seemed slightly irritated as the God of Radiance didn’t respond.
She stood barefoot on the stone bench, hands on hips, "Radiance! I’m asking you a question!"
Despite this form of the Dark Night Goddess appearing angry, it lacked any goddess-like authority.
More like a cute little girl acting spoiled.
The God of Radiance replied, "That’s right, I consumed the Rule of Light."
The corners of the Dark Night Goddess’s mouth lifted again upon hearing these words.
"Hee~ Is that so~"
"So this time, you brought these few humans to My palace, for what purpose?"
"Don’t tell me, it’s just to take My floor?"
She switched effortlessly from that cute state to this extremely enchanting state.
Truly seamless.
On the side, the people listening to the conversation between two divine spirits felt something bizarre.
The God of Radiance sighed, "I have nothing to look for you, but my master, he needs to find you."
"Your master, you actually acknowledge a human as your master?"
Even the Dark Night Goddess was surprised this time.
She carefully sensed, "Interesting, there really is a rule oath upon you."
"Light, I somewhat misjudged you."
"I wonder who this existence is that made a top-tier divine spirit acknowledge him as master?"
At this moment, the Dark Night Goddess cast her dazzling black-gem-like gaze upon Han Xing.
"Is it you?"
Han Xing did not deny, simply nodded.
In the next moment, a wave of divine power emanated from the Dark Night Goddess.
Before anyone could react, she appeared directly in front of Han Xing.
"Stop!
The God of Radiance instantly burst out with a Power of Radiance, only to see the Dark Night Goddess casually wave her sleeve and block his attack.
At this instant, Han Xing even prepared to activate the [Oracle Throne] to escape.
Yet at the last moment, he did not sense any threatening aura from the Dark Night Goddess.
Thus, Han Xing stopped the teleportation action.
At this moment, the Dark Night Goddess floated barefoot in the air, tilting her head and gazing at Han Xing.
Her face was less than a centimeter away from Han Xing.
Their faces were nearly touching,
In this close distance, Han Xing did not move.
It was then he noticed how exquisite this woman’s looks were.
A crystal-like nose, gem-like dazzling eyes, and black-red lips.
It was a face that had purity mixed with a strong enchanting allure.
Even though Han Xing had seen countless beauties, he couldn’t help but be somewhat captivated.
But soon, Han Xing snapped back to reality.
The Dark Night Goddess chuckled softly and her figure flashed, returning to the pavilion.
She glanced at the God of Radiance, then at Han Xing,
"Radiance, have you placed your hope on him?"
The God of Radiance frowned slightly but still nodded.
Upon hearing this, divine power surged around the Dark Night Goddess.
In the next moment, in the gaze of the surprised crowd.
Her body rapidly grew.
From the previous loli form less than 1.2 meters tall, directly to a tall stature nearly 1.8 meters.
The long dress she wore transformed into a short skirt.
Long legs encased in floral-patterned black silk, slender hands also enveloped in black gauze.
In this form, the Dark Night Goddess was what everyone had seen before.
Every expression was filled with an extraordinary charm.

chapters.title: Chapter 866 - 462: Invitation from the Dark Night Goddess
paragraphs: In her current form, the Dark Night Goddess exuded a unique aura with every smile and frown.
Then, she finally assumed a serious demeanor and looked at Han Xing, asking, "Little one, what business do you have with me?"
The true age of the Dark Night Goddess was unknown.
But she was at least a figure from ten thousand years ago.
So, even though she appeared youthful, calling Han Xing a little one was not entirely inappropriate.
Han Xing didn’t mind and directly pulled out a longbow forged entirely from black gemstones from his backpack.
At the sight of the bow, the Dark Night Goddess’s eyes lit up.
"This seems to be... the bow I used, it even has my mother’s aura on it..."
"But it was lost in the Holy Spirit Realm ten thousand years ago and has not been found since."
"I didn’t expect you to find it."
"No wonder... you managed to locate my palace."
Han Xing nodded, "Is this longbow what you need?"
The Dark Night Goddess nodded slightly, "Yes, it is what I need."
"Even though I’ve made a second longbow over these many years."
"But this longbow holds special meaning for me."
After hearing this, Han Xing didn’t say much and directly tossed the longbow to her.
"Giving you this longbow can compensate for us taking away your palace floor."
The Dark Night Goddess was momentarily stunned, then covered her mouth and laughed, "You humans are quite amusing."
"I’ve been here for thousands of years, and it’s the first time I’ve met such an interesting little one like you."
"I think I understand why the God of Radiance willingly acknowledges you as his master."
After speaking, she glanced at the God of Radiance and then at Han Xing.
"In that case, let’s do as you say..."
"Since you’ve returned the longbow to me, I won’t pursue the matter of you stealing the floor."
Han Xing and the others breathed a sigh of relief.
Even though they weren’t afraid of the Dark Night Goddess in a fight.
This matter was indeed their fault.
They started to massively harvest those Black Abyss Stone structures without the other party’s consent.
After all, who would have known the Dark Night Goddess was really at home!
At this moment, Han Xing spoke, "Since the item has been returned to its owner, we’ll take our leave now."
With that, Han Xing turned and led his team to leave.
However, the Dark Night Goddess suddenly said, "Wait a moment."
Han Xing turned his head in confusion, while secretly preparing for teleportation.
The Dark Night Goddess took note of Han Xing’s actions with a charming smile.
Then she slowly said, "Would you like to know a clue about a Holy Artifact Longbow?"
Han Xing froze on the spot and asked in surprise, "What did you say? A Holy Artifact Longbow?"
As if expecting Han Xing’s reaction, the Dark Night Goddess laughed again.
"So, you’re interested now, aren’t you?"
"Hehe~ I knew you’d be interested in the Holy Artifact Longbow."
She looked like a little girl whose plan had succeeded, smiling happily.
However, Han Xing solemnly asked, "Do you really have a clue about the Holy Artifact Longbow?"
It’s important to know, Han Xing already had three holy artifacts in his possession.
Once he found the rest of the Master of Stars Set, his entire body, except for the weapon, would be equipped with Holy Artifact level gear.
And then, once he acquired a Holy Artifact Longbow.
He would truly be fully equipped with Holy Artifact level gear.
Seeming to understand Han Xing’s skepticism.
The Dark Night Goddess continued, "You can ask the God of Radiance~"
Han Xing directed his gaze towards the God of Radiance.
Radiance nodded, "Many years ago, we indeed witnessed the Dark Night summon a projection of a Holy Artifact Longbow for battle."
"That Holy Artifact level bow is called Eternal Night."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded in understanding.
Being able to summon the projection of a Holy Artifact Longbow for battle.
This suggested that the Dark Night Goddess likely had contact with the holy artifact.
He was now fully convinced by the Dark Night Goddess’s words.
The Dark Night Goddess continued to smile, "So, you’re interested now, aren’t you?"
Han Xing nodded, "Can you tell me the clue about the Holy Artifact Longbow?"
The Dark Night Goddess nodded, "I can~"
"But, I can only tell you alone."
Han Xing frowned.
Does this mean she wants to be alone with Han Xing?
Why does that sound so dangerous?
Han Xing was just a Legend, staying with an ancient divine spirit, if that deity had any other ideas, Han Xing would have no power to resist.
The team members also realized this and hurriedly shook their heads, "Brother Xing, don’t agree to it."
"Yeah Brother Xing, let’s just leave."
The team members all urged.
After all, this was a Divine Spirit level being.
Being alone with such a powerful entity was too risky!
The Dark Night Goddess chuckled softly, "The choice is yours~"
At this moment, Han Xing also fell into deep thought.
Staying with the Dark Night Goddess was certainly dangerous.
However, it must be said, the temptation of the Holy Artifact Longbow was too great.
Moreover, if the Dark Night Goddess really wanted to make a move against them.
She could have simply overpowered Han Xing just now.
There was no need to go to the trouble of creating a scenario where they would be alone.
Thinking of this, Han Xing told his team, "You guys leave first, go wait for me at the warship, I’ll be there soon."
Upon hearing this, the team’s eyes were filled with worry.
Han Xing looked at them and chuckled, "Don’t worry, nothing will happen."
His tone carried a hint of confidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 867 - 462: Invitation from the Dark Night Goddess (2)
paragraphs: At this moment, the team members thought it over several times, and finally nodded.
Just like before, they trusted Han Xing’s decision.
They also believed that no matter what difficulties he encountered, he could solve them forcefully.
Then, they all turned and left together.
When Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others, including the God of Radiance, had all left,
only he and the Dark Night Goddess were left in the pavilion.
Han Xing finally asked seriously, "Alright, now we can talk."
"If I want to know the clues about the Holy Artifact Longbow from you, what do I need to offer?"
The Dark Night Goddess said softly, "You don’t need to offer anything, just promise me one condition."
Han Xing asked with a puzzled look, "What condition?"
The Dark Night Goddess looked at Han Xing, then extended her warm tongue to lick her lips.
She showed a seductive expression and said, "I want a child..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s jaw dropped in shock.
"What the heck? What did you say?"
"You want me to be your son?"
The Dark Night Goddess rolled her eyes at Han Xing and teased, "Hmph! You’re playing dumb."
"I mean, I want to have a child with you..."
After saying this, even with the Dark Night Goddess’s open personality, a blush appeared on her face.
She lowered her head.
Han Xing understood her meaning and was full of confusion.
"Why with me?"
The Dark Night Goddess did not answer but instead looked up and smiled lightly, "It seems you haven’t discovered the secret about yourself~"
"However, I cannot speak about this issue."
"I can only tell you, you are very special. From the time Radiance accepted you as its master, you should know the uniqueness about yourself."
"Otherwise, a Divine Spirit, even in death, would never recognize a Legend as its master."
Han Xing’s eyes showed a contemplative look.
Although the Dark Night Goddess said he had something special, Han Xing did not know what it was.
These Divine Spirits were all like riddlers, unwilling to speak clearly.
Han Xing had no clue at all.
So, he asked again, "Alright, then the next question, why do you want a child?"
The Dark Night Goddess said, "Because... I am preparing for my own future..."
"Future?"
The Dark Night Goddess nodded but did not continue.
However, Han Xing saw a deeply hidden fear in her eyes.
But she quickly concealed the emotion in her eyes, then looked at Han Xing and asked, "So, how is it, have you considered it?"
"This is the first time I have made such an invitation to a male~"
Although Han Xing was open-minded about such matters,
it was also the first time he encountered an ancient deity asking to have a child with him.
However, at the thought of the clue about the Holy Artifact Longbow promised by the Dark Night Goddess,
he nodded and said, "Alright."
The Dark Night Goddess’s face showed a stunning smile.
Her figure spun, and the black skirt swirled like a black rose.
The next moment, Han Xing’s vision spun, appearing in a bedroom similar to a girl’s room.
It was filled with various luxurious decorations, all in black tones,
giving the whole room a calm, elegant feeling.
At this moment, the Dark Night Goddess sat in front of the bed and hooked her finger.
Han Xing’s vision shifted again, and this time, he appeared directly in front of the Dark Night Goddess.
At this point, the distance between the two was less than a centimeter.
The warm breath from the Dark Night Goddess’ nose hit Han Xing’s face.
The next moment, the distance between the two vanished.
Then, in the depths of this Void, the deepest room in the Dark Night Goddess’s palace trembled repeatedly.
Both possessed exceptionally terrifying power.
The Dark Night Goddess, in particular, was a Top-tier Divine Level power.
In this process, Han Xing was not even in a dominant position, being suppressed unilaterally by the Dark Night Goddess.
No matter how he tried to counterattack, he still sank into the gentle embrace.
So, Han Xing simply gave up on resisting.
Until nearly four or five hours later.
The Dark Night Goddess’s bedroom doors opened wide.
Han Xing then walked out, a little unsteady on his feet, his eyes wandering.
"Wow, that was intense..."
This was the first time Han Xing had interacted with a deity-level being.
He fully experienced their power.
He shook his head, quickly emptying his mind.
Then he tidied up his clothes and left the Dark Night Goddess’s palace directly...
A few minutes later.
Han Xing sat on the Oracle Throne and flew straight back to the warship.
Feeling Han Xing’s presence, the team members all rushed out of the cockpit to the deck to wait.
They asked with concern, "Brother Xing, how was it, did that Goddess do anything to you?"
Han Xing nodded with a strange expression, "Probably, nothing happened..."
Everyone finally breathed a sigh of relief.
At this time, the God of Light carefully sensed Han Xing’s aura and looked at the gradually disappearing Dark Night Goddess palace in the distance with a peculiar expression.
Cheng Jianyong asked excitedly, "Brother Xing, did the Dark Shadow Goddess tell you the location of the Holy Artifact Longbow?"
Han Xing nodded, "She told me, the Longbow is in a special place."
"It has something to do with the Void, and its location is extremely far from us, so we can’t reach it in a short time."
Upon hearing this, a hint of disappointment appeared on everyone’s faces.
Yet Han Xing’s next words left the team members simultaneously puzzled.
"However, besides the clue about the Holy Artifact Longbow, she also gave me something."
Everyone was taken aback and asked simultaneously, "What is it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 868 - 462: The Dark Night Goddess’s Invitation_3
paragraphs: Han Xing didn’t say a word, but posted a blueprint in the team channel.
[Creation of Black Abyss Realm: Lingxiao]
[With this blueprint, a war mecha with Celestial King level (Divine-level) combat power can be crafted.]

[Construction Materials: Black Abyss Stone*1 million, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*200,000, Philosopher’s Stone*1 million, Void Demon Stone*500,000, Shimmering Terra Stone*300,000, Power of Complete Rules*1 (Note, any divine-level energy core can substitute, such as Demon God’s Heart, Insect Emperor Core, etc...)]
After reading the attributes of this blueprint, everyone was shocked dumb.
"Holy shit! This is actually the blueprint that can produce a divine-level mecha!"
"This is terrifying! The Dark Night Goddess actually gave you such a blueprint."
When Han Xing obtained this blueprint, he was equally surprised as them, feeling utterly amazed.
Because with this, they could even mass-produce mechas of divine-level combat power!
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "It’s actually a mecha!"
"I previously said I wanted to fulfill my dream of piloting a mecha, and in the blink of an eye, Brother Xing really got the mecha blueprint!"
Shen Yun poured cold water on the excitement, "Don’t get too excited, we still don’t know if this mecha can be manually controlled."
Cheng Jianyong also thought of this point, his eyes showing some uncertainty.
At that moment, God of Radiance explained, "As far as I know, this kind of puppet can be controlled by a living being inside."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong immediately clenched his fist, "Wuhu! This is great!"
He became very expectant.
However, rather than the manual driving mode.
What Han Xing was more looking forward to was whether this mecha could benefit from the Sun Crown Stele’s enhancements.
If so, that would be absolutely amazing!
A mecha like this already possesses divine-level combat power.
And with the Sun Crown Stele’s enhancement, it surely would not lose to the current God of Radiance’s power.
That means, a top-tier divine spirit!
If they could produce several, Han Xing could even directly possess an army with top-tier combat power!
Even God of Radiance did not expect that the Dark Night Goddess had such a blueprint in her possession, and even gave it directly to Han Xing.
The team members were overjoyed.
However, Han Xing only had one [Power of Complete Rules], and he needed a lot more complete rules to break through to Demigod.
As for [Demon God’s Heart], he did not possess any at all.
So, even though Han Xing had gathered all the other materials, crafting a [Lingxiao Mecha] now was still not possible.
Han Xing said, "Alright, we currently don’t have any extra Power of Complete Rules."
"Let’s put aside the matter of crafting the Lingxiao Mecha for now."
"Next, we need to visit the palace of the Barbaric God."
Upon hearing Han Xing mention this, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes instantly lit up.
"The Barbaric God’s palace! Supreme Hidden Profession!"
He exclaimed excitedly, "Finally, it’s my turn to break through to Demigod?"
Han Xing smiled, "Don’t get happy too soon, haven’t you seen the hint above? You still need to complete the trial before you can inherit the Barbaric God’s power."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, "It doesn’t matter, Brother Xing, no challenge can stop my determination to become a hidden profession!"
Han Xing nodded in agreement, then looked at the team members and said.
"Then, we’re about to enter teleportation state and continue our journey!"
The team members adjusted their expressions and together entered the cabin.
At this moment, Han Xing directly pressed the teleportation button of the battleship.
Voice broadcast appeared.
"Entering teleportation state, countdown five seconds..."
"Five..."
"Four..."
When the countdown hit zero, the enormous silhouette of the Divine Demon Battleship vanished instantly from its original location.
Until it completely disappeared.
In this region, there was a palace that was completely pitch-black, still hidden in the chaotic currents.
At this moment, the Dark Night Goddess who had changed into a long dress, watched the direction Han Xing departed, her eyes showing curiosity.
"Interesting man..."
"Unaware of his own secrets, also doesn’t know what kind of existence chose him."
"Yet still unwaveringly seizes every opportunity to grow stronger."
"I hope that one day, you can really be the one who breaks all rules.
At this time, the Dark Night Goddess looked at her belly and said with interest, "In about four years, our child will be born."
"I wonder, will I still see you then~"
Time flew by, and it was two days later.
The enormous silhouette of the Divine Demon Battleship appeared from the chaotic void.
Voice broadcast sounded.
"Teleportation successful, Divine Demon Battleship exited teleportation state..."
Han Xing and others breathed a sigh of relief, then switched the battleship to smooth flying mode.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, how far are we from the Barbaric God’s Inheritance Palace?"
Han Xing took out the rusty key, then sensed for a moment and said, "Roughly eight days away."
Cheng Jianyong nodded.
He was already close to breaking through to Demigod.
However, he also knew the closer to such a milestone, the less he should be impulsive.
Compared to the previous excitement and urgency.
Now Cheng Jianyong had calmed down.
He didn’t forget Han Xing’s warning.
The final trial must be completed to inherit the Barbaric God’s power.
Cheng Jianyong aimed to welcome the final trial in the most perfect state.
At this moment, Han Xing was looking at the outside void, lost in thought.
During this time, the Elf King hadn’t sent him any messages.
This was good news.
Indicating the Abyss Realm hadn’t intensified the invasion.
Wu Ling’Er also regularly reported the outside situation to him, everything was relatively stable.

chapters.title: Chapter 869 - 463: Synthesizing World Will
paragraphs: "Whew..."
Han Xing slowly let out a breath.
The journey through the Void is destined to be lonely and boring.
If it weren’t for having companions around, staying in the Void for a long time might even change one’s personality.
Just like the Dark Night Goddess.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly noticed a glowing sphere appearing in the Void ahead.
This sphere was emitting flickers of light, brightening and dimming in turns.
"Another newly born world!"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy!
Then, without hesitation, he directly maneuvered the Divine Demon Battleship to approach.
Seeing the commotion outside, the team members gathered around.
Soon, they were attracted by the aura of that small world, causing the Divine Demon Battleship to enter an uncontrolled state.
However, they had experience in handling such situations.
The Divine Demon Battleship quickly stabilized, maintaining a steady speed while gradually approaching that small world.
"Crack! Crunch!"
That small world was undergoing a disaster at the start of its creation.
It seemed like it couldn’t hold on and was about to collapse.
A thoughtful expression appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Indeed, as the God of Radiance said, the birth of each world in the Void is very coincidental.
Growing up is even more challenging.
Han Xing wondered whether the Holy Spirit Realm also evolved from such a small world into a great realm.
If that’s the case, then the Holy Spirit Realm must have experienced many unimaginable disasters to reach today.
No wonder the God of Radiance said the Holy Spirit Realm is unique.
As the newly born small world was about to collapse.
Han Xing glanced at the God of Radiance, "Radiance, it’s your turn."
The God of Radiance looked troubled, "Master, it’s better to do such things less often; the forbidden powers in the Void are truly terrifying.
The fact that such a top-tier Divine Spirit uttered the word ’terrifying’ showed that the God of Radiance was truly frightened.
Han Xing nodded and said, "I understand, try a few more times; I need to test something."
Currently, Han Xing lacked the last 20 World Marks to harvest a [World Will] and gather the materials to forge the [Celestial Rail Strike Device].
There’s no way to falter at the last step.
The God of Radiance nodded and took a deep breath.
Then continued to release Divine Power, permeating into that small world.
"Buzz!"
The darkness of radiance instantly filled the small world completely.
The terrifying disasters were neutralized by the Divine Power of the God of Radiance, dissipating entirely into nothingness.
In less than half a minute, all disasters subsided.
Then, the God of Radiance faced another mysterious power’s impact, as if struck by lightning.
But this time, he had gained experience in dealing with it, bursting out his full Divine Power to resist before the power descended.
Finally, the God of Radiance merely groaned softly, with a trace of red blood on the corner of his mouth.
Han Xing glanced at the God of Radiance and felt relieved upon realizing he was alright.
And Han Xing happily heard a system reward notification.
[Due to your rescue of an unknown small world, you have earned the world’s will reward, World Mark +5 layers]
Han Xing’s lips curled with a hint of joy.
layers of marks now, just 15 more to gather a complete [World Will].
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
Then, everyone continued onward.
"Buzz!"
The Divine Demon Battleship began continuous teleportation.
After several days of advance, they’ve reached the deepest part of the Void.
Here, small worlds seem to be born more frequently.
In the next five days, Han Xing encountered two more small worlds undergoing disaster.
As the God of Radiance, each time he reluctantly intervened to save these two small worlds, he again suffered heavy blows.
Han Xing still managed to gather 10 layers of World Marks.
Just 5 more layers to achieve the World Will!
However, after several rescues, Han Xing clearly sensed that the God of Radiance’s aura seemed to slightly diminish.
Though the decrease is minimal, any loss of Power is serious for an existence like Radiance on the verge of becoming a True God.
Radiance said nothing.
Han Xing took the initiative to ask, "Radiance, how much Power did you lose during these rescues?"
Upon hearing Han Xing inquire, the God of Radiance replied, "Master, less than a ten-thousandth."
Hearing this number, Han Xing nodded.
Though it might not seem much, considering the God of Radiance’s terrifying Power, even a ten-thousandth loss is substantial.
Thus, Han Xing said, "Radiance, I understand that rescuing those small worlds might cause backlash on you."
"But I need something related to these small worlds now."
"Therefore, I need you to help me once more."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s earnest reply, the God of Radiance recognized the importance of the matter to him.
Consequently, the God of Radiance replied, "Understood, Master."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, a new doubt arose in his mind.
Throughout their journey, though they encountered several newly born small worlds.
Yet, they haven’t seen a single formed world with Life inside.
From the conversation of the Divine Spirits, Han Xing learned there should be many small worlds in the Void.
Han Xing continued to look towards the God of Radiance beside him, asking puzzledly, "Radiance, did all small worlds that survived disasters get destroyed?"
"Why haven’t we seen any of them?"

Hearing this number, Han Xing nodded.
Though it might not seem much, considering the God of Radiance’s terrifying Power, even a ten-thousandth loss is substantial.
Thus, Han Xing said, "Radiance, I understand that rescuing those small worlds might cause backlash on you."
"But I need something related to these small worlds now."
"Therefore, I need you to help me once more."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s earnest reply, the God of Radiance recognized the importance of the matter to him.
Consequently, the God of Radiance replied, "Understood, Master."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, a new doubt arose in his mind.
Throughout their journey, though they encountered several newly born small worlds.
Yet, they haven’t seen a single formed world with Life inside.
From the conversation of the Divine Spirits, Han Xing learned there should be many small worlds in the Void.
Han Xing continued to look towards the God of Radiance beside him, asking puzzledly, "Radiance, did all small worlds that survived disasters get destroyed?"
"Why haven’t we seen any of them?"

chapters.title: Chapter 870 - 463: Synthesizing the World Will (2)
paragraphs: However, the God of Radiance shook his head and said, "No, Master."
"Those small worlds that have survived the calamities have already developed self-awareness."
"They know that there are many dangers lurking in the Void, so they all choose to hide themselves."
"Hide themselves?" Han Xing asked, puzzled.
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes."
Han Xing pondered for a moment and continued, "Is there any way to find these small worlds?"
The God of Radiance shook his head and said, "For now, there is no way."
"The energy within the Void is too chaotic and boundless, making it impossible to detect."
"Much like the palace of the Dark Night Goddess, hidden within the Void, even if we appear nearby, we wouldn’t sense it."
"Only True God Level beings can possess the strength to find other small worlds within the Void."
Han Xing thought silently, "True God..."
He nodded and decided not to ponder this issue further.
Next, the Divine Demon Battleship continued its teleportation.
A day later...
Just one day away from the location of the Barbaric God’s palace.
On the way, Han Xing encountered yet another small world enduring calamities.
This time, without Han Xing needing to say much, the God of Radiance decisively intervened, neutralizing all the disasters inside.
The small world teetering on the brink of collapse returned to tranquility.
Simultaneously.
A world mark imprinted on Han Xing.
The system prompt appeared.
[Detected Human Race Master Han Xing: World mark has reached 100 layers, conditions met to synthesize World Will?]
[Synthesize?]
"Yes."
At the moment Han Xing clicked confirm.
The energy within a million miles fell into a halted state.
The next instant, this energy began rotating towards a single point, as if driven by some attraction.
"Wow! Wow!"
It was as if a tornado emerged beneath the sea.
The violent Void energy, due to the constant rotation, formed a massive energy cyclone!
And Han Xing and his companions’ Divine Demon Battleship was situated at the core of this cyclone.
But with the protection of the God of Radiance, the Divine Demon Battleship remained unmoving.
The team members looked in amazement at the scene simulated on the screen.
This image was truly awe-inspiring!
"Whoa... How come this scene looks like a black hole? Are we now at the center of a black hole?"
"Will this energy hurricane continue to grow larger?"
Cheng Jianyong asked in uncertainty.
Even Han Xing was feeling quite surprised.
As he hadn’t expected that merely wanting to synthesize a [World Will] would cause such a commotion.
"Whew—"
The turbulent energy cyclone swept through.
Just as Cheng Jianyong said, this energy storm was growing larger.
From an initial diameter of a million kilometers, within mere seconds, it reached ten million kilometers!
Even the Divine Demon Battleship seemed insignificant in front of this colossal cyclone.
In the next instant, this storm, now exceeding a diameter of ten million kilometers, suddenly coalesced into a line.
And this line descended from overhead, then appeared directly above the battleship.
Everybody sensed a strong energy fluctuation above.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and directly said, "Let’s go out and take a look."
After speaking, the six of them blinked and appeared on the deck of the Divine Demon Battleship.
Then, they witnessed a stunning scene.
Above them was a tiny ball, the size of a fist, connected to that black line.
Through the line, it was endlessly absorbing the surrounding violent Chaos energy.
The enormous storm suddenly seemed to allow this tiny ball to absorb half its energy!
Yet, its size hadn’t visibly increased.
The God of Radiance said in astonishment, "This is... the scene of yet another small world’s birth!"
"Heavens! Master, what did you do?"
Han Xing did not answer but asked back, "Radiance, is this how a small world is born?"
The God of Radiance nodded, then shook his head, "The birth of a small world doesn’t usually cause such terrifying commotion."
"From what I’ve seen, those small worlds only need to absorb a few tens of thousands of kilometers of energy from Chaos, at most absorbing tens of thousands more."
"For this small world to absorb ten million kilometers of Void energy is truly beyond my imagination!"
Then, the God of Radiance worriedly said, "But this means that if this small world grows in the future, the calamities it must face will become exceedingly terrifying."
"Giving it no chance of survival."
Han Xing nodded in realization.
From the God of Radiance’s words, he seemed to understand the relationship between the Void and these small worlds.
The birth of a small world requires energy.
And where does the energy come from?
Of course, from the Void.
The Void is devoured of energy by these small worlds, thus it brings down celestial calamities to destroy them.
However, there is always a ray of hope in everything.
Including the Chaos Celestial Calamity.
After experiencing the calamity with a chance of survival, the small worlds that endure continue to thrive,
but those unable to withstand it perish...
Han Xing, as if in a trance, seemed to vaguely grasp the connection between the small worlds and the Void.
Yet, different from what the God of Radiance mentioned.
The tiny ball before Han Xing wasn’t a nascent small world.
It was the will of a world.
Though it sounded equally elusive.
Clearly, [World Will] was not the same as those nascent small worlds.

chapters.title: Chapter 871 - 463: Synthesis of World Will_3
paragraphs: The crowd silently waited.
When the nearby Void Energy Storm had been completely absorbed.
Millions of miles around plunged into boundless darkness.
Silence, a deathly silence...
This area seemed half-dead, with no trace of any material existence.
Mysteriously, everyone suddenly had a bad feeling in their hearts.
At this moment, not only Shen Yun, but even the God of Radiance’s face changed first.
"Master, let’s go quickly!"
Although no one knew what would happen next.
Even Han Xing felt enveloped by a sense of crisis.
As if something terrifying was about to happen in this region.
Without any hesitation, Han Xing directly activated the "Teleportation" button on the battleship.
"Buzz!"
"Entering teleportation state, starting countdown..."
"Five..."
"Four..."
In the next moment, the Divine Demon Battleship instantly disappeared from its original location.
Seconds later, they appeared over ten million kilometers away.
The extreme teleportation distance of the Divine Demon Battleship was just enough to surpass this void region.
At this moment, when everyone looked back, they found that the Void that had devoured all energy seemed to have disappeared entirely.
Yes, it had completely disappeared.
Such a vast Void Realm, even from millions of kilometers away could be seen.
But now, there was no trace of it at all.
Cheng Jianyong looked at the God of Radiance and asked, "Radiance, have you encountered this situation before?"
The God of Radiance shook his head.
Clearly, as an ancient Divine Spirit, he had not encountered such an event.
"It’s outrageous..."
Everyone felt a strange sensation rising in their hearts.
If they had stayed there just moments before, would they have vanished along with that space?
And after disappearing, where would they end up?
The thought of this possibility sent shivers down everyone’s spine.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, then comforted, "Alright, no need to think too much, we’re fine and that’s what matters."
"There are many secrets in the Void, this one doesn’t make much difference."
After hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
Han Xing gazed at the palm-sized glowing orb before him, murmuring, "This is the World Will."
"Having absorbed so much energy, what purpose does it ultimately serve?"
Then, the attributes of this item appeared in front of him.
[World Will: Unknown Grade (Exclusive to Han Xing)]
[Effect 1: Allows a dead world to replace its will, regain vitality, and become a growing world.]
[Effect 2: Can be directly absorbed, increasing Divine Power Value by 50,000 points.]

[Effect 3: Directly detonate this World Will, sealing one million kilometers around, blocking all enemies’ Power of Rules, causing 99.99 million True Damage (effective against True God Level entities)]
[Effect 4: Can be used as materials for crafting some special devices, granting them special effect.]
Upon seeing the four ways this item could be used.
Han Xing couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
"Hiss!!"
Goodness, the first effect can allow a dead world to be reborn.
Meaning, if Han Xing uses it, he could own a small world of his own?
This usage is definitely worth noting.
Although Han Xing doesn’t understand the utility of controlling a small world.
But when it involves the world, it must be extraordinary.
As for the second use, it’s quite straightforward, directly increasing Divine Power Value by 50,000 points, which is incredibly powerful, comparable to the boost from 5 complete Power of Rules!
The third effect is even more terrifying, directly exploding the World Will and sealing all enemies’ Power of Rules, dealing nearly 100 million True Damage to enemies.
This thing is a massive weapon!
You have to know, even the main cannon of Divine Demon Battleship has only an Attack Power of 5 million.
With the bonus from Sun Crown Stele, it becomes 15 million Attack Power.
This level of attack is already able to critically wound gods like the God of Light.
Imagine the 100 million True Damage of the World Will, if detonated.
Even a True God would perish instantly!
"Truly terrifying..."
Han Xing murmured.
Now, he was even a bit reluctant to use the World Will for crafting the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
With this item, even facing a True God, Han Xing has confidence to make sure he doesn’t just come and go as he pleases!
It’s like having a trump card against True Gods!
After thinking for a moment.
Han Xing looked at the schematic requirements for the Celestial Rail Strike Device.

[Materials required for building Celestial Rail Strike Device: Philosopher’s Stone*50 million, Shimmering Terra Stone*50 million, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*20 million, Calamity Divine Gold*500 thousand, Chaos Divine Stone*200 thousand, Unknown Item: Codename World Will*1.]
"That’s way too much..."
Han Xing was stunned and looked at his material reserves.
[Philosopher’s Stone]*37.23 million
[Shimmering Terra Stone]*17.54 million
[Ancient Elf Secret Ingot]*6 million
[Calamity Divine Gold]*61 thousand
[Chaos Divine Stone]*17 thousand
"Wow... I never thought, even I couldn’t afford to build a Celestial Rail Strike Device."
"The materials required for this thing are too outrageous!"
Han Xing initially thought his material reserves were quite abundant.
But couldn’t even gather enough for building one device.
Nevertheless, it indirectly indicates the power of the Celestial Rail Strike Device must be very formidable.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and first put this World Will into his backpack.
"Let’s wait and see, I now know the location of two Divine Treasure Vaults, I should be able to scavenge quite a few materials from these two vaults."
"If they’re really not enough, I’ll have Radiance take me to plunder the God of Light’s vault too."
Although Han Xing currently can’t immediately build the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
But with the World Will in hand, he essentially possesses a weapon capable of annihilating True Gods!
Of course, Han Xing isn’t sure if, when he throws out the World Will, it might also wipe him out along with it.
So he still needs to find an appropriate opportunity to use it.

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - 464: Barbaric God Trial Begins
paragraphs: Han Xing continued to ponder.
"Moreover, aside from the Celestial Rail Strike Device, I have a Divine Spirit Level mecha creation: the Lingxiao that needs crafting."
"The materials needed for the Lingxiao are also quite a terrifying number."
"So next, we need to figure out how to gather more materials!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s hoarding instinct started kicking in.
Due to insufficient material reserves, Han Xing felt a lack of security!
In the next three days, the group didn’t encounter another nascent small world in the Void.
They quickly arrived at the location of the [Inheritance Palace Key of the Wilderness God].
As everyone expected, no building structures were found here either.
No palace, not even a brick.
However, thanks to their experience outside the Dark Night Goddess Palace, no one panicked.
Han Xing’s figure flashed directly to the battleship’s deck,
He raised the rusty key in his hand and shouted, "Wilderness God! I’ve come to negotiate... no, we’ve come to accept your trial!"
Han Xing’s voice echoed far away.
The next moment, the Void began to tremble.
"Rumble!"
Then, under the astonished eyes of everyone, a pyramid-shaped palace with three layers appeared, towering over ten million meters!
Even Han Xing and others’ [Divine Demon Battleship] seemed insignificant compared to this structure.
"Wow... That’s huge!"
Clearly, this was the largest building they had ever seen.
The palace appeared to be constructed from giant stones, each piece measuring tens of kilometers wide and thousands of meters thick!
In contrast to the Dark Night Goddess Palace’s stern and steady style,
this palace looked incredibly rugged and majestic.
Cheng Jianyong and others appeared on the deck as well.
He pointed to the lowest layer of the colossal pyramid structure and said, "Brother Xing, look there."
Following Cheng Jianyong’s direction,
Han Xing saw a staircase leading straight to the top!
This staircase was equally magnificent.
Each step was tens of thousands of meters high, several hundred kilometers wide.
Standing on it felt as small as an ant.
"Is this the trial palace of the Wilderness God? What a grand display!" Cheng Jianyong marveled.
Even the God of Radiance, watching the colossal building, couldn’t help but feel stunned.
Contrary to everyone’s amazement, Han Xing was more concerned about what materials were used to create this building.
Can these giant stones be taken away?
Or, is there any treasure within this palace?
Meanwhile, a system prompt appeared.
[You have discovered the Wilderness God’s Inheritance Palace; World Influence +1784, Legendary Points +20]
Seeing this system prompt, everyone glanced at each other.
Wow! No wonder the Wilderness God is one of the four oldest divine spirits!
Merely discovering his inheritance palace added more Legendary Points and World Influence than other divine spirits.
"Let’s go over there."
But as Han Xing was preparing to maneuver the [Divine Demon Battleship] to dock directly,
he suddenly found the battleship unable to proceed, as if an invisible shield was enveloping the entire [Wilderness God Inheritance Palace].
"Huh? Not letting us through?" Cheng Jianyong wondered.
And at this moment, a second system prompt appeared.
[Inheritor detected, conditions are being checked...]
[Check complete.]
[Race: Human Race]
[Item: Key of the God of the Wilderness (qualified)]
[Power: Legendary Limit (First Class)]
[Divine Power Value: above 30,000. (Super First Class)]
[Physical Attributes: Middle-tier Demigod. (Super First Class)]
[Overall Evaluation: Super First Class.]
[Fully met the Wilderness God’s inheritance conditions, do you wish to enter the Wilderness God Inheritance Palace?]
Everyone exchanged glances.
Clearly, the target of this check was Han Xing.
Shen Yun chuckled, "Super First Class evaluation, even the Wilderness God wouldn’t have expected such a demon to inherit his Power."
Everyone laughed along.
Cheng Jianyong said, "The palace’s detection mechanism is truly impressive, even identifying Brother Xing’s Divine Power Value and Physical Attributes."
"Sadly, the one to inherit the Wilderness God’s Power isn’t Brother Xing, but me, Cheng Jianyong, hahaha!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing also smiled.
He tossed the key directly to Cheng Jianyong.
Then, another system prompt appeared.
[Inheritor target change detected, rechecking conditions.]
[Checking...]
[Check complete.]
[Race: Human Race]
[Item: Key of the God of the Wilderness (qualified)]
[Power: Legendary Limit (First Class)]
[Divine Power Value: above 8,000. (First Class)]
[Physical Attributes: Initial-tier Demigod. (First Class)]
[Overall Evaluation: First Class.]
[Met the Wilderness God’s inheritance conditions, do you wish to enter the Wilderness God Inheritance Palace?]
Compared to Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong’s evaluation turned out to be First Class.
Content with this result, Cheng Jianyong nodded, "First Class is not bad."
He looked at Han Xing and asked, "Brother Xing, should we enter directly now?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, let’s go straight in."
"Okay."
Cheng Jianyong clicked to confirm.
The next moment, the energy shield of the first layer area of this immense stone palace instantly dissipated.
Seeing this, Han Xing pondered, "Does this mean we can only enter from the first layer?"
Shaking his head, Han Xing directly said, "Let’s go check it out."
