What a grand display!" Cheng Jianyong marveled.
Even the God of Radiance, watching the colossal building, couldn’t help but feel stunned.
Contrary to everyone’s amazement, Han Xing was more concerned about what materials were used to create this building.
Can these giant stones be taken away?
Or, is there any treasure within this palace?
Meanwhile, a system prompt appeared.
[You have discovered the Wilderness God’s Inheritance Palace; World Influence +1784, Legendary Points +20]
Seeing this system prompt, everyone glanced at each other.
Wow!
No wonder the Wilderness God is one of the four oldest divine spirits!
Merely discovering his inheritance palace added more Legendary Points and World Influence than other divine spirits.
"Let’s go over there."
But as Han Xing was preparing to maneuver the [Divine Demon Battleship] to dock directly,
he suddenly found the battleship unable to proceed, as if an invisible shield was enveloping the entire [Wilderness God Inheritance Palace].
"Huh?
Not letting us through?" Cheng Jianyong wondered.
And at this moment, a second system prompt appeared.
[Inheritor detected, conditions are being checked...]
[Check complete.]
[Race: Human Race]
[Item: Key of the God of the Wilderness (qualified)]
[Power: Legendary Limit (First Class)]
[Divine Power Value: above 30,000. (Super First Class)]
[Physical Attributes: Middle-tier Demigod. (Super First Class)]
[Overall Evaluation: Super First Class.]
[Fully met the Wilderness God’s inheritance conditions, do you wish to enter the Wilderness God Inheritance Palace?]
Everyone exchanged glances.
Clearly, the target of this check was Han Xing.
Shen Yun chuckled, "Super First Class evaluation, even the Wilderness God wouldn’t have expected such a demon to inherit his Power."
Everyone laughed along.
Cheng Jianyong said, "The palace’s detection mechanism is truly impressive, even identifying Brother Xing’s Divine Power Value and Physical Attributes."
"Sadly, the one to inherit the Wilderness God’s Power isn’t Brother Xing, but me, Cheng Jianyong, hahaha!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing also smiled.
He tossed the key directly to Cheng Jianyong.
Then, another system prompt appeared.
[Inheritor target change detected, rechecking conditions.]
[Checking...]
[Check complete.]
[Race: Human Race]
[Item: Key of the God of the Wilderness (qualified)]
[Power: Legendary Limit (First Class)]
[Divine Power Value: above 8,000. (First Class)]
[Physical Attributes: Initial-tier Demigod. (First Class)]
[Overall Evaluation: First Class.]
[Met the Wilderness God’s inheritance conditions, do you wish to enter the Wilderness God Inheritance Palace?]
Compared to Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong’s evaluation turned out to be First Class.
Content with this result, Cheng Jianyong nodded, "First Class is not bad."
He looked at Han Xing and asked, "Brother Xing, should we enter directly now?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, let’s go straight in."
"Okay."
Cheng Jianyong clicked to confirm.
The next moment, the energy shield of the first layer area of this immense stone palace instantly dissipated.
Seeing this, Han Xing pondered, "Does this mean we can only enter from the first layer?"
Shaking his head, Han Xing directly said, "Let’s go check it out."

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - 464: Barbaric God’s Trial Begins (Part 2)
paragraphs: The [Divine Demon Battleship] slowly approached, then gradually arrived at this gigantic stone palace, the area of the first level.
The next moment, the figures of six people flashed.
They appeared inside the palace,
which looked more like a vast stone platform.
In the central area was the staircase leading to the top of the passage.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[Please, the Survivor holding the Key of the Barbaric God, step onto the staircase and accept the heritage trial.]
[Please note, this heritage trial can only be accepted by one person, other beings cannot participate.]
Seeing this system prompt, everyone looked at each other in bewilderment.
Shen Yun asked in confusion, "Does this mean Xiaoyongzi has to complete it on his own?"
Cheng Jianyong didn’t feel much; he was extremely confident in himself.
"It’s fine, I’ll go by myself."
"This little trial, watch me take it effortlessly!"
Even though he said it lightly, everyone knew that such supreme hidden profession trials were surely not that simple.
After all, the process of Zhang Lianmeng gathering 7 Elemental Divine Formats had cost everyone so much time and effort, which was expected.
This was still with the five of them helping.
And for Cheng Jianyong, this trial can only be challenged by him alone.
Han Xing walked over, patting Cheng Jianyong on the shoulder, "Be careful."
Cheng Jianyong put away the smile on his face.
He also knew that this trial was absolutely not that simple.
Thus, Cheng Jianyong took a deep breath.
He took out the burning red rod, [Abdullah’s Molten Rock Pillar].
Before, he always thought this pillar was too ugly.
But now, to face this heritage trial with all his might, he was also forced to take out this pillar.
The staircase in front of him, each step was a hundred meters high, hundreds of kilometers wide, even capable of being called a small battlefield.
When Cheng Jianyong stepped onto the first step.
It represented the official start of the challenge.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[The supreme heritage trial officially begins, please slay all enemies in order to ascend to challenge the second level of the staircase.]
When the prompt ended, the onlookers saw.
A barrier of air suddenly appeared on the first level of the staircase battlefield, isolating everyone.
At the same time.
Cheng Jianyong also saw, around him appeared dense packs of wolves.
These wolves had blood-red fur and ferocious fangs, exuding a brutal aura throughout.
[Blood Wolf: Tier Five Elite Level Creature]
[Level: 52]
[Attributes: Strength 6723, Agility 6974, Spirit 6643, Constitution 6324]
[Skills: Blood Bite (When attacking, a 100% chance to apply a permanent bleeding effect to the target, lasting until either itself or the opponent perishes)
Blood Strike (Transformed into a streak of blood lightning that strikes the enemy, dealing 150% attack damage)
Blood Claw (Upon hitting, absorbs 30% of the inflicted damage)]
[Talent: Pack (When the number of blood wolves acting simultaneously reaches 100 or more, Attack Power increases by 20%, Movement Speed increases by 20%)]
These were the enemies of the first level.
A pack of elite-level blood wolves, mixed with one or two leader-level blood wolves.
Although numerous, under Cheng Jianyong’s overwhelming Power, they were completely ineffective.
"Boom!"
Cheng Jianyong swung the pillar with a whooshing sound.
"Awooo!"
The blood wolf pack surged forward like a tide.
Cheng Jianyong began a frenzied sweep.
Boom! Boom boom boom!
Each time the pillar hit a blood wolf, it emitted a series of flesh-shattering sounds.
In an instant, the terrifying force crushed these blood wolves into pieces!
"Pop pop pop!"
Blood flowers burst open one after another.
Cheng Jianyong directly transformed into a machine of slaughter.
From one end of the staircase, he crossed over ten kilometers, to the other end of the staircase.
In under five minutes, he slaughtered all the blood wolves on this level of the staircase.
During Cheng Jianyong’s killing spree, Han Xing and the others noticed that clusters of invisible blood energy seemed to be absorbed by Cheng Jianyong.
However, Cheng Jianyong’s panel did not change.
[The Barbaric God’s Heritage Trial, the first tier of the first floor has been passed, you have 30 seconds to rest...]
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exhaled lightly, "Wuhu, it doesn’t seem that difficult."
Han Xing’s voice came from afar, "Don’t be complacent, this is only the first step."
"Just the first floor has over a hundred of these steps."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s reminder, Cheng Jianyong straightened up again.
He began to quickly recover his Physical Strength.
When the 30-second rest period ended.
Then, he directly stepped onto the second floor.
An Energy Light Curtain appeared.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly saw, nearby, appeared several pitch-black creatures that looked like a mix of leopards and tigers.
In front of him appeared the attributes of these monsters.
[Divine Creation - Beast Sewn Together: Five-star Elite Level Creature]
[Level: 52]
[Attributes: Strength 7134, Agility 7241, Spirit 6892, Constitution 7117]
[Skills: Tiger and Leopard Form (Burst speed increased by 50%, Attack Power increased by 25%)
Beast King’s Suppression (Applies a mark on the enemy, increasing the attack speed by 30% when striking)
Barbaric Assault (Instantly bursts with full body Power, Charges forward a thousand meters, inflicting 80% tearing damage to all enemies in the path)]
Compared to the monsters on the first level of the staircase, although both at the elite level, this hybrid of a tiger and leopard was evidently more powerful.
However, for Cheng Jianyong, they still posed no problem.
He continued to wield the [Molten Rock Pillar], smashing the black beasts lunging at him into pulp!
Han Xing and the others once again noticed, those beasts he killed, all had red blood energy being absorbed by him.

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - 464: Barbaric God Trial Activated_3
paragraphs: Time used: 4 minutes 40 seconds, Cheng Jianyong once again completed the challenge of the 2nd floor.
To save time, he didn’t choose to rest, and directly stepped into the 3rd floor.
The monsters that appeared on this floor were a group of brown bears.
They also had Five-star Elite Level strength, and the number of Leader-level brown bears had increased.
Cheng Jianyong began another round of slaughter.
Then he pushed straight through.
4th floor...
5th floor...
6th floor...
He charged all the way up to the 80th step in one breath before finally pausing to catch his breath.
Because here, he had just encountered a Legendary Level opponent.
However, it only made him pause for a brief moment.
Very soon, Cheng Jianyong drew in a deep breath and directly charged in for the kill.
Starting from the 80th floor.
From here on, every floor would have 1 Legendary Level monster appear.
And its Level and strength were steadily increasing.
By the time he reached the 100th floor.
Cheng Jianyong finally faced an opponent that was enough to make him look serious.
It was a Level 60 Legendary Creature.
This monster had the limbs of an elephant, the body of a rhinoceros, the skin of a crocodile, the fangs of a Saber-toothed Tiger, and the ears of a deer.
Its whole body was multicolored, as if stitched together.
In front of him, the Attributes panel of this monster appeared.
[Divine Creation · Five Spirits Sewn Together, Five-star Legendary Level]
[Level: Level 60]
[Attributes: Power 67,217, agility 54,213, Spirit 55,231, Constitution 64,221]

[Skills: Five Spirits Body (Constitution increased by 40%), Power of the Five Spirits (Power increased by 40%), Beast’s Instinct (when entering combat State, Attack Speed increased by 50%), Light of the Five Phases (summons Light of Chaos, firing an Energy pillar forward, dealing Attack Power *150% damage to all enemies along its path),
Fivefold Beast King Domain (facing the fivefold pressure of the Beast King, reduces enemies’ agility by 8,000*5 and Power by 6,000*5, ineffective against Demigod Level Creatures)
Chaos Light Rain (Legendary Skills, summons 100 beams of Light of Chaos, dealing Attack Power *177 True Damage to all enemies)]
[Divine Power Value: 0]
This was the first High-tier Legendary Level monster he had encountered.
Moreover, the Attributes of this stitched monster were somewhat strange.
As a High-tier Legend, its Divine Power Value was actually 0.
This was probably related to its stitched-together nature.
However, in exchange, it had terrifying Power and Constitution.
A hint of War Intent appeared on Cheng Jianyong’s face.
When that Sewn Giant Beast pounced at him.
Cheng Jianyong’s figure vanished in an instant.
Then, a terrifying Molten Rock Pillar, like a pillar propping up the sky, smashed down violently!
"Roar!!!"
The monster seemed to want to rely on brute strength to take it head-on.
It thrust out its thick elephant leg and smashed it down hard.
However, how could its Power possibly compare to Cheng Jianyong, who was now fully outfitted with Divine Artifact Equipment.
"Bang!"
A dull, meaty thud rang out.
This Legendary Level stitched monster was directly smashed into the floor.
And its elephant leg exploded in midair into a rain of blood.
Seeing this scene, Cheng Jianyong pressed the advantage and launched a pursuit.
"Roar!!"
Under the terrified gaze of that monster.
Cheng Jianyong swung his big club down fiercely.
With a thunderous crash, this stitched monster was slammed directly into the ground.
Even its head was smashed to pulp.
Then, it turned into a rain of light and disappeared from everyone’s sight.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully cleared the Trial Palace of the Barbaric God, first-layer challenge completed perfectly, reward obtained: Barbaric God’s Inheritance Mark, 100 layers.]
[Trial Palace: Second-layer challenge is now opening.]
This prompt sounded in everyone’s ears.
Shen Yun asked curiously, "Cheng Jianyong, what is the Barbaric God’s Inheritance Mark?"
Cheng Jianyong replied in the team channel, "I don’t know, it only says it can be used to unlock the final inheritance Trial, nothing else.
Hearing this, everyone suddenly nodded in realization.
Then, after resting for a while, Cheng Jianyong directly started the second-layer challenge.
The second-layer stairway had over three hundred steps.
The monsters here were also mostly Five-star Elite Level, and there was a Legendary Creature on every floor.
For the current Cheng Jianyong, this level of strength could no longer pose any threat to him.
After waiting for more than an hour, Cheng Jianyong once again charged through thirty to forty floors in a row.
Everyone continued watching the battle from the side.
Shen Yun frowned and said, "At this rate, Cheng Jianyong is in for a prolonged endurance battle."
Han Xing also nodded. "He spent eight hours on the hundred steps of the first layer."
"This second layer has nearly five hundred steps. I’d say he won’t be coming down in less than three or four days."
"And there’s still the third layer with a full thousand steps..."
After Han Xing finished speaking, worry appeared in everyone’s eyes.
After all, going through such high-intensity combat continuously for four or five days straight would make even Han Xing feel a bit strained.
Moreover, the first and second layers were just appetizers.
The third layer was where the Trial was at its hardest.
Calculating the clearance time per layer like this.
It meant that Cheng Jianyong would have to undergo at least half a month of continuous battle next.
Han Xing let out a sigh and said, "I just hope he can hold out..."
Everyone nodded as well.
This was Cheng Jianyong’s choice, and they had no way to help him.
Three hours later.
Everyone watching from the side started to feel a bit bored.
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, should we find something to do now?"
Han Xing nodded. "I’ve been thinking about something—this palace is so huge; besides the outer stairway, it can’t possibly be solid inside, right?"
Hearing Han Xing bring this up, everyone seemed to realize something as well.
"Brother Xing, you mean...?"
Han Xing nodded. "Let’s go search around the perimeter of this palace and see if there’s any way to enter its interior."
"Alright."
The team members all agreed, then began to split up and act.
Han Xing also started searching around.

chapters.title: Chapter 875 - 465: Entering the Interior of the Divine Palace
paragraphs: The entire palace resembled a gigantic pyramid, with no visible entrance leading inside.
Han Xing circled the massive pyramid twice and suddenly discovered an unusual spot at a corner.
It was an entrance like an archway.
Compared to the grand scale of this structure, the entrance appeared very inconspicuous.
Han Xing immediately gathered his team members and the God of Radiance.
"Huh? There really is a door here," Shen Yun exclaimed in surprise.
However, when they approached, they found a large gray stone door at the entrance.
There was a strong divine power seal on the door.
Han Xing looked at the God of Radiance beside him and asked, "Radiance, can you sense what’s inside the palace?"
The God of Radiance released divine power from his body, enveloping the entire giant stone palace.
After a moment, he shook his head and said, "I’m very sorry, Master, this palace is shielded by a rather high-level divine power."
"I can’t sense what’s inside,"
Han Xing nodded, not feeling too surprised.
After all, the Barbaric God was known as one of the oldest among the four ancient divine spirits.
He was likely several levels above the God of Radiance.
Thinking about this, a trace of curiosity arose in Han Xing’s heart.
He asked, "Radiance, do you know how strong the Barbaric God is? What level of divine spirit is he?"
Upon hearing this question, the God of Radiance shook his head: "Master, I don’t know."
"These four ancient divine spirits are known to exist, but they are very low-key and rarely reveal their true forms."
"So, the world is left only to speculate about their powers."
Hearing this, Han Xing nodded in realization.
He continued to ask, "Besides the Elemental God and the Barbaric God, do you know the names of the other two?"
The God of Radiance shook his head again: "Master, I don’t know that either.
Han Xing was somewhat surprised, "You don’t know either? Didn’t you say these four ancient divine spirits exist?"
The God of Radiance replied with a wry smile, "They do exist indeed, but Master, you should know, the Elemental God and the Barbaric God are known as two of the oldest four divine spirits."
"But how ancient are they?"
Upon hearing this question, Han Xing fell into deep thought.
To be honest, he hadn’t really considered this issue before.
What he knew as the oldest era was only the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
"Could it be that they are not gods born in the Age of Ten Thousand Gods?" Han Xing voiced his doubts.
The God of Radiance chuckled and said, "Yes, none of us gods know the exact era during which the Elemental God and the Barbaric God first emerged."
"But it’s speculated they might have become divine spirits even before the Age of Ten Thousand Gods."
"So, apart from those four, we don’t know what era preceded the Age of Ten Thousand Gods."
"We also have no idea how long these four ancient beings have existed."

chapters.title: Chapter 876 - 465: Entering the Interior of the Divine Palace (Part 2)
paragraphs: After a wave of fluctuation, the seal barrier restored its original state.
This was the first time [Beast’s Tail Spike] had encountered such a situation.
"Damn...so hard to break?"
Han Xing was not discouraged.
He lifted the giant spike and continued to jab at the same spot.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
Ripples kept appearing on it.
However, even with Han Xing’s continuous attempts, there were no signs of the Divine Power Barrier being lifted.
Moreover, Han Xing had been holding onto the True God Level fierce beast’s tail spike for a long time.
His skin, once again, seeped with dense blood stains.
Although he had already reached the peak Legendary Level, with flesh strength comparable to a Middle-tier Demigod.
Nonetheless, the Power of Rules on the Beast Tail Spike could injure even a True God.
So Han Xing was still enduring that terrifying stinging sensation.
But having gone through it several times before, Han Xing was already accustomed to it.
Seeing this, the God of Radiance approached, saying, "Master, is that the Beast of Calamity Tail Spike in your hand?"
Han Xing halted the door-breaking motion, then shook his body, instantly evaporating the dense blood marks on him.
He nodded, "Yes,"
The God of Radiance said, "This gate has the seal of the Barbaric God on it."
"Though the Beast of Calamity Tail Spike is adept at breaking all sorts of Divine Power barriers, it falls a bit short compared to the sealing level above."
Hearing this, Han Xing pondered.
"Radiance, is there a way?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "I can give it a try."
Han Xing’s eyes lit up immediately, "Try?"
The God of Radiance manipulated divine power and took over the Beast of Calamity Tail Spike from Han Xing’s hand.
Then, Han Xing saw the spike transform into a stream of light and disappear into the distance.
Han Xing had no concerns, nor was he worried that the God of Radiance would snatch away this treasure.
Sure enough, the disappeared tail spike burst forth with intense radiance in the void.
Then, in a string-like momentum, it instantly rushed towards this side.
Whoosh!
In the void, even a series of sonic booms appeared.
"Master, and a few friends of the Human Race, please step aside a bit first.
Upon hearing this, everyone unhesitatingly moved away from the gate.
In the next moment, that tail spike directly struck the Divine Power Barrier.
"Buzz!"
A strong fluctuation appeared on it.
Han Xing’s eyes brightened.
It’s promising!
Thus, Han Xing ordered, "Radiance, continue."
The God of Radiance complied, manipulated divine power to apply to the Beast’s Tail Spike, then accelerated the stab.
"Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!"
After more than a dozen continuous attempts.
Everyone saw the Energy Light Curtain becoming increasingly thin.
After the eighteenth attack ended.
The divine power seal above vanished completely.
"Boom!"
The gray limestone gate above showed dense cracks.
The God of Radiance returned the Beast’s Tail Spike to Han Xing, then said, "Master, I didn’t fail the mission."
Han Xing nodded, "Radiance, well done."
Then, he directly destroyed the gate that was about to crack.
"Crash! Rumble!"
The gray limestone gate collapsed.
And in front of everyone, a deep passage appeared.
Everyone exchanged looks, smiles appearing on their faces.
Because this meant they could truly enter inside.
"Let’s go, take a look inside."
With those words, Han Xing led the team inside the passage.
Before Shen Yun entered, he said in the team channel, "Xiaoyongzi, we’re going to the palace to hunt for treasure, not staying outside with you."
"Make sure to strive a bit harder, don’t let us see you’ve been wiped out when we come out, that would be too embarrassing."
Cheng Jianyong, in a fighting state at the moment, got angry upon hearing this, "Hey! Xiaoyunzi looks down on whom?"
"Watch me, Old Cheng, directly kill through a thousand levels and become a Supreme Hidden Profession.
"And then you can wait to be thrashed by me!"
Shen Yun smiled and shook his head.
Also followed into the passage.
This stone passage was deep and long.
Inside, there was not a single light source.
However, with the God of Radiance being like a moving light bulb, it was pretty much the same as being outside.
Han Xing noticed that there were many murals on the walls of this passage.
As they walked along, they understood a small story depicted in the murals.
The gist was: a boy born in an ancient tribe, innately divine power, grew up hunting with elders from his tribe.
One day, the village was attacked by a giant beast.
The beast tread upon flames with its four hooves, formidable beyond measure.
Watching as villagers were killed one by one.
The boy struck out in anger, engaged the beast in a life-and-death battle.
The boy ultimately defeated the beast and saved the village.
Then, the villagers revered the boy as the descendent of a Celestial God.
And just as the villagers jointly carried the beast’s corpse back to celebrate victory,
A massive shadow suddenly appeared in the sky, covering the entire village.
The story abruptly ended here.
The team members felt a bit bewildered.
But after thinking, they didn’t dwell on it.
Continuing down this passage for over ten kilometers, they finally reached the end.
System prompt appeared.
[You have entered the interior of the Barbaric God Divine Palace...]
This seemed to be a vast space, empty inside, their footsteps echoed far.
Shen Yun laughed, "Radiance, shine a light."
The God of Radiance snapped his fingers.
Pop!
Then, a light source floated forward.
As the light source advanced, it rapidly burst into myriad radiance.
Illuminating the entire interior space thoroughly.
In front of them, a massive plaza appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 877 - 465: Entering the Inner Sanctum of the Divine Palace (Part 3)
paragraphs: This plaza seems to be used for some kind of ritual ceremony, and also looks like a place similar to a beast fighting arena.
Around are many large black cauldrons, several iron cages, and sections of collapsed stone pillars.
On the ground, there are also many pieces of dried bloodstains.
Han Xing cast his gaze over, and a heap of red notifications appeared in front of him.
[Damaged Cauldron of Ten Thousand Spirits (Red): Unknown effect, seems to have the function of extracting divine power from demigod-level creatures.]
(Can be disassembled into materials: Philosopher’s Stone*20000, Shimmering Terra Stone*10000, Chaos Divine Stone*200)
[Damaged Sealing Spirit Cage (Red): Can be used to incarcerate demigod-level creatures, the creatures inside will have all divine power and physical strength sealed.]
(Can be disassembled into Philosopher’s Stone*10000, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*2000, Chaos Divine Stone*100)
[Broken Palace Pillar (Red): Purely crafted from Philosopher’s Stone, extremely hard stone pillar.]
(Can be disassembled into Philosopher’s Stone*50000.)
"Holy shit!"
Shen Yun exclaimed.
Obviously, the team members also saw the item descriptions.
They were filled with shock, even their breaths became somewhat rapid.
A moment later, Shen Yun couldn’t help but sigh: "These divine spirits really have a lot of treasures on their hands!"
"To be able to casually discard divine artifact-level items like this, they’re freaking wealthy."
Han Xing nodded and smiled: "Maybe because they are all damaged, they couldn’t be bothered to reforge them."
"Well, it’s a windfall for us."
Hearing this, everyone laughed in unison.
Without Han Xing saying anything, they all knew what to do next!
Then, they all rushed down together.
Everyone continuously released divine power, collecting all these broken pillars and iron cages.
System notifications appeared one after another.
[Acquired Broken Palace Pillar (Red) *1]
[Acquired Damaged Cauldron of Ten Thousand Spirits (Red) *1...]
[Acquired...]
Listening to the system notifications, Han Xing was in an excellent mood.
These already damaged divine artifact items, although they lost their original function.
But as long as they are disassembled, they yield tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of divine artifact-level materials!
And Han Xing needs to build the [Celestial Rail Strike Device] and the [Lingxiao], which themselves require a huge amount of materials.
This wave of harvest might just be enough to gather all the materials he needs,
so Han Xing said: "Search thoroughly, don’t miss a single corner."
Shen Yun laughed and replied: "Don’t worry, Brother Xing, not a single fragment will be missed!"
Everyone began to search the interior of the palace bit by bit.
After walking for a while, Han Xing set his gaze on the floor tiles beneath his feet.
Finding no notifications on them, he shook his head regretfully.
For this meant the floor tiles were either ordinary materials or materials that couldn’t be taken, which is why there’s no display.
However, Han Xing wasn’t discouraged.
Because apart from this large plaza, the interior of the palace also contains many small rooms.
Inside, they also found some old divine artifact items.
This Inheritance Palace has existed for a very long time.
Even the Barbaric God probably hasn’t visited it many times.
Han Xing and team were elated with their haul.
It wasn’t long before they filled up all 1600 slots in their inventory.
They had to go back and forth between the battleship and the palace interior to transport the materials out and come back.
It took Han Xing and his team a good four to five hours to finish searching that plaza.
Then Han Xing tallied the haul.
The four of them together, acquired a total of [Old Cauldron of Ten Thousand Spirits (Red)]*455,
[Damaged Sealing Spirit Cage (Red)]*1723,
[Broken Palace Pillar (Red)]*432,
adding up to a total obtainment of:
[Philosopher’s Stone]*47.93 million
[Shimmering Terra Stone]*9.1 million
[Ancient Elf Secret Ingot]*3.446 million
[Chaos Divine Stone]*263,000
"Wow! That’s a lot?"
Upon getting this number, Han Xing was also startled himself.
The biggest harvest this time was naturally the nearly 50 million Philosopher’s Stones.
Just those Philosopher’s Stones alone are enough for the quantity needed for the [Celestial Rail Strike Device].
The rest of the materials, combined, were an astounding gain!
Han Xing was thrilled!
"Great, great! At this rate, as long as we loot one or two more Divine Treasure Vaults, we will be more than sufficient to construct the Celestial Rail Strike Device!"
"With some luck, there might even be some extra materials to build the Lingxiao!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel excited.
Moreover, beyond the plaza, there’s still plenty to explore inside this palace.
They started moving through all those rooms.
For the next three days, Han Xing and his team searched separately within the palace.
Sparing no corner untouched.
Various old divine artifact items were pocketed by them.
These things overlooked by the Barbaric God, or scraps from some buildings, were astonishing treasures to Han Xing!
Han Xing couldn’t help but marvel, "I really don’t know where these divine spirits get such Philosopher’s Stones."
After three days.
Han Xing gained another [Philosopher’s Stone]*37.23 million, [Shimmering Terra Stone]*8.7 million, [Ancient Elf Secret Ingot]*1.8 million, [Chaos Divine Stone]*170,000.
Although not as much as the first day’s harvest,
it was still a considerable gain.
It wasn’t until then that they finished searching the entire palace interior.
Han Xing contentedly gathered everyone back together, "Let’s go, we’ve searched enough."
"Let’s head out and see how Cheng Jianyong is doing."
Speaking of which, Cheng Jianyong had been continuously fighting outside for four days.
Yesterday afternoon, they received a system notification.
Cheng Jianyong completed the second layer’s challenge, earning 500 layers of Barbaric God inheritance marks.
Now, he was in the third layer challenge.
And this was the toughest layer.
With a thousand steps in total.
And each step represents a battle.

Han Xing gained another [Philosopher’s Stone]*37.23 million, [Shimmering Terra Stone]*8.7 million, [Ancient Elf Secret Ingot]*1.8 million, [Chaos Divine Stone]*170,000.
Although not as much as the first day’s harvest,
it was still a considerable gain.
It wasn’t until then that they finished searching the entire palace interior.
Han Xing contentedly gathered everyone back together, "Let’s go, we’ve searched enough."
"Let’s head out and see how Cheng Jianyong is doing."
Speaking of which, Cheng Jianyong had been continuously fighting outside for four days.
Yesterday afternoon, they received a system notification.
Cheng Jianyong completed the second layer’s challenge, earning 500 layers of Barbaric God inheritance marks.
Now, he was in the third layer challenge.
And this was the toughest layer.
With a thousand steps in total.
And each step represents a battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 878 466: Challenging the Difficult Trial
paragraphs: When everyone came out.
They already saw Cheng Jianyong fighting a winged giant wolf.
Cheng Jianyong shouted loudly.
"Hahaha! Little wolf cub, still want to catch your master, no way!"
At this moment, the giant wolf also possessed high-tier legendary level strength, yet Cheng Jianyong was playing with it single-handedly.
It felt extremely angry.
"Roar!!"
After an angry roar, the giant wolf charged fiercely at Cheng Jianyong.
And just at this moment, Cheng Jianyong seized the opportunity and suddenly stopped.
Then, he instantly swung the stone pillar, slamming it fiercely.
"Bang!"
The body of the winged giant wolf was directly sent flying, the sound of bones breaking continuously ringing out.
"Awoo..."
The giant wolf fell to the ground, letting out a miserable howl.
And just then, a figure descended from the sky.
"Heaven and Earth Destruction!"
Cheng Jianyong, holding the pillar, directly smashed it heavily.
Puff!
After the sound of flesh bursting.
The body of the giant wolf was directly smashed into pieces.
Looking at his high-spirited war intent, everyone felt relieved.
At least, Cheng Jianyong now showed full vitality.
Time flew by, and two days had passed.
In these two days, Cheng Jianyong never stopped.
Cheng Jianyong rushed through more than three hundred floors again.
At this point, almost every floor required a battle with at least a legendary level creature.
Moreover, a new condition was added to the trial.
That is, the duration of each battle cannot exceed twenty minutes.
Although the rest time in between has been extended, it is only one minute.
Even though Cheng Jianyong is full of energy, the intense battles have left him with nothing but irritation.
It's been six days since the trial started,
Continuous six days of battle have consumed a large amount of Cheng Jianyong's energy.
Everyone's face showed worry.
Shen Yun asked in the chat channel, "Xiaoyongzi, how do you feel? There's still over six hundred floors left."
"You need to defeat at least six hundred more legend, can you sustain it?"
Cheng Jianyong complained secretly but still pretended to be nonchalant, "No big deal."
"Xiaoyunzi, just watch and see!"
"I want to become the strongest warrior!"
"Watch how I climb step by step to the highest point!"
"At that time, whatever demigod, whatever divine spirit, I'll smash them all!"
After saying that, Cheng Jianyong stepped onto the higher level without hesitation.
[Inheritance Trial, Third Floor, 373rd Challenge has started, this challenge is limited to: 20 minutes...]
In front, a group of vicious stitched monsters appeared.
"Kill!"
Cheng Jianyong entered the combat state once more.
Two more days passed.
Cheng Jianyong fought from the 373rd floor to the 627th floor!
Two days, over two hundred battles.
And all against opponents of at least middle-tier legendary level.
Although Cheng Jianyong is a top-notch legend and full of energy.
Some things, however, require time to rest and recover.
Everyone clearly felt Cheng Jianyong's movements becoming sluggish.
However, in front of him, there are still over three hundred steps.
Han Xing said at this point, "Cheng Jianyong, if you can't keep going, stop here."
"This trial is a bit abnormal."
Han Xing was right, this trial involves over a thousand high-intensity battles.
The opponents later on weren't just legends; many times, it was one high-tier legend, bringing two middle-tier legends for an ambush.
If Cheng Jianyong was at full strength, these monsters certainly wouldn't pose any threat to him.
But now, he's almost exhausted his physical strength.
Even Han Xing's words couldn't distract him to respond.
After spending about 8 minutes.
Cheng Jianyong forced himself to take a breath and resolved his opponent.
He finally rested a while at the spot.
Then, Cheng Jianyong turned to everyone and showed a smile, "Don't worry, Brother Xing, I'm still holding strong."
"This is far from my limit, I can still endure."
He spoke lightly.
However, his teammates could see a trace of reluctance in his smile.
Han Xing did not continue talking,
He knew this was Cheng Jianyong's choice.
[Inheritance Trial, Third Floor, 628th Challenge has started, this challenge is limited to: 20 minutes...]
After the prompt ended, Cheng Jianyong resolutely stepped onto the next level.
Two more days passed.
Cheng Jianyong finally climbed to the 900th step of the third floor.
Only the last 100 steps remain!
Up to now, he has fought continuously for ten days.
The high-intensity battles and life-and-death crises he has experienced even exceed the total in his lifetime!
It can be imagined, Cheng Jianyong's attention and reaction capabilities are now in a taut state.
Relying solely on the last bit of willpower to persist.
However, this state is the most dangerous.
If this string breaks, he may end up dying on the spot.
On the 900th floor, two high-tier legendary level fierce beasts have appeared.
Han Xing has a premonition, the remaining 100 floors will definitely feature demigod level creatures.
Sure enough, when Cheng Jianyong stepped onto the 901st step.
Above appeared a Minotaur monster covered in solid muscle, holding a trident.
[Divine Creation·Ancient Divine Bull Stitched Creature: Initial-tier Demigod]
[Level: 61]
[Attributes: Power 82313, Agility 78231, Spirit 76592, Constitution 79231]
[Skills: Stitched Body, Life Source, Power Burst, Power Domain, Ultimate Skill - Sky Piercing Spear!]
[Divine Power Value: 0]
The initial-tier demigod stitched creature, although its attributes are weaker than Cheng Jianyong's by a margin.

chapters.title: Chapter 879 466: Arduous Trial Challenge (Part 2)
paragraphs: But it possesses incredibly terrifying destructive power, along with an ultimate skill.
Cheng Jianyong had been through numerous battles, and his state was far from its peak.
"Hmph..."
The Ancient Divine Bull hybrid snorted out a burst of hot air.
In an instant!
Like a volcanic eruption, it charged fiercely at Cheng Jianyong.
The terrifying aura erupted instantly, even making the onlookers tense up.
"Hey! Little Minotaur!"
Cheng Jianyong still wore a strained smile on his face.
He took a deep breath and wielded the molten rock pillar in his hand, clashing with the minotaur's spear.
"Bang!"
After a dull collision sound.
Before this, opponents with attributes inferior to Cheng Jianyong would be directly knocked away by him.
However, this time, the minotaur still stood firm.
Cheng Jianyong frowned.
He clearly felt that his power had weakened...
"Damn it!"
Although slightly frustrated, Cheng Jianyong did not lose heart.
Instead, he continued to wield the stone pillar, engaging in a direct melee with the minotaur!
After a full ten minutes of close combat, Cheng Jianyong barely managed to kill the opponent.
Killing a demigod-level monster with a legendary creature is already a terrifying feat.
But for Cheng Jianyong, equipped with divine artifacts and such formidable attributes, it was a tough battle.
This fell far below everyone's expectations.
The team members frowned.
"This can't go on..."
Shen Yun said worriedly, "So far, we've already encountered demigod-level monsters."
"The intensity of battles in the remaining 99 levels is unlikely to be any lower than this."
"This trial is a bit too monstrous..."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Shen Yun continued in the team channel, "Xiaoyongzi, come back. There's no shame in giving up now; you've already done well.
However, at this moment, Cheng Jianyong did not reply and was still full of determination,
stepping firmly onto the 902nd level after a brief rest.
Then, a creature that was a combination of a crocodile and a snake appeared.
Its body, over a thousand meters long, was covered with spike-like scales, like a prehistoric behemoth awakening.
Not to mention the demigod-level combat power of this monster, its mere appearance gave a strong sense of oppression!
Once again, both sides engaged in close combat.
In this battle.
Cheng Jianyong's body was entangled by the crocosnake, and the sound of bones cracking even emerged.
Through the energy barrier, everyone could feel the terrifying strength.
If it were an ordinary high-tier legend, they wouldn't last a second and would be strangled by this crocosnake!
However, Cheng Jianyong's face was still flushed red, one hand clenched around the crocosnake's head, the other hand raised the molten rock pillar high.
Allowing this giant snake to tightly coil around his body.
Cheng Jianyong took a deep breath, grabbing the crocosnake's crocodile head with a solid grip.
His right hand directly thrust into its eye socket.
"Gurgle, gurgle!"
A sound that made one's scalp tingle echoed.
The giant snake roared in pain, its binding body loosening its grip slightly.
Cheng Jianyong also realized this was his chance to turn the tables.
Disregarding his injuries, he lifted the molten rock pillar and smashed it down fiercely.
"Die for me!"
Bang!
After a solid thud,
the crocodile head of the giant snake was smashed into a pulpy mess.
"Boom!"
The massive body of the snake collapsed, then turned into light particles and disappeared.
Cheng Jianyong lay on the ground, gasping for breath.
Shen Yun forced a smile on his stern face, "Xiaoyongzi, how many bones are broken? Can you still hold on?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong flipped up from the ground with a roll, "Who are you underestimating? Just a few ribs, watch me recover them immediately!"
After speaking, Cheng Jianyong took a deep breath and began mobilizing the power within his body.
"Crack! Crack!"
The sound of bones cracking echoed, and Cheng Jianyong's sunken chest gradually swelled.
This is the physical quality and terrifying recovery ability of a top-tier legend.
As long as he isn't killed instantly, he can recover.
However, this recovery is not without cost.
It consumes his life force.
In other words, it's his lifespan.
Nevertheless, Cheng Jianyong didn't care at all.
After pulling himself together, he continued his arduous battle.
[Trial of Succession, third floor 903rd challenge now open, time limit for this challenge: 20 minutes...]
After nearly 17 hours of fighting.
Cheng Jianyong climbed to the 950th level.
The monster's strength hadn't increased.
Still the initial-tier demigod.
However, the time Cheng Jianyong took for each battle grew longer and longer.
To the extent that each battle dragged on till the last minute to resolve.
He had to fight while using any spare time to recover from injuries as much as possible.
Otherwise, the mere 60 seconds of mid-combat rest time wouldn't allow him to recover fully.
Until the 960th level.
Cheng Jianyong encountered a creature entirely covered with spikes, a stitched monstrosity.
It was like a spiky ball, rolling rapidly across the staircase battlefield.
The speed was so fast it was hard to capture.
And it would occasionally erupt spikes from its body, attacking Cheng Jianyong's vital spots.
Several times, Cheng Jianyong, due to decreased reflexes, ended up with several bloody holes on his body.
The onlookers were extremely anxious watching this.
Seeing the battle time was about to end.
And just then, the spiky monster suddenly leapt, pouncing at Cheng Jianyong in an instant.
Cheng Jianyong, for some unknown reason, did not dodge.
He was instantly pierced by the spiky monster's attack, with dozens of bone spikes penetrating through him front to back.

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - 466: Difficult Trial Challenge_3
paragraphs: At that moment, Han Xing almost couldn’t resist stepping in to save him.
However, Cheng Jianyong managed to find an opportunity to counterattack while the opponent pierced through his body.
He grabbed the opponent’s spikes and broke them one by one.
Pulling out the monster’s true form from within.
It was a creature with a smooth, glistening body resembling a monster infant.
Covered with viscous fluid, it looked extremely ugly.
Without hesitation, Cheng Jianyong smashed it with a stick.
"Poof!"
A puddle of blood foam appeared on the ground.
The challenge of the 960th layer ended.
Although he won the victory.
The situation became increasingly unfavorable.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong had almost exhausted all of his trump cards.
Only [Divine Demon Swordsmanship: Storm Style] and [Divine Ghost Swordsmanship: Sword Qi Cross] remained unused.
These were his last two Burst Skills.
Unless absolutely necessary, Cheng Jianyong wouldn’t use them.
Looking at Cheng Jianyong lying in a pool of blood, struggling to mobilize his Life Force to heal his injuries.
A trace of unwillingness appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Shen Yun said in the team channel, "Xiaoyongzi, that’s enough, are you really planning to risk your life for a trial?"
"Don’t you know your own limits?"
However, Cheng Jianyong, after barely recovering some strength, weakly said, "Don’t call me, I said I’d take down this Supreme Hidden Profession, and I will!"
"Even if the King of Heaven comes, nothing can stop me!"
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun sighed.
Each battle only allowed for 60 seconds of recovery time.
And being injured repeatedly, then recovering, meant overextending Life Force.
Cheng Jianyong grew weaker,
After another three hours,
Cheng Jianyong had fought his way to the 970th layer.
Even the others didn’t expect Cheng Jianyong to hold on for so long.
He continued to bite his teeth and challenge.
Three hours later, he cleared the 980th layer.
Only 20 layers left!
In the last battle, Cheng Jianyong encountered a mantis insect sewn monster.
This monster had sharp scythes that could even cut through the Void.
During the confrontation,
the mantis’ scythes grazed Cheng Jianyong’s cheek, almost slicing his head off.
At that moment, Han Xing had already prepared to intervene.
Fortunately, Cheng Jianyong retreated half a step at the last moment.
Avoiding a critical injury.
And seizing the opportunity, he closed in and finished off the mantis monster.
Once again, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Every subsequent battle kept them on the edge of their seats.
As if Cheng Jianyong could be killed by the enemy at any moment.
Han Xing then looked at the God of Radiance beside him and said, "Radiance, the Demigod-level battles are too fast, I might not be able to react in time."
"I need you to maintain full attention, and intervene without hesitation if he faces life-threatening danger."
The seriousness in Han Xing’s tone was clear.
The God of Radiance solemnly nodded.
He approached the third layer area, focusing his Divine Power in his head.
His two eyes burned like the sun, dazzlingly bright.
The God of Radiance stood ready to act at any moment.
Yet even so, it wasn’t safe.
As mentioned before, Demigod-level battles were really fast.
Moreover, it was close-quarters melee combat.
If not careful, either side could kill the other.
One could say that above the 900th layer, Cheng Jianyong was essentially walking a tightrope.
Finally, Cheng Jianyong directly fought his way to the 990th layer.
At this stage, no one tried to persuade him anymore.
Only the last 10 layers remained.
They knew, with Cheng Jianyong’s character, even if it meant death, he wouldn’t give up.
After a brief rest, he stepped decisively into the 991st layer.
Here, he encountered a middle-tier Demigod-level monster.
[Divine Creation - Flying Bird Sewn Together (Winged Dragon, Electric Eagle, Omaya)]
[Level: 66 (Middle-tier Demigod Level)]
[Attributes: Power 123215, Agility 113243, Spirit 124321, Constitution 136727]
[Skills: Three Spirits’ Assault, Master of Hundred Schools, Celestial Eagle Strike, Sky Dominator, Ultimate Skill - Covering the Sky and Sun]
[Divine Power Value: 0]
Middle-tier Demigod-level creature!
This was the strongest opponent he had encountered.
Cheng Jianyong felt a pressure engulf him.
He knew his physical condition wouldn’t allow for prolonged battles any longer.
Thus, Cheng Jianyong decided to stick to his old strategy.
Trading injury for injury, aiming for maximum damage.
"Shriek!!!"
The flying bird sewn creature struck like lightning.
While Cheng Jianyong advanced instead of retreating, rushing to the bird fusion creature’s front in an instant.
Seeing this, everyone tensed up.
Han Xing said while standing by, "Radiance, be ready to intervene anytime!"
"Understood, Master."
The God of Radiance stood prepared.
Swish!
In an instant, both parties collided.
Then a terrifying wave of energy burst forth.
Touch and separate.
The next moment, blood splattered from both of their bodies simultaneously.
Seeing this, everyone frowned.
Because they couldn’t tell which side won this exchange.
But when they saw the sewn bird monster’s head showing cracks, they already guessed.
Ultimately, Cheng Jianyong won the victory.
Of course, he didn’t come out unscathed.
Cheng Jianyong’s belly also had a gash, bleeding incessantly.
Everyone even saw the internal organs inside.
This time the injuries were too serious, Cheng Jianyong took over twenty seconds to barely stop the bleeding.
In the team, Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng leaned on each other, holding each other’s hands.
They both felt a surge of tension, even sweat gathering in their palms.
The situation grew more intense.
At this moment, while Cheng Jianyong was recovering, he suddenly heard a system prompt.
[Trial of Barbaric God Inheritance, Third Layer, the 993rd challenge is about to start, time limit: 20 minutes.]

Although he won the victory.
The situation became increasingly unfavorable.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong had almost exhausted all of his trump cards.
Only [Divine Demon Swordsmanship: Storm Style] and [Divine Ghost Swordsmanship: Sword Qi Cross] remained unused.
These were his last two Burst Skills.
Unless absolutely necessary, Cheng Jianyong wouldn’t use them.
Looking at Cheng Jianyong lying in a pool of blood, struggling to mobilize his Life Force to heal his injuries.
A trace of unwillingness appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Shen Yun said in the team channel, "Xiaoyongzi, that’s enough, are you really planning to risk your life for a trial?"
"Don’t you know your own limits?"
However, Cheng Jianyong, after barely recovering some strength, weakly said, "Don’t call me, I said I’d take down this Supreme Hidden Profession, and I will!"
"Even if the King of Heaven comes, nothing can stop me!"
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun sighed.
Each battle only allowed for 60 seconds of recovery time.
And being injured repeatedly, then recovering, meant overextending Life Force.
Cheng Jianyong grew weaker,
After another three hours,
Cheng Jianyong had fought his way to the 970th layer.
Even the others didn’t expect Cheng Jianyong to hold on for so long.
He continued to bite his teeth and challenge.
Three hours later, he cleared the 980th layer.
Only 20 layers left!
In the last battle, Cheng Jianyong encountered a mantis insect sewn monster.
This monster had sharp scythes that could even cut through the Void.
During the confrontation,
the mantis’ scythes grazed Cheng Jianyong’s cheek, almost slicing his head off.
At that moment, Han Xing had already prepared to intervene.
Fortunately, Cheng Jianyong retreated half a step at the last moment.
Avoiding a critical injury.
And seizing the opportunity, he closed in and finished off the mantis monster.
Once again, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Every subsequent battle kept them on the edge of their seats.
As if Cheng Jianyong could be killed by the enemy at any moment.
Han Xing then looked at the God of Radiance beside him and said, "Radiance, the Demigod-level battles are too fast, I might not be able to react in time."
"I need you to maintain full attention, and intervene without hesitation if he faces life-threatening danger."
The seriousness in Han Xing’s tone was clear.
The God of Radiance solemnly nodded.
He approached the third layer area, focusing his Divine Power in his head.
His two eyes burned like the sun, dazzlingly bright.
The God of Radiance stood ready to act at any moment.
Yet even so, it wasn’t safe.
As mentioned before, Demigod-level battles were really fast.
Moreover, it was close-quarters melee combat.
If not careful, either side could kill the other.
One could say that above the 900th layer, Cheng Jianyong was essentially walking a tightrope.
Finally, Cheng Jianyong directly fought his way to the 990th layer.
At this stage, no one tried to persuade him anymore.
Only the last 10 layers remained.
They knew, with Cheng Jianyong’s character, even if it meant death, he wouldn’t give up.
After a brief rest, he stepped decisively into the 991st layer.
Here, he encountered a middle-tier Demigod-level monster.
[Divine Creation - Flying Bird Sewn Together (Winged Dragon, Electric Eagle, Omaya)]
[Level: 66 (Middle-tier Demigod Level)]
[Attributes: Power 123215, Agility 113243, Spirit 124321, Constitution 136727]
[Skills: Three Spirits’ Assault, Master of Hundred Schools, Celestial Eagle Strike, Sky Dominator, Ultimate Skill - Covering the Sky and Sun]
[Divine Power Value: 0]
Middle-tier Demigod-level creature!
This was the strongest opponent he had encountered.
Cheng Jianyong felt a pressure engulf him.
He knew his physical condition wouldn’t allow for prolonged battles any longer.
Thus, Cheng Jianyong decided to stick to his old strategy.
Trading injury for injury, aiming for maximum damage.
"Shriek!!!"
The flying bird sewn creature struck like lightning.
While Cheng Jianyong advanced instead of retreating, rushing to the bird fusion creature’s front in an instant.
Seeing this, everyone tensed up.
Han Xing said while standing by, "Radiance, be ready to intervene anytime!"
"Understood, Master."
The God of Radiance stood prepared.
Swish!
In an instant, both parties collided.
Then a terrifying wave of energy burst forth.
Touch and separate.
The next moment, blood splattered from both of their bodies simultaneously.
Seeing this, everyone frowned.
Because they couldn’t tell which side won this exchange.
But when they saw the sewn bird monster’s head showing cracks, they already guessed.
Ultimately, Cheng Jianyong won the victory.
Of course, he didn’t come out unscathed.
Cheng Jianyong’s belly also had a gash, bleeding incessantly.
Everyone even saw the internal organs inside.
This time the injuries were too serious, Cheng Jianyong took over twenty seconds to barely stop the bleeding.
In the team, Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng leaned on each other, holding each other’s hands.
They both felt a surge of tension, even sweat gathering in their palms.
The situation grew more intense.
At this moment, while Cheng Jianyong was recovering, he suddenly heard a system prompt.
[Trial of Barbaric God Inheritance, Third Layer, the 993rd challenge is about to start, time limit: 20 minutes.]

chapters.title: Chapter 881 - 467: Awakening the Heart of the Fighting God
paragraphs: He raised his head.
At this moment, everyone saw that the madness and determination initially in Cheng Jianyong’s eyes were gone.
On the contrary, he now appeared incomparably calm.
He clearly knew what he was doing.
He also understood the state he needed to be in to survive the upcoming battle and claim victory.
Shen Yun said at this moment, "Brother Xing, have you noticed that Xiaoyongzi seems to have undergone some changes?"
Han Xing nodded, "I have noticed, but I can’t quite put it into words, what specific changes."
Simultaneously, the God of Radiance, whose eyes were radiant like the sun, showed a hint of surprise.
"Master, your friend is quite interesting... He seems to have entered an awakening state called the Heart of the Fighting God."
"Heart of the Fighting God awakening state?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes."
"Throughout history, only Gods of War and Gods of Destruction who emerged from fierce battles have a chance of awakening into such a state."
"From your friend, I see the same eyes as those divine spirits."
Han Xing asked, "Will this state have any impact on him?"
The God of Radiance replied, "It won’t have any adverse effect; on the contrary, it will greatly enhance his potential."
"You must understand, every divine spirit controls different rules, so their expertise varies."
"And those truly possessing the strongest combat power are those who have awakened the Heart of the Fighting God among the divine spirits."
"Among the gods, they are extremely formidable and highly aggressive."
"Given time, they have a significant chance to break through to become a True God."
"However, the prerequisite is that your friend manages to successfully complete his transformation without perishing midway."
Han Xing was thoughtful.
The God of Radiance continued, "Thousands of high-intensity battles have already forced his spirit to its limits time and again."
"He managed to persist at this level by relentlessly tapping into all his potential."
"However, when potential is exhausted, it starts to overdraw future potential and even life force."
"Hence, the upcoming battle is crucial for him."
"If he emerges as the final victor, he might fully awaken the Heart of the Fighter and stand among the top gods in future breakthroughs."
"If he loses the next battle, even if he survives, he might fall into despair, becoming utterly useless.
Upon hearing the God of Radiance’s explanation, everyone tensed up again.
Because this meant Cheng Jianyong could only win the upcoming battle, he absolutely must not fail.
Once he fails, even if the God of Radiance saves him, Cheng Jianyong would likely lose all combat ability.
Under everyone’s tense gaze.
Cheng Jianyong has already stepped into the 993rd challenge.
Just as the God of Radiance mentioned.
He has now entered a wondrous transformation state.
He ignored everything around him—sounds, energy, scenes...
In front of him, only his opponent remained.
A creature with hundreds of arms, all ghastly white, resembling a millipede.
Every opened palm revealed a tortured human face,
they continuously emitted wail-like cries of vengeful spirits.
[Divine Creation - Hybrid Stitched Body (Human, Centipede, Skeleton Creature)]
[Level: 66 (Middle-tier Demigod)]
[Attributes: Power 152394, Agility 134523, Spirit 153321, Constitution 163323]
[Skills: Night Parade of Hundred Demons, Rapid Healing, Skeleton Body, Ten Thousand Souls’ Resentment, Ultimate Skill—Hell’s Wail]
[Divine Power Value: 0]
At this moment, seeing Cheng Jianyong, those faces on the palms simultaneously released cries of pain.
"Pain... I’m in so much pain!"
"Help me... help me..."
"Hehehe! Come accompany us~"
These voices seemed to ring in his ears, continuously drilling into Cheng Jianyong’s mind.
Normally, even legends or demigods would be affected by this mental attack.
However, Cheng Jianyong’s heart remained calm.
He even felt no pain from his body.
At this moment, the millipede with human faces swiftly crawled from the ground toward him.
Rustle, rustle, rustle...
The sight of hundreds of arms crawling on the ground looked extremely eerie.
And just as this creature was about to get close to Cheng Jianyong, its upper torso suddenly stood up, pouncing fiercely toward him.
The kilometer-long body now came down like a towering mountain.
"Whew..."
Cheng Jianyong took a deep breath.
His brain was already in a hyper-speed state.
At the moment when the millipede’s attack came, Cheng Jianyong suddenly realized the opponent’s attack seemed so slow.
He even rapidly analyzed in his mind the attack trajectory of each leg and how to evade them with minimal physical strength consumption.
Before the millipede’s massive body compressed Cheng Jianyong.
He moved.
He retrieved the Magma Pillar in his hand, replacing it with a longsword that appeared again.
"Swish!"
The longsword sliced through.
Dozens of arms on the millipede were severed in an instant.
It couldn’t help but open its mouth in a painful cry.
And at this moment.
Cheng Jianyong’s figure flickered and appeared in front of it.
Seizing the moment its mouth opened, the longsword directly pierced out.
"Pfft!"
The battle ended.
Since he stepped onto the third layer, this was the quickest and easiest battle he experienced.
The Cheng Jianyong in this state was truly strong.
Everyone remained silent in the team channel, fearing they might disturb him.
The God of Radiance beside them grew more delighted with each observation.
The God of Radiance gleefully expressed, "His adaptability is truly terrifying!"

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - 467: Awakening the Heart of the Fighting God (2)
paragraphs: "So soon you’ve adapted to the war rhythm under the state of the War God’s heart."
"At this rate, perhaps you really might complete the thousand-layer challenge."
Just as the God of Radiance predicted.
The battles Cheng Jianyong faced next continued like this, advancing triumphantly.
Then, he pressed forward fearlessly.
In less than 20 minutes, he had cleared from the 994th layer to the 998th layer.
Now, with only two final battles left, he would complete the last challenge.
The system prompt appeared.
[Barbaric God’s inheritance trial, third layer, 999th layer challenge starting soon, time limit: 20 minutes.]
After a brief rest, Cheng Jianyong resolutely stepped into the next level.
Here appeared a creature, towering over three thousand meters, with bear-like robust limbs, but a head shaped like a sharp point.
This monster, Han Xing seemed to recognize.
Inside the Barbaric God’s palace.
One of those collapsed stone pillars had a picture engraved of this fierce beast.
At the same time, this monster’s attributes appeared before Cheng Jianyong.
[Divine Creation: Hybrid Sewn-up Body (Behemoth, Bear, Blue Eagle)]
[Level: 69 (High-tier Demigod)]
[Attributes: Power 352315, agility 302134, spirit 312351, constitution 362891]
[Skills: Ancient Power, Cry of the Blue Eagle, Dragon Swallowing...]
[Divine Power Value: 0]
This trial finally saw the emergence of a high-tier demigod level creature.
For Cheng Jianyong, it was akin to surpassing a great battle tier.
Just the basic attributes alone are nearly four to five times Cheng Jianyong’s.
The gap was immense.
Yet, in that state, Cheng Jianyong did not feel daunted even by a high-tier demigod.
Instead, his eyes gleamed with intense war intent.
"High-tier demigod, huh?"
"This is the first time I’ve faced a creature this powerful alone!"
Cheng Jianyong licked his lips.
"Let me see your power!"
The next moment.
The terrifying sewn giant beast was already charging towards Cheng Jianyong.
Thud! Thud thud!
Its robust giant legs, with every step, caused a movement akin to an earthquake.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong entered the state of [Divine Ghost Swordsmanship: Sword Qi Cross].
With only the last two layers of challenges left, there was no need to hold back anything.
As he raised his longsword, thousands of sword qi converged around him.
Simultaneously, the terrifying giant beast lunged at this moment.
Cheng Jianyong directly swung his sword.
Instantly, all the sword qi slashed towards this hybrid giant beast.
"Clang clang clang!"
A burst of metal clashing sounds occurred.
Yet, it failed to cause any harm to this giant beast.
Nevertheless, Cheng Jianyong was not discouraged.
"Roar!"
These sewn monsters are undoubtedly composed of the strongest parts of those creatures, master of hundred schools.
One could say they have no weaknesses.
At this point, the only option is to engage in frontal combat.
There’s no other clever trick to employ.
Cheng Jianyong raised his longsword, battling the giant beast neck and neck.
The movements of both sides were so fast they left afterimages behind.
"Slash slash slash!"
"Clang clang clang!"
Sword qi crisscrossed.
The sound of metal intersecting continually echoed.
The beast’s paws struck thousands of times in a flash.
Shen Yun and Su Xiaoyang on the field couldn’t even keep up with Cheng Jianyong’s movements.
Within moments, they had already exchanged over ten thousand blows.
Han Xing and the God of Radiance watched intently, afraid to miss any action.
The tense battle atmosphere left everyone almost breathless.
One minute later.
The God of Radiance said, "The result is determined."
In the bewildered gaze of the onlookers,
The suffocating battlefield finally paused briefly.
Boom!
Man and beast simultaneously fell from the sky, then halted in their tracks.
Cheng Jianyong exhaled heavily.
"Hoo...
Next, the giant beast’s body revealed dense blood marks.
Pff!!
Thousands of blood columns shot up.
The body of the giant beast collapsed like a massive mountain, instantly shattering into thousands of pieces.
"Cough... cough..."
Cheng Jianyong spat out a mouthful of fresh blood explosively.
In the just-ended battle, he hadn’t escaped unscathed.
His body enduring multiple powerful punches from the giant beast.
Many bones in his body fractured.
However, in that state, he didn’t feel pain.
Instead, he quietly mobilized his life force within, healing the injuries.
Crack! Crack!
The sound of bones mending resonated.
seconds later, the system prompt appeared again.
[Barbaric God’s inheritance trial, third layer, 1000th challenge starting soon, time limit: 20 minutes.]
The crowd couldn’t help but become invigorated.
Finally, at the last layer?
They all thought Cheng Jianyong couldn’t endure this far.
Yet, he truly completed it, simply unbelievable!
The challenge of the 1000th layer was also a high-tier demigod.
Cheng Jianyong reserved his final trump card just for this final moment.
When the sewn beast with dragon, saber-toothed tiger, and butterfly genes appeared.
Cheng Jianyong directly unleashed [Divine Demon Swordsmanship: Storm Style]
A massive sword array enveloped the entire battlefield completely.
"Slash! Slash slash slash!"
Thousands of sword qi sliced through.
Even though the high-tier demigod creature desperately dodged.
Yet in the ’Heart of the Fighting God’ state, every strike by Cheng Jianyong was fast and precise.
Clearly, Cheng Jianyong concluded the final battle without danger.
The system prompt appeared.
[The challenger has completed all challenges of the Barbaric God’s inheritance trial, congratulations! You now possess the qualification to inherit the Barbaric God’s power!]
[Will you now inherit the Barbaric God’s power and become the Supreme Hidden Profession: Barbaric War God?]

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - 467: Awakening the Heart of the Fighting God (Part 3)
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong turned around and flashed a victory sign to everyone.
Han Xing gave him a thumbs up.
Clearly, his performance this time completely exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Even the God of Radiance hadn’t expected him to awaken the ’Heart of the Fighting God’.
Shen Yun laughed in the team channel, "I underestimated you, Xiaoyongzi."
"You’re a bit stronger than I expected."
"But don’t get too cocky, it’s just a bit more."
Cheng Jianyong sneered and said, "If you say so, then it is."
"I won’t argue with you because soon, I’m about to break through to Demigod, hahaha!"
"Xiaoyunzi, aren’t you envious?"
"The second in Blue Star human history to break through to Demigod is me, Cheng Jianyong!"
"In the future, for thousands of years, they will remember my name, hahaha!"
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong looked extremely arrogant and excited.
Shen Yun rolled his eyes at him, "Bragging, just breaking through to Demigod, look at you."
Despite the words, everyone felt relieved when they saw Cheng Jianyong had recovered his state.
Han Xing then said, "Xiaoyongzi, hurry up and break through here."
"Alright, Brother Xing."
Just as Cheng Jianyong was about to click to confirm acceptance of the legacy.
A system prompt appeared.
[Detected challenger, Barbaric God’s legacy mark has reached level 1000, the final legacy trial can be initiated, would you like to initiate it?]
This prompt could be seen by everyone.
Everyone had a puzzled expression.
"Final trial?"
"How is there another one?"
The team members were confused.
Cheng Jianyong directly asked, "What is the final legacy trial, what if I don’t initiate it, what happens after?
[The final legacy trial is the last stage trial, choosing not to initiate the final trial will not affect you, you can still receive the Barbaric God’s power legacy.]
[If the challenger chooses to initiate the final trial, you will be transported inside the palace for the final battle.]
[Upon completing the trial, you will receive the Barbaric God’s gift: Immortal Giant Battleaxe (Holy Artifact)]
[Note: The final trial must be initiated before becoming a Demigod.]
Seeing this prompt, everyone was stunned for a moment.
"Wow... actually giving a Holy Artifact level weapon as a reward!?"
"Did I hear that right?"

It’s known that among everyone present, only Han Xing had three pieces of Holy Artifact level equipment, none of which could be equipped.
Even Han Xing didn’t have a Holy Artifact level weapon.
Possibly no one expected that this final legacy trial reward was an Holy Artifact Battleaxe.
It can be imagined, once Cheng Jianyong becomes the Supreme Hidden Profession: Barbaric War God.
Coupled with a Holy Artifact level battleaxe, how terrifying his power will be.
But clearly, this final trial is definitely more challenging than the previous thousand-plus trials!
Moreover, it requires Cheng Jianyong to complete it at Legendary Level.
Which means, he can’t wait until he’s received the Barbaric God’s power before taking on this challenge.
And Cheng Jianyong is already seriously injured, with his current state, taking on the challenge could be quite dangerous.
Before Han Xing could speak.
Cheng Jianyong directly said, "Brother Xing, let me go."
"A Holy Artifact level equipment is very powerful, and it’s a weapon, I don’t want to miss it."
Everyone knew how terrifying Holy Artifact level equipment was.
The Dwarf Race and Elf Race each have a piece of Holy Artifact level equipment, which solidified their positions as dominant races.
Only the Giant King didn’t have a Holy Artifact level weapon.
For a Holy Artifact level weapon, the Giant King searched throughout the Holy Spirit Realm, even triggering a war with the Dwarf Race.
However, at this time Han Xing was still somewhat hesitant.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly smiled and said, "Brother Xing, don’t worry about me."
"The previous battle against the Demon God made me realize my own weakness."
"When facing Divine Spirit level entities, we can only watch from the sidelines.
"I, Old Cheng, don’t want it to be like this, I want to fight alongside you!"
"Whether the opponent is a Divine Spirit or a True God."
"Just like I said before, if a True God comes, we’ll face it together, if we can’t stand it, we’ll fall together, what’s the worst that could happen?"
"Therefore, I, Old Cheng, need to be able to fight by your side, not just watch from behind."
"But just inheriting the Supreme Hidden Profession is not enough, if I have a Holy Artifact level battleaxe, I can truly have the power to fight the Divine Level!"
Hearing Cheng Jianyong’s earnest speech.
Everyone understood why he was so determined.
This guy doesn’t want Han Xing to feel such immense pressure.
He’s doing all he can to help bear the burden.
The team members all fell silent.
Including Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, who silently clenched their fists.
They seemed to have made some kind of determination because of Cheng Jianyong’s words.
Suddenly Shen Yun laughed and said, "You brat, suddenly so serious."
"Made me feel a lot of pressure."
"Saying such things, if I, Shen Yun, break through to Demigod, not having the power to challenge the Divine Level would be an embarrassment to Brother Xing, unworthy to fight alongside him."
Cheng Jianyong laughed and said, "That’s of course, by Brother Xing’s side are humanity’s strongest."
"If we’re going to do it, we must do it to the extreme!"
After saying that, everyone fell silent, waiting for Han Xing’s decision.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Go ahead."
Then he smiled and said, "Remember to come back alive."
Cheng Jianyong also laughed, "Don’t worry Brother Xing."
After saying that, he took a deep breath and then looked at the system prompt in front of him.
His gaze gradually became cold.
Cheng Jianyong once again entered the ’Heart of the Fighting God’ state.
Then he directly clicked to continue the challenge.

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - 468: Holy Artifact Battleaxe, Immortal Giant
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong directly clicked on ’Continue Challenge’.
[Barbaric God’s Inheritance Trial, Final Trial has opened...]
In the next moment, Cheng Jianyong’s figure disappeared from his spot.
Just as the system prompt said, he was teleported inside the temple.
It’s the place where Han Xing and others found the [Cauldron of Ten Thousand Spirits].
In the next moment,
An invisible divine power barrier suddenly appeared, completely enveloping the entire temple.
Even the divine power of the God of Radiance couldn’t penetrate through.
Everyone exchanged a glance, unable to sense what was happening inside anymore.
They didn’t know what kind of enemy Cheng Jianyong was facing.
They could only wait quietly.
"Boom boom boom..."
There seemed to be a terrifying battle happening inside the temple.
The violent vibrations could be felt by Han Xing outside.
Everyone frowned once again.
A dozen minutes later.
Cheng Jianyong’s figure reappeared, a look of terror on his face.
Before anyone could speak, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed first.
"What the heck! What the heck! It’s so terrifying!"
"This final challenge is too unreasonable. So many demigods surrounded me, scared me to death!"
"Luckily, Old Cheng kept a trick up his sleeve; the divine-level effect of the weapon hasn’t been used, otherwise I almost didn’t make it."
Hearing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, a joyful expression appeared on their faces.
Because Cheng Jianyong safely emerged, it means he has completed the final challenge.
Of course, in this final challenge, Cheng Jianyong also suffered a certain amount of injuries.
On his body, everyone saw many deep wounds exposing the bone.
And a dozen blood holes penetrating through.
One of them was less than a few centimeters from the heart.
Imagine he went through an extremely terrifying battle inside, even faced death countless times.
While recovering from his injuries, Cheng Jianyong shouted to the sky, "Where’s my reward?
What he wanted, naturally, was the holy artifact-level war axe.
The system prompt appeared.
[Barbaric God’s Inheritance Trial, Final Challenge Completed, Reward Dispensing...]
Meanwhile.
In the endless void, a dazzling white light suddenly burst forth.
The light shone like a diamond, swiftly crossing millions of miles like a meteor rapidly flying.
"Whoosh!"
The void was stirred.
As the meteor approached, everyone saw it was a giant axe reaching over a hundred meters!
The axe handle was entirely crafted from a special blue metal.
While the axe head seemed to be polished from a whole piece of unique stone.
The axe head was overall ink-green, even having some black spots.
However, from this ink-green battleaxe, everyone felt an extremely strong life force.
As the battleaxe swept over their heads, everyone felt their life force stirring— even their hair began to grow.
This goes to show how terrifying the life force of this battleaxe was.
"Axe come!"
Cheng Jianyong shouted, then stretched out his right hand, that giant axe from over a hundred meters gradually shrank to a height of over a meter.
Then he firmly grasped it in his hand.
Before he could feel the power of this holy artifact battleaxe.
A stream of light flew from above once again.
It was a rhombic crystal emitting endless blood energy, so intense that everyone’s blood flowed rapidly.
Even the God of Radiance had a look of shock in his eyes.
"Divine Format!"
"That is the Barbaric God’s Divine Format!"
Everyone looked with enlightened expressions.
Because Cheng Jianyong had completed all trials.
And now, it was time for him to inherit the power of the Barbaric God, to become the supreme hidden profession.
Cheng Jianyong’s ears heard a system prompt,
[Detected survivor has completed all trials of Barbaric God’s Inheritance, meeting breakthrough requirements, detecting other conditions...]
[Level: 60 (met)]
[Profession: Warrior (met)]
[Race: Human Race (met)]
[All advancement conditions met, would you like to absorb the Power of Rules contained within the Barbaric God’s Divine Format, to breakthrough to demigod level creature?]
[Upon breaking through to demigod, you will automatically transfer to supreme hidden profession: Barbaric War God.]
Cheng Jianyong’s mouth curved into a smile.
Does this even need thinking?
He gave it his all specifically for this moment.
Thus, Cheng Jianyong hesitated not at all and clicked ’Yes’.
Crack!
Above, the rhombic crystal containing endless blood energy shattered in an instant.
Then, all that vast blood energy rushed into Cheng Jianyong’s body.
His injuries on the body recovered completely in a split second.
Not only that, under the impact of that blood energy.
Cheng Jianyong’s body seemed to undergo a certain metamorphosis once more.
His height began to increase rapidly, from the original near 1.8 meters, straight up to 2.5 meters, and still growing rapidly.
In no time, he grew to a height of 5 meters.
Meanwhile, his long hair grew like grass, in the blink of an eye dragging to the ground.
Even more terrifyingly, tiny black spots appeared on his pores.
Those tiny black spots were swiftly discharged, making his body renewed.
The breakthrough commotion here even caused the energy within a million-mile radius of this void to fall into turbulence.
At this moment, powerful beings lurking in the void seemed to have sensed something.
Unanimously, they looked towards the place where Han Xing and others were.
However, due to the energy fluctuation being too strong,
Those powerful beings, adhering to the mindset of handling less trouble being better than more, chose to ignore.
