chapters.title: Chapter 885 - 468: Holy Artifact Battleaxe, Immortal Giant_2
paragraphs: A few minutes later.
Cheng Jianyong finally absorbed the divine format of the Barbaric God.
He gradually recovered from the state of transformation.
At the same time, an astounding aura rose from his body.
Everyone present could feel his aura surging rapidly.
From the former pinnacle of legend, he instantly reached the height of the Demigod level, and it continued to rise at an alarming rate.
Until it was about to reach the High-tier Demigod level, it gradually slowed down.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong’s transformation was considered complete.
A system notification appeared.

[Breakthrough complete, you have become a Demigod-level creature, automatically changing profession to the Supreme Hidden Profession: Barbaric Law God, all attributes increased by 300%, divine power value increased by 300%, Rule of Force interface unlocked.]

[You have automatically learned new skills: Ultimate Skill — Barbaric Body (Passive Skill), Ultimate Skill — Undying Body (Passive Skill), Ultimate Skill — Creation of Heaven and Earth, Ultimate Skill — Three Extremes Axe]
After hearing this long prompt, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes showed a look of surprise.
At the same time, a system rang in everyone’s ears.
System Announcement: "All survivors, please note, Survivor Lone Brave has fully advanced through the Sixth Transformation, becoming a new Demigod-level powerhouse among the Blue Star People."
"Let us congratulate this mighty figure for making a great contribution to the rise of the Human Race!"
At this moment, the chat channel was once again in a terrifying uproar.
Dark Souls Enthusiast: "Holy crap! Someone else broke through to Demigod? It hasn’t been long since Qing Meng broke through, right?"
Upper Half of a Cat: "Why do I feel this scene is somewhat familiar?"
Holy Knight Let’s Go: "Agreed! It was the same when the Star Gods broke through to Legend, one after another."
The survivors seemed to have a premonition of what was to happen next.
A survivor named Loves Cilantro laughed and said, "Prize guessing time, folks, who do you think will be the next to break through to Demigod?"
"Star God, Yun Tianming, or Clever Little Sheep?"
Now, the few people around Han Xing were well-known among the survivors.
So they all knew that once one of them broke through to a new realm.
The other few would soon follow.
"I bet on Star God! Star God has already allowed his two companions to break through, next is definitely him!"
"I bet on Clever Little Sheep! Last time Star God was the first to break through, but this time there’s been no movement, maybe he’s planning something big."
"Haha, I think Yun Tianming is also very likely!"
"I’m betting on Clever Little Sheep!"
More and more people participated in the guessing.
Tangxin Mumu was the first to catch the trend.
She actively initiated a guessing post on the "All Gods Daily" forum.
And even set up a small prize.
Soon, a large number of survivors flooded into the forum, beginning to vote.
At this moment, including Zhou Huang and Boundless, who heard the system prompt, felt a sense of emotion.
They knew that next, the other three would also begin to break through to Demigod.
The gap would once again widen.
Zhou Huang reported Cheng Jianyong’s breakthrough to Demigod to the mysterious woman.
At this moment, the woman chuckled lightly: "Zhou Huang, there’s nothing to worry about, it’s just a breakthrough to Demigod."
"As I told you, there is a gap even between Demigods."
"An ordinary Demigod is merely an ant in front of a Divine Spirit Level."
"Not to mention, there are even more terrifying True Gods."

After saying this, the woman looked into the void ahead and said, "Next, I will take you to find a True God’s divine format. With it, you can grow to the Divine Realm without being restricted by rules."
"While those people will be suppressed by rules, forever remaining in the Demigod Realm."
Hearing this, Zhou Huang nodded, reigniting a glimmer of hope within.
This was also the condition of his exchange with the woman.
To give her the Human Emperor’s Sword, and the woman would find a True God’s divine format for Zhou Huang.
However, they did not know.
Han Xing is not someone who follows the conventional path.
This time, not only did they break through to more than just ordinary Demigods.
But they also changed profession to the legendary Supreme Hidden Profession.
Although they did not know how strong the Power of Rules of the Elemental God and Barbaric God were.
But according to Zhang Lianmeng’s description, when she broke through to the Divine Realm, she would face no obstacles at all.
That is to say, the Barbaric God and Elemental God are definitely existences above True Gods.
In the void.
Han Xing and others also heard the system prompt, which indicated that Cheng Jianyong had completed his breakthrough.
They gathered around him immediately.
Shen Yun excitedly said, "Xiaoyongzi, how does it feel, quickly tell us!"
Including Han Xing and others, they were very curious.
Cheng Jianyong smiled, first returning from a height of nearly five meters to his normal human appearance.
Then he truthfully shared the changes from his breakthrough to Demigod.
Shen Yun, after reading it, was completely shocked.
"Oh my, truly worthy of being the same Supreme Hidden Profession as Sister Lian Meng, it also increased threefold in attributes and divine power value, isn’t that too terrifying!"
"But, why do you only have four ultimate skills?"
"Sister Lian Meng got seven ultimate skills directly, plus a combined ultimate skill."
However, Cheng Jianyong laughed and said, "You don’t understand, it’s about quality, not quantity."
"Once you see the attributes of these four ultimate skills, you won’t say that."
With that, Cheng Jianyong directly posted the attributes of the four ultimate skills.

[Ultimate Skill — Barbaric Body: After entering combat state, power increases by 100%, and when receiving power-type augmentation effects, the effect is additionally increased by 200% (skills, secret elixirs, equipment effects, etc.).]

This time, not only did they break through to more than just ordinary Demigods.
But they also changed profession to the legendary Supreme Hidden Profession.
Although they did not know how strong the Power of Rules of the Elemental God and Barbaric God were.
But according to Zhang Lianmeng’s description, when she broke through to the Divine Realm, she would face no obstacles at all.
That is to say, the Barbaric God and Elemental God are definitely existences above True Gods.
In the void.
Han Xing and others also heard the system prompt, which indicated that Cheng Jianyong had completed his breakthrough.
They gathered around him immediately.
Shen Yun excitedly said, "Xiaoyongzi, how does it feel, quickly tell us!"
Including Han Xing and others, they were very curious.
Cheng Jianyong smiled, first returning from a height of nearly five meters to his normal human appearance.
Then he truthfully shared the changes from his breakthrough to Demigod.
Shen Yun, after reading it, was completely shocked.
"Oh my, truly worthy of being the same Supreme Hidden Profession as Sister Lian Meng, it also increased threefold in attributes and divine power value, isn’t that too terrifying!"
"But, why do you only have four ultimate skills?"
"Sister Lian Meng got seven ultimate skills directly, plus a combined ultimate skill."
However, Cheng Jianyong laughed and said, "You don’t understand, it’s about quality, not quantity."
"Once you see the attributes of these four ultimate skills, you won’t say that."
With that, Cheng Jianyong directly posted the attributes of the four ultimate skills.

[Ultimate Skill — Barbaric Body: After entering combat state, power increases by 100%, and when receiving power-type augmentation effects, the effect is additionally increased by 200% (skills, secret elixirs, equipment effects, etc.).]

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - 468: Holy Artifact Battleaxe, Immortal Giant_3
paragraphs: [Ultimate Skill—Undying Body: After entering combat state, recovery ability is increased by 100%. When receiving any recovery-type enhancement effects, the effectiveness is further increased by 200% (skills, secret elixirs, equipment effects, etc.).]

[Ultimate Skill—Creation of Heaven and Earth: Gather all power to strike the strongest blow. Deal attack power*8700% damage to all enemies in a fan-shaped area of 10,000 meters in front. This attack ignores 500,000 points of defense, with a cooldown of 1 hour.]

[Ultimate Skill—Three Extremes Axe: Gather all power to mark a target, sealing the opponent’s power of attributes, divine power, and power of rules. Strike the strongest axe blow, dealing 20,000% armor-piercing damage to the enemy!]
"Hiss!!"
After reading the attributes of these four ultimate skills,
everyone took a deep breath.
"It’s terrifying!" Shen Yun couldn’t help but exclaim.
Undoubtedly, the attributes of these four skills are all terrifying.
The first two passive skills, the first being Barbaric Body, greatly increased Cheng Jianyong’s strength.
His current strength attribute was already 320,000, and now it has increased by 100% again, directly reaching a height of 640,000!
What kind of concept is this?
You must know, even for a general high-tier demigod, the average attribute value is around 500,000.
And Cheng Jianyong, having just broken through, directly crushed high-tier demigods with this skill!
Almost reaching the level of top demigods like the Dwarf King.
The second skill significantly enhances recovery ability.
Clearly, this was prepared for him for endurance battles.
If Cheng Jianyong had this skill before the trial, fighting over a thousand battles would be no pressure for him at all.
And the latter two skills are explosive attack-type ultimate skills in terms of damage coefficient.
One group attack, one single target.
They are without weaknesses.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong proudly said, "There’s more, let me show you the attributes of the Holy Artifact Battleaxe I just obtained.
Hearing about the Holy Artifact Battleaxe, everyone expressed great anticipation.
[Immortal Giant]
[Quality: Holy Artifact]
[Attack Power: 71,693~73,252]
[Attribute Bonus: Strength +10,000, Constitution +10,000]
[Attached Effect1: Ultimate Armor Piercing (Ignores 50,000 points of enemy armor when attacking)]

[Attached Effect2: Giant Roar (Legendary Effect, 80% chance to trigger Giant Roar during attacks, causing enemies to enter a stunned state, reducing all attributes by 60%, effective only on beings of the same level)]
[Attached Effect3: Frenzied Giant (Epic Effect, 50% chance to increase attack speed by 100% during attacks, lasting 60 seconds, can stack up to 3 times!)]
[Attached Effect4: Immortal Giant (Divine-level Effect, restores 5% of life value per second after entering combat state.)]

[Attached Effect5: Immortal Heart (Holy Artifact exclusive effect, when facing an unbeatable enemy, can transfer the power of Immortal Giant to you, increasing all attributes by 100 times, lasting 100 seconds, after the duration, the holy artifact permanently breaks)]
After reading the attributes of this equipment, everyone swallowed.
Shen Yun was shocked, "Damn... your axe is just outrageous!"
"Directly ignoring 50,000 of my armor, even my divine artifact shield doesn’t have such high defense."
"And that Frenzied Giant effect, stacking three times is a 300% attack speed bonus, isn’t that too abnormal?"
The more Shen Yun spoke, the more envy flooded his eyes.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "The previous effects are probably not the most abnormal."
"The most abnormal are that divine-level effect and holy artifact-level effect."
Shen Yun also noticed this point.
He seemed to recall something and exclaimed, "What the hell! You seem to have a passive skill Undying Body that increases recovery ability by three times."
"That divine-level effect, restoring 5% of life value per second in combat, plus your passive, wouldn’t that be 20% life value recovery per second?"
"You’re an unkillable little strong!"
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, eyes full of pride.
Clearly, this [Immortal Giant] is matched perfectly with his newly obtained skill.
With 20% life value recovery per second, given Cheng Jianyong’s current constitution of over 300,000, he really can’t die even if he wanted to,
and the last one, the holy artifact-level effect is even more abnormal.
Directly increasing attributes by 100 times, based on Cheng Jianyong’s current attributes, that’s over 30 million in strength!
Han Xing didn’t know what level a million attributes would be.
But 30 million, must be at least true god level.
Of course, the cost is terrifying, which is that after using it, this holy artifact battleaxe directly breaks permanently.
Like Han Xing’s [Supreme Star Country Armor].
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong excitedly held up the war axe in his hand, looked at Shen Yun, and said, "So, Xiaoyunzi, want to practice a bit?"
"I’ll let you hit me for a minute!"
Cheng Jianyong was eager to try, while Shen Yun rolled his eyes, "Get lost, with your recovery ability, I might not be able to kill you even if I hit you for a whole day."
"Hahaha!"
Cheng Jianyong laughed proudly.
Shen Yun looked at Cheng Jianyong, then at Zhang Lianmeng, and a thoughtful expression flashed in his eyes, "Two supreme hidden professions, who knows who’s stronger if they fought."
Upon hearing this, everyone expressed some curiosity.
Han Xing smiled and said, "If not relying on external factors, their winning rate should be evenly split."
"But if Xiaoyongzi has the Holy Artifact Battleaxe, then the battle is not in doubt."
After hearing, Shen Yun’s eyes showed an envious look, "Envy, the boost of supreme hidden professions is too terrifying."
"If I could also change to a supreme hidden profession, that’d be great."
However, he also knows that it’s impossible.
After all, even such ancient divine spirits, there are only four.

chapters.title: Chapter 887 - 469: Zhou Huang Breaks Through to Demigod
paragraphs: Now, the Power of the Elemental God and Barbaric God has already been inherited by them.
As for the other two ancient Divine Spirits, even their names are unknown.
And at this moment, the God of Radiance spoke: "Master, if you only want to inherit Power similar to the Elemental God, I do have a few regions."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing immediately became interested.
"You mean, there are other inheritances similar to that of the Barbaric God?"
The God of Radiance shook his head, "Not exactly, these four ancient Divine Spirits are unique."
"So far, I have not seen a stronger existence than them."
"The place I am speaking of is deeply hidden within the Void."
"There, great dangers exist, along with strong resentment, seemingly formed from the lingering Powers of some terrifying existences after their death, forming a forbidden zone."
"Even Divine Spirits venturing there face the risk of downfall."

Saying this, the God of Radiance paused then continued: "However, I’ve heard that, at the end of the Dark Age, a certain Legend inherited an ancient Power in one of those forbidden zones, gaining terrifying growth in strength."
"He later soared up, forcefully breaking into the Divine Realm, and was absorbed into the Supreme Hall by the Hunters."
"For some unknown reason, this existence then detached himself from the Supreme Hall."
"Since then, no one has seen him again."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing couldn’t help but ask: "Hold on, is the one you are speaking of called Master of War Ghosts?"
The God of Radiance was stunned for a moment, "Ah, so Master, you know this person?"
Han Xing nodded.
The God of Radiance said: "Yes, this existence is indeed the Master of War Ghosts, also one of the most dazzling figures of that era."
Hearing this, Han Xing nodded in realization.
If that’s the case, it means what the God of Radiance said is likely true.
Those forbidden zones harbor extremely ancient Powers, which can allow ordinary Legends to have even more formidable Power when breaking through to be Demigods.
Shen Yun and Su Xiaoyang can go and explore those forbidden zones before their breakthrough.
However, that is a matter for later.
Because next, Han Xing needs to prepare for his breakthrough.
Shen Yun asked: "Brother Xing, where are we going next, should we head directly to the Land of Divine War?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and shook his head, "The next step is to prepare for my own breakthrough.
"But before that, I need to make some preparations."
"Preparation?" Shen Yun questioned.
Han Xing nodded and said: "Yes, before heading to the Land of Divine War, I need to craft a ’Celestial Rail Strike Device’."
Upon hearing this, everyone suddenly understood and nodded.
[Celestial Rail Strike Device], as the highest Level blueprint they have encountered thus far.
The required materials are also the most terrifying.
If it can be crafted, it will greatly assist Han Xing in his upcoming journey.
After all, the Land of Divine War is not a safe place.
Didn’t the Old Tree say?
A High-tier Demigod or lower coming near would surely die.
Therefore, crafting the [Celestial Rail Strike Device] before heading to the Land of Divine War greatly enhances safety.
Han Xing checked the requirements and his materials for crafting the [Celestial Rail Strike Device].

[Materials required for crafting the Celestial Rail Strike Device]: Philosopher’s Stone*50 million, Shimmering Terra Stone*50 million, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*20 million, Calamity Divine Gold*500 thousand, Chaos Divine Stone*200 thousand, Unknown Item: Codename World Will*1.
And his current material reserve is:
[Philosopher’s Stone]*102.47 million
[Shimmering Terra Stone]*31.24 million
[Ancient Elf Secret Ingot]*10.34 million
[Calamity Divine Gold]*560 thousand
[Chaos Divine Stone]*630 thousand
[World Will]*1
Seeing his material reserve, Han Xing’s eyes showed a hint of surprise.
"All other materials are entirely sufficient.
"Now, we only lack the Shimmering Terra Stone and Ancient Elf Secret Ingot, and we can craft the Celestial Rail Strike Device!"
The team members’ eyes also showed joy.
At this time, Shen Yun asked: "Brother Xing, where do we get the materials now that we’re in the Void?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing laughed and said: "Of course, we have to rely on Radiance, don’t you agree?"
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
"Master, you mean to open the Divine Treasure Vault?"
Han Xing nodded and said: "Yes, first take us to find the Light God’s Treasure Vault."
Now, apart from the Light God’s Treasure Vault.
Han Xing also knows the location of two other vaults, which belong to the God of Fertility and the Mother of Life.
The God of Fertility’s vault is in an Anomalous Space Rift, which is temporarily not considered.
While the Mother of Life’s vault, although in the Void, is guarded by a True God.
Moreover, a living True God!
If Han Xing opens her vault, he will definitely be detected by this True God.
By then, if the Mother of Life rushes into the Void to deal with Han Xing, that will be big trouble.
Therefore, Han Xing’s current target is to focus on the already deceased Light God’s Treasure Vault.
The God of Radiance closely senses for a while, then nods and says: "Master, the Light God’s Treasure Vault is still quite a long distance from here."
"If we proceed now, it will take about half a month."
Han Xing pondered for a moment and then nodded.
This time, he can accept.
Spending an extra half month also allows for more preparation.
Han Xing can only hope that the materials in the Light God’s Treasure Vault are enough for him to craft the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
"Let’s go, back to the battleship, next target, Light God’s Treasure Vault."
Han Xing finished speaking, and the figures of the five of them flashed.
Then, they returned to the Divine Demon Battleship.

chapters.title: Chapter 888 - 469: Zhou Huang Breaks Through to Demigod (2)
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Han Xing directly activated the teleportation state.
System notifications appeared.
[Entering teleportation state, countdown five seconds...]
[Five...]
[Four...]
After the familiar voice playback, the countdown reached zero.
The Divine Demon Battleship disappeared from its original location.
"Buzz!"
A few seconds later, the Divine Demon Battleship appeared over ten million kilometers away.
Then, they once again began their long journey forward.
Time slowly passed.
Soon, half a month went by.
At the same time.
In the Holy Spirit Realm.
More and more powerhouses were gathering towards the Elf Realm.
It’s been almost three months since the death of the Demon God’s Terrifying Limbs.
The invasion of the Abyss Realm seemed to have signs of intensifying.
In recent days, according to the news Han Xing received.
In these three months, the Abyss Realm sent another Demon God to invade the Holy Spirit Realm.
But with the hidden powerhouses of major tribes fully mobilized, and with the pressure held by the three tribe monarchs...
Though the Holy Spirit Realm paid some sacrifices, they ultimately killed this Demon God.
This battle instilled confidence and charm in the spirits of the Holy Spirit Realm.
They know that the power they hold can deal with one, even two or three Demon Gods.
The weak Holy Spirit Realm was not without resistance.
High Priest Xiao excitedly shared this news with Han Xing.
And upon hearing it, Han Xing also smiled.
For some reason, upon hearing the news of the Holy Spirit Realm powerhouses jointly slaying the Demon God, Han Xing felt relieved.
Because this meant that even without Han Xing, the Holy Spirit Realm had the strength to protect itself.
Besides this good news, High Priest Xiao delivered another piece of good news.
That is, he has broken through to Demigod.
Since the death of Helas, the Witch Race had no top-tier powerhouse.
Xiao’s breakthrough surely boosted the morale of the Witch Race People.
The Witch Race People on the Witch Race Continent, upon hearing this news, celebrated for several days!
Han Xing also smiled.
This way, he could search for opportunities in the Void with more peace of mind to enhance his own power.
At this moment, the God of Radiance said, "Master, we’re almost there."
"The location in the God of Light’s memory is about half a day’s journey away from here."
Han Xing nodded.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "I wonder if we can gather enough materials to craft the Celestial Rail Strike Device from the God of Light’s treasury this time."
"If not, it might be a bit troublesome."
Everyone realized this and felt a bit worried.
Shen Yun now said, "Don’t worry, the God of Light as an old-time Divine Spirit is still so cunning."
"Surely, he has secretly collected many treasures."
"At least more than the resources in the God of Tricks’ treasury."
Everyone nodded.
Just then, a system notification interrupted everyone’s thoughts.
System announcement: "Attention all Survivors, Survivor Zhou Huang has fully advanced to Sixth Transformation, becoming a new Demigod Level powerhouse among Blue Star People."
"Let’s congratulate this powerhouse for making a great contribution in the rise of the Human Race!"
Upon hearing this system notification, Han Xing and the others felt odd.
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "Zhou Huang, is it him?"
"That kid isn’t dead yet?"
Everyone felt very surprised.
Since last time, when they went to bombard the God of Tricks, Zhou Huang was taken away by that mysterious woman.
Since then, there has been no news of him whatsoever.
Han Xing and the others all thought that Zhou Huang was dead.
Unexpectedly, he not only wasn’t dead, but had grown at a terrifying speed and became a Demigod Level existence.
Shen Yun exclaimed in shock, "This guy, the last time we saw him, he hadn’t even broken through to Legendary yet, how did he get so fast?"
Zhou Huang’s speed of improvement stunned everyone.
Even Han Xing and the others have been at the Legendary Realm for over a year.
And they still haven’t broken through yet.
Yet Zhou Huang had already surpassed them.
After considering for a moment, Han Xing said, "Probably with help from that mysterious woman."
After all, the coordinates of the seven Elemental Divine Formats and the God of Tricks’ treasury were all told to Han Xing by that mysterious woman.
It can be seen that the other party surely possesses some opportunity places.
Han Xing pondered, "That woman surely isn’t so kind."
"I just don’t know what price Zhou Huang paid."
Han Xing and the others know how Zhou Huang broke through to Demigod.
However, the group of Survivors did not know.
They exclaimed in the chat channel, "What the hell! We guessed wrong, the third person to break through to Demigod wasn’t the Star God team, but Zhou Huang!"
"Oh my, Zhou Huang, I haven’t heard that name in a long time, didn’t expect he’s still alive!"
"Yeah, it’s unbelievable, not only is he still alive, he even managed to break through to Demigod before the Star God team."
"Zhou Huang, that guy, is truly a surprise."
The chat channel ignited in violent uproar once again.
"Speaking of which, what exactly is the Demigod realm like?"
Seeing Zhou Huang break through to Demigod, the Survivors couldn’t help but become curious about this realm.
"I don’t know, we haven’t broken through to Demigod, not even to Legendary."
Yes, to date, besides Han Xing and the others, no Survivor has broken through to the Legendary Realm.
At this moment, a Survivor named Shu Jun said, "I don’t know about Demigod Level realm."
"But before, I heard from those Legendary Powerhouses of the Witch Race that any Demigod can easily crush a Legend."

sentences.text: Meanwhile, Han Xing directly activated the teleportation state.
System notifications appeared.
[Entering teleportation state, countdown five seconds...]
[Five...]
[Four...]
After the familiar voice playback, the countdown reached zero.
The Divine Demon Battleship disappeared from its original location.
"Buzz!"
A few seconds later, the Divine Demon Battleship appeared over ten million kilometers away.
Then, they once again began their long journey forward.
Time slowly passed.
Soon, half a month went by.
At the same time.
In the Holy Spirit Realm.
More and more powerhouses were gathering towards the Elf Realm.
It’s been almost three months since the death of the Demon God’s Terrifying Limbs.
The invasion of the Abyss Realm seemed to have signs of intensifying.
In recent days, according to the news Han Xing received.
In these three months, the Abyss Realm sent another Demon God to invade the Holy Spirit Realm.
But with the hidden powerhouses of major tribes fully mobilized, and with the pressure held by the three tribe monarchs...
Though the Holy Spirit Realm paid some sacrifices, they ultimately killed this Demon God.
This battle instilled confidence and charm in the spirits of the Holy Spirit Realm.
They know that the power they hold can deal with one, even two or three Demon Gods.
The weak Holy Spirit Realm was not without resistance.
High Priest Xiao excitedly shared this news with Han Xing.
And upon hearing it, Han Xing also smiled.
For some reason, upon hearing the news of the Holy Spirit Realm powerhouses jointly slaying the Demon God, Han Xing felt relieved.
Because this meant that even without Han Xing, the Holy Spirit Realm had the strength to protect itself.
Besides this good news, High Priest Xiao delivered another piece of good news.
That is, he has broken through to Demigod.
Since the death of Helas, the Witch Race had no top-tier powerhouse.
Xiao’s breakthrough surely boosted the morale of the Witch Race People.
The Witch Race People on the Witch Race Continent, upon hearing this news, celebrated for several days!
Han Xing also smiled.
This way, he could search for opportunities in the Void with more peace of mind to enhance his own power.
At this moment, the God of Radiance said, "Master, we’re almost there."
"The location in the God of Light’s memory is about half a day’s journey away from here."
Han Xing nodded.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "I wonder if we can gather enough materials to craft the Celestial Rail Strike Device from the God of Light’s treasury this time."
"If not, it might be a bit troublesome."
Everyone realized this and felt a bit worried.
Shen Yun now said, "Don’t worry, the God of Light as an old-time Divine Spirit is still so cunning."
"Surely, he has secretly collected many treasures."
"At least more than the resources in the God of Tricks’ treasury."
Everyone nodded.
Just then, a system notification interrupted everyone’s thoughts.
System announcement: "Attention all Survivors, Survivor Zhou Huang has fully advanced to Sixth Transformation, becoming a new Demigod Level powerhouse among Blue Star People."
"Let’s congratulate this powerhouse for making a great contribution in the rise of the Human Race!"
Upon hearing this system notification, Han Xing and the others felt odd.
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "Zhou Huang, is it him?"
"That kid isn’t dead yet?"
Everyone felt very surprised.
Since last time, when they went to bombard the God of Tricks, Zhou Huang was taken away by that mysterious woman.
Since then, there has been no news of him whatsoever.
Han Xing and the others all thought that Zhou Huang was dead.
Unexpectedly, he not only wasn’t dead, but had grown at a terrifying speed and became a Demigod Level existence.
Shen Yun exclaimed in shock, "This guy, the last time we saw him, he hadn’t even broken through to Legendary yet, how did he get so fast?"
Zhou Huang’s speed of improvement stunned everyone.
Even Han Xing and the others have been at the Legendary Realm for over a year.
And they still haven’t broken through yet.
Yet Zhou Huang had already surpassed them.
After considering for a moment, Han Xing said, "Probably with help from that mysterious woman."
After all, the coordinates of the seven Elemental Divine Formats and the God of Tricks’ treasury were all told to Han Xing by that mysterious woman.
It can be seen that the other party surely possesses some opportunity places.
Han Xing pondered, "That woman surely isn’t so kind."
"I just don’t know what price Zhou Huang paid."
Han Xing and the others know how Zhou Huang broke through to Demigod.
However, the group of Survivors did not know.
They exclaimed in the chat channel, "What the hell!
We guessed wrong, the third person to break through to Demigod wasn’t the Star God team, but Zhou Huang!"
"Oh my, Zhou Huang, I haven’t heard that name in a long time, didn’t expect he’s still alive!"
"Yeah, it’s unbelievable, not only is he still alive, he even managed to break through to Demigod before the Star God team."
"Zhou Huang, that guy, is truly a surprise."
The chat channel ignited in violent uproar once again.
"Speaking of which, what exactly is the Demigod realm like?"
Seeing Zhou Huang break through to Demigod, the Survivors couldn’t help but become curious about this realm.
"I don’t know, we haven’t broken through to Demigod, not even to Legendary."
Yes, to date, besides Han Xing and the others, no Survivor has broken through to the Legendary Realm.
At this moment, a Survivor named Shu Jun said, "I don’t know about Demigod Level realm."
"But before, I heard from those Legendary Powerhouses of the Witch Race that any Demigod can easily crush a Legend."

chapters.title: Chapter 889 - 469: Zhou Huang Breaks Through to Demigod (3)
paragraphs: "From what we previously understood about legends, every legend can cause severe harm to our Human Race."
"If it’s a demigod, it’s estimated they could wipe out all of humanity in a very short time..."
Hearing this survivor speak, a faint sense of powerlessness began to rise in the hearts of others.
"Oh my... hearing you say that, demigods really do seem ridiculously powerful."
"If you’re not a legend, you’re just an ant, right?"
"We humans are still too weak in the Holy Spirit Realm."
The atmosphere in the chat channel gradually became a bit gloomy.
At this time, Luo Chan stood up and said, "Everyone, do not lose heart. We must remember, no matter how strong the outsiders are..."
"At least the Star God is on our side."
"Only the Star God is truly helping the Human Race!"
In the chat channel, a survivor named Xiaobaihe asked, "Fairy Luo Chan, we haven’t seen the Star God for a long time."
"What is he doing? Busy breaking through to a demigod?"
Other survivors also asked, "Yes, Fairy Luo Chan, do you know where the Star God went?"
"We haven’t seen the Star God for one or two years."
Luo Chan was silent for a moment, then slowly replied, "The Star God is fighting for the safety of humanity."
"You may not know it, but the Holy Spirit Realm is currently undergoing a terrible invasion event."
"The enemy is too powerful, even the world itself is at risk of destruction!"
"By then, our Human Race, the Witch Race, and even other races in the Holy Spirit Realm will cease to exist."
"The Star God has moved a large number of powerful warriors from the Witch Race, along with his companions, all of whom are now fighting on the front lines."
"It is the Star God who quietly bears everything for us!"
After Luo Chan finished speaking, the chat channel fell into a brief silence.
Then, the survivors’ minds were filled with a slew of question marks.
They never expected Luo Chan to suddenly say this.
Nor did they expect such events to be happening outside in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Those survivors asked, "Goddess Luo Chan, is what you said true? Is there really such a serious disaster happening outside?
"Goddess Luo Chan, will the Star God and the others succeed?"
"@Star River, Star God, how are things on your side?"
A pile of questions from the survivors were thrown out, many people in the chat channel mentioned Han Xing.
Regarding the Abyss Realm’s invasion, Han Xing hadn’t publicly mentioned it.
However, Han Xing’s close confidants, such as Lanlan and Mu Qing, knew about it.
It seems Luo Chan might have gotten the news from Lanlan.
Luo Chan also couldn’t answer these questions for them.
At this time, Han Xing and others, located in the Void, also saw the chat channel information.
This system feature is really powerful.
In the Void, they’re unable to trade items but can still communicate with survivors of the Holy Spirit Realm.
This was also a feature they used to pass the time during the bleak Void journey.
Seeing the overwhelming questions in the chat channel.
Han Xing then directly spoke inside.
"Everyone, I am Star River."
Seeing Han Xing’s name, the survivors were once again in a strong uproar.
"Holy crap! The Star God appeared!"
"Star God, I’m your fan!"
"Star God, is what Goddess Luo Chan said true? Is there really a war happening now in the Holy Spirit Realm?"
The survivors maintained their goofy style, amid it all was a slew of questions.
The screen-scrolling speed of billions of people was incredibly fast.
Han Xing directly enabled a group mute.
The chat channel instantly fell silent.
Then Han Xing slowly said, "Regarding the questions you all asked, I’ll explain a bit first."
"The first is about the war; this matter is true, the Holy Spirit Realm is indeed facing a terrible war."
"As for whether we can win the final victory, I have no certainty because this time the enemy is too strong."
Upon hearing this response, the survivors felt their hearts sink.
Han Xing continued, "And even if we win this war, we still can’t escape the crisis of annihilation."
"Because there are too many enemies, even stronger enemies might appear afterward."
His tone carried some heaviness.
The billions of survivors around the world felt a depressive cloud looming over their hearts.
After all, even the always invincible Star God was unsure of victory.
Among them, there were even two demigod-level powerhouses.
With a little imagination, the survivors realized how terrifying this enemy was.
Han Xing then said, "But besides these bad news, there is also good news."
"Which is, if we fail this time, it won’t be just our Human Race that gets exterminated, but all creatures in the Holy Spirit Realm."
Hearing Han Xing’s piece of good news, the survivors couldn’t help but roll their eyes.
Dragon Abyss, as the chat channel’s administrator, then helplessly said, "Star God, your good news might as well not be said."
His laughter carried a touch of helplessness.
Han Xing replied, "Yes, I originally didn’t want to tell you this, but you insisted on knowing."
Dragon Abyss continued to represent other survivors by asking, "Then, Star God, is there really no hope of defeating these enemies?"
Han Xing replied, "It’s not that there’s no hope at all; if there wasn’t any hope, we wouldn’t still be holding on at the front."
"There’s still some time for us to develop."
Upon hearing this, the survivors also breathed a sigh of relief.
However, they all felt a sense of urgency rise within them.
Since merging with the Witch Race Continent, the Human Race has had a few good years.
And now they realized these good times were because Han Xing and the others were enduring the pressure at the front and dealing with other races to negotiate safety.

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - 470: Entering a New World
paragraphs: When Han Xing finished speaking, the chat channel fell into silence.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled on the side, "Brother Xing, giving them such pressure all at once, most people can’t handle it, right?"
Han Xing also smiled, "It’s okay, if they can’t accept it, they can’t accept it, at most they will be downcast for a while or feel despair."
"And if the survivors can still strive forward despite knowing this information, they are good seeds for the future."
"They might even have a chance to break through to Legend."
"I’ll also have Lanlan keep an eye on these survivors, and provide them with resources to break through to Legend when the time comes."
After Han Xing finished speaking, the team members nodded in agreement.
They also understood that Han Xing’s decision was correct.
Although, for them, one or two Legends wouldn’t change much.
But at least it could enhance the foundation of the Human Race.
Just as Han Xing was about to close the chat channel.
He suddenly remembered something, and added one more line in the chat channel.
"Zhou Huang, no matter where you are now, and no matter what kind of deal you made with that woman, be cautious."
In the chat channel, the survivors saw Han Xing suddenly mention Zhou Huang, feeling baffled.
They discussed below, "What is the Star God warning Zhou Huang to be careful about?"
"Who is the woman he’s talking about?"
The survivors wore expressions of confusion.
After a moment, Zhou Huang, who hadn’t spoken in the chat channel for years, said, "I know."
Seeing Zhou Huang respond, Han Xing didn’t feel strange.
Then, he directly lifted the group mute on the chat channel.
The messages from the survivors flooded in like a torrential wave.
Han Xing did not continue watching, and directly closed the chat.
His gaze returned to the endless Void.
Under the scene simulation of the Divine Demon Battleship, everything here seemed so dark.
The God of Radiance said, "Master, this is the area which in my memory, the God of Light often visited.
Han Xing nodded upon hearing this, then looked around.
Here, too, was void.
Nothing but void.
Han Xing controlled the battleship, searching this area for almost a whole day, yet still couldn’t find any clues about the Light God’s Treasure Vault.
The next day, the Divine Demon Battleship had patrolled this area back and forth over ten times.
Han Xing turned around and asked in confusion, "Radiance, what’s going on?"
The God of Radiance thoughtfully recalled, "Master, according to the fragments of memories I absorbed, the location is indeed here."
"Since the God of Light often came here, it should not be wrong."
"However, the scene has some discrepancies."
Han Xing questioned in confusion, "Scene?"
The God of Radiance nodded and said, "In the memory fragments I absorbed, the area where the God of Light was located, featured blue skies, white clouds, a bright sun, and grasslands..."
At this point, the God of Radiance seemed to have thought of something.
He widened his eyes and exclaimed, "I think I know!"
Seeing such a strong reaction from the God of Radiance, everyone came over,
"Radiance, what have you understood?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
The God of Radiance replied excitedly, "The place where the God of Light is situated is a Small World within Chaos!"
"Small World?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, it’s unexpected, the God of Light actually possesses another world!"
Upon hearing this, everyone seemed to have understood something.
Han Xing asked, "You mean there is a hidden world in this area?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Very likely so, otherwise there’s no other explanation."
Han Xing continued to ask, "Is there any way to find this hidden world so that we can enter?"
Han Xing and others have been searching here for a day already.
And they haven’t discovered any clues regarding these Small Worlds.
Moreover, as the God of Radiance mentioned earlier, those Small Worlds hide themselves.
Aside from True Gods, it’s tough to find the whereabouts of these Small Worlds in the Void.
The God of Radiance also fell into contemplation.
He seemed to be rummaging through the memory fragments of the God of Light, looking for any clues.
After a moment, the eyes of the God of Radiance blazed with light as if a torch had been ignited.
"Got it!"
Cheng Jianyong asked, "What did you find, Radiance."
The God of Radiance replied, "From the previous memories, it seems that after the God of Light arrived here, he actively released his aura."
"Then, that Small World gradually revealed itself."
"And I absorbed the Divine Power of the God of Light, so I have the aura of the God of Light on me."
"Let me try to see if I can bring that Small World out."
Upon hearing this, everyone understood the method that the God of Radiance was referring to.
Once said, the God of Radiance directly released boundless Divine Power.
Tens of thousands of kilometers around the area were covered in radiant light.
In the Void, those violent energies began to surge.
And in the amazed gazes of Han Xing and others.
A massive sphere suddenly emerged.
This sphere rivals the size of the Beast of Calamity, being as colossal as a star.
The Divine Demon Battleship of Han Xing and the others was as insignificant as a mosquito before this sphere.
Thus it could be seen how large this world is, nurturing a huge amount of life within.
"Huh, the surface of this world seems to have a transparent shield?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Everyone also saw that transparent shield.
The God of Radiance explained, "This shield is the World Barrier that new Small Worlds also have."
"The World Barrier is extremely sturdy and can shield the probing of Divine Power."
Everyone’s faces showed a look of realization.
No wonder they wandered in the Void for so long and couldn’t find any trace of this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - 470: Entering the New World_2
paragraphs: At this moment, the God of Radiance said something that surprised them again: "Moreover, because of the existence of the World Barrier, the flow of time inside is different from that of our external world."
A look of astonishment flashed in everyone’s eyes.
Han Xing asked, "Is the time flow faster or slower?"
The God of Radiance replied, "Allow me to sense it first."
With that, he directly extended a sliver of divine power, cautiously approaching the layer of the World Barrier.
Very quickly, the God of Radiance retracted the sliver of divine power.
Looking at Han Xing, he replied, "Returning to the master, it’s clear, the flow of time within this world is slower."
"We spend a day in the Void, which equates to roughly ten days inside."
Everyone was shocked once again.
Whoa!
A 1:10 time flow ratio!
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "Does that mean if we stay inside for 10 years, only 1 year passes outside?"
The God of Radiance nodded.

Cheng Jianyong exclaimed again in excitement, "That’s amazing! Just like those cultivation novels, I could plant an elixir inside, and after a thousand years, harvest it as a ten-thousand-year-old elixir!"
"A day’s vacation could be extended to ten days inside!"
Everyone rolled their eyes at him again.
Shen Yun said speechlessly, "I thought you would come up with something grand, but is this all?"
Cheng Jianyong rolled his eyes back, "What’s wrong with that? Don’t tell me you haven’t thought about it!"
"Remember in high school, you always said the vacation time wasn’t enough, and you couldn’t play games?"
Shen Yun paused, realizing he indeed had thought that way before.
The God of Radiance laughed and said, "Your method is theoretically feasible.
"Moreover, the larger the world, the slower the world’s time flow."
"Some worlds can even achieve time flow ratios of 1:100 or even 1:1000."
The more the God of Radiance spoke, the more shocked everyone felt.
Even though they currently didn’t know what mastering these small worlds could be used for, merely extending time 10 times or even 1000 times was already defying the natural order!
The God of Radiance smiled and said, "However, as previously mentioned, entering these worlds isn’t easy."
"They all have a layer of World Barrier, and only entities recognized by the World Will can enter."
"Furthermore, all beings have a limited lifespan."
"Even if our time inside is extended, what’s consumed is still our own lifespan."
Everyone nodded in realization.
At this point, Han Xing suddenly recalled one of the uses of the World Will.
It can allow a world that has died to regain will and come back to life.
So wouldn’t this mean that Han Xing could have a world of his own?
This speculation might be true.
But he only has one World Will at hand, and this idea still needs testing.
At this moment, the scenery within the world gradually became clear.
Through the transparent World Barrier, everyone saw the scene inside.
Then, shock appeared in their eyes simultaneously.
This is a world similar to the Holy Spirit Realm, with floating Sky Islands.
However, compared to the Holy Spirit Realm, this world is evidently much smaller.
But still comparable to a star.
If there is life here, the quantity must be quite astonishing.
"Wow... This world is just like a replica of the Holy Spirit Realm," Cheng Jianyong remarked.
Everyone nodded together.
After observing for a moment, Han Xing asked, "Radiance, how do we get inside now?
The God of Radiance pondered for a moment, then replied, "In the God of Light’s brief memory segment, there’s no method for entering these small worlds."
"However, based on my experience, it’s quite difficult for us external entities to enter these small worlds."
"Because to the will of these small worlds, we are essentially invaders and won’t be easily allowed to enter them."
"Moreover, if we forcibly breach the World Barrier, it would trigger the world’s Will to counterattack."
"Counterattack?"
"Yes, if this world perceives danger, it will use all means to deal with us."
After hearing this, Han Xing asked in confusion, "Are the counterattack methods of the World Will strong?"
The God of Radiance shook his head, "The World Will has no combat power."
"It will only summon the creatures of this world to oppose us."
"But in such small worlds, it’s difficult to even produce a Demigod, so generally, no existence would be a match for us."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Then what are we waiting for? Let’s just breach the World Barrier directly!"
The God of Radiance shook his head, "Let’s not rush. Although this small world’s counterattack methods pose no threat to us."
"If we breach the World Barrier, there will be certain disadvantages."
Han Xing asked, "What are the disadvantages?"
The God of Radiance replied, "If we forcefully breach the World Barrier, then this world loses its means of protection and will become like the Holy Spirit Realm, unable to hide anymore."
"Moreover, this world would lose its capability of slowing time flow."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing seemed to recall something and asked, "Are you saying that the Holy Spirit Realm’s World Barrier has already been breached?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, otherwise how could there be so many Void Beasts invading the Holy Spirit Realm?"
Understanding dawned on Han Xing.
He learned more about the Holy Spirit Realm’s information.

chapters.title: Chapter 892 - 470: Entering the New World_3
paragraphs: It turns out that the Holy Spirit Realm once also had a World Barrier.
It was just breached by some terrifying beings.
This led to the emergence of so many Void regions in the Holy Spirit Realm, allowing the Void Beasts to invade on a large scale.
At this moment, Han Xing sighed and said: "I wonder how strong the time flow was in such a big realm like the Holy Spirit Realm before the World Barrier was breached."
"Could it have been 1 to 10,000?"
The God of Radiance shook his head, as he wasn’t very sure about this aspect either.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at this layer of transparent World Barrier, with a look of contemplation flashing in his heart.
If possible, he didn’t want to use such a brute force method to breach it.
So Han Xing asked: "Is there another way?"
The God of Radiance nodded.
"Yes, there is, and that is to use a transmission method that disregards the World Barrier."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing and the others exchanged glances, then joy appeared simultaneously on their faces.
Because they had the ability of the Oracle Throne, a transmission method that disregards space and barriers.
According to the God of Radiance, it could directly transmit them into this small world.
So Han Xing said: "Radiance, we can directly transmit inside, do you have any methods?"
The God of Radiance was momentarily startled, then shook his head and said, "No, Master."
Han Xing rolled his eyes, "Then let’s try and see if we can bring you in as well."
The Oracle Throne can transmit up to five people at once, but fortunately, each of them had an Oracle Throne.
However, Han Xing was not sure if a Divine Spirit like the God of Radiance would be considered as their teammate by the system.
Therefore, Han Xing directly left the team.
Then he activated the Divine Oracle Summon effect.
The next moment, a white light appeared on the God of Radiance’s body.
Everyone’s faces lit up with joy.
There’s hope!
And the God of Radiance also felt as if he was enveloped by a peculiar Divine Power, directly merging into the space.
His eyes displayed a look of amazement.
Han Xing then said, "I’ll go in with Radiance first, you all follow me and transmit in, just leave the Divine Demon Battleship here."
The next moment, Han Xing and the God of Radiance vanished from where they were.
The team members nodded at each other.
Then, Zhang Lianmeng also activated the Oracle Throne effect, enveloping everyone together.
"Buzz!"
Then, six figures simultaneously appeared inside this small world.
Above was a clear blue sky, with white clouds floating.
The sunlight here was so bright, as if there was never a night.
In the distance, one after another, Sky Islands loomed, with lush green lawns, flowers, castles, streams on top...
Everything seemed like a dreamlike scene.
Each Sky Island here was independent.
For example, in the central area, a massive Sky Island was floating, with a budding town on it.
And around this Sky Island were small Sky Island fragments, clustered around this main city.
On these Sky Island fragments, there might be a forest or a lake.
Or perhaps a small village.
They were at some distance from each other but collectively formed a whole.
Closest to Han Xing and the others was a small Sky Island fragment.
Several small wooden houses were built under the greenery-laden hills, seemingly forming a small village.
Han Xing and the others also saw a few humans dressed in plain linen clothes, working with tools by the fields.
The system notification appeared.
"You have discovered an unknown small world, world influence +2831, World Mark +5."
Han Xing was taken aback, "Huh, entering these small worlds also grants World Mark rewards?"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy.
It seemed he had found another way to acquire World Marks.
After all, if the Celestial Rail Strike Device was strong enough, Han Xing would like to set up a few more.
So, he needed to obtain more World Marks.
Han Xing said, "Radiance, cloak our auras so the beings of this world don’t detect our power."
The God of Radiance nodded and then released Divine Power.
The next moment, no trace of Divine Power fluctuation leaked from any of them, including the God of Radiance.
They appeared to be just a few ordinary people.
Soon, Han Xing and the others directly flew to that Sky Island fragment.
Then they came to the side of those humans.
In front of Han Xing, a system notification appeared.
"Villager: McLain"
"Level: 1"
"Attributes: Power 3, agility 2, Spirit 3, Constitution 4"
"Skills: None"
"Villager: Kureya"
"Level: 1"
"Attributes: Power 2, agility 3, Spirit 3, Constitution 3"
"Skills: None"
Humans, indigenous humans of this world.
Han Xing asked, "Friends, may I ask what this place is called?"
Before speaking, Han Xing and the others had already heard the villagers’ conversations.
They were surprisingly using the language of the Holy Spirit Realm.
This made everyone feel quite surprised.
However, after thinking for a moment, they understood the reason.
This was likely related to the God of Radiance.
At this moment, seeing Han Xing and the others dressed in exotic clothes, the villagers’ eyes showed a look of astonishment.
"Honorable lords, could you be the legendary Knights?"
Han Xing was a bit surprised.
Knights? Such a familiar term.
In those Western fantasy novels he read on Blue Star, Knights represented extraordinary power of this world.
So he nodded and said, "I guess so."
The next moment, the villagers exchanged glances and then exclaimed with delight, "Knights! Knights have come to Hundred Fruit Garden!"
"Quick, notify the village chief!"
With these words, the villager named Kureya began sprinting through the flower-filled little village, shouting joyfully.
"Knights! Knights have come to our village!"
"Everyone, come out and see!"

chapters.title: Chapter 893 - 471: Earth Knight and Apocalypse Knight
paragraphs: After a short while, villagers began to emerge from the small houses, men and women, young and old.
They were all dressed in coarse linen clothes, with expressions of amazement on their faces.
At this time, an elderly man, supported by the villagers, came to Han Xing and the others.
"Distinguished Knights from afar, I am Barnaby, the village chief of Hundred Fruit Garden."
After saying this, the village chief was about to kneel before Han Xing and the others.
Han Xing quickly stopped him, "Chief Barnaby, there’s no need for formalities."
However, the village chief insisted, "According to the kingdom’s law, commoners must kneel before nobility."
"You knights protect the land of our Cloud Sea Kingdom from invasion, giving us a place to survive."
"You are more worthy of our respect than those noble lords."
After speaking, the village chief disregarded their protests and led the other villagers to kneel down simultaneously.
Everyone exchanged looks, not knowing how to act for a moment, and decided to stop protesting.
Moments later, all the villagers stood up.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Chief Barnaby, you just mentioned that the land is under invasion. Who is attacking our Cloud Sea Kingdom?"

The old village chief replied, "It’s the Cliff Kingdom. They are deploying an army of knights, directing those giant dragons to invade us. Many villages and cities have suffered invasions from the Cliff Kingdom."
Cheng Jianyong continued to ask, "And why did the war start?"
This old village chief seemed somewhat puzzled to hear this question.
After all, in his understanding, these issues are common knowledge.
Even the newborns of Cloud Sea Kingdom know this.
And they are not only asking who is invading the Cloud Sea Kingdom but also why the war started.
Though puzzled, Chief Barnaby continued, "Because those noble lords are competing for the title of Legendary Knight."
"Legend has it that only in the war of blood and fire can the strongest knight be forged."
"And the ultimate victor will become the Legendary Knight."
"Then, this Legendary Knight will receive the divine summons, opening the sacred Gate of Heaven."
"Gate of Heaven?" Han Xing asked again.
When Han Xing asked this question, the surrounding villagers were already suspicious.
They exchanged looks and became alert.
Some villagers even began cautiously moving back.
However, as beings possessing demigod-level combat strength, their little movements could hardly escape Han Xing’s eyes.
Han Xing simply waved his hand.
The villagers instantly entered a bewildered state.
Eyes vacant, staring dazedly ahead.
This was a small trick of divine power application.
Han Xing continued to ask, "What is the Gate of Heaven?"
The old village chief shook his head dazedly, "I don’t know... According to legend, behind the Gate of Heaven is the abode of divine spirits."
"Only the strongest knight is qualified to go to the Gate of Heaven."
Divine spirits?
Everyone exchanged looks, could there really be divine spirits in this world?
Han Xing looked over at the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance pondered for a moment and shook his head, "Master, I haven’t sensed any aura of divine spirits."
"Of course, it could be that they have used some means to hide themselves."
Han Xing nodded and decided not to dwell on this issue further.
He asked the village chief questions just to understand the basic situation of this world and locate the Light God’s Treasure Vault.
So, Han Xing continued to ask, "Do you know about the God of Light?"
The group of villagers all shook their heads in confusion.
It seems they don’t know about this either.
Then clues must be sought from these so-called divine spirits.
However, to find these divine spirits, one must first open the Gate of Heaven.
Hence, Han Xing asked, "How is the Gate of Heaven opened?"
Chief Barnaby continued to shake his head, "I... I don’t know..."
The village chief seemed to be in a state of knowing nothing, which is typical under mind control.
Han Xing continued to ask, "Is there anyone who knows?"
Chief Barnaby paused, then said bewilderedly, "His Majesty the King should know."
"He is hailed as the Knight of Destiny and is the most hopeful to become the Legendary Knight."
Everyone exchanged looks, not expecting to uncover some crucial clues in this small village.
Han Xing continued to ask, "Where is His Majesty the King now?"
Chief Barnaby continued to shake his head in confusion.
This was true of the other villagers as well.
Han Xing furrowed his brows, "Does anyone know the king’s whereabouts?"
Chief Barnaby continued, "You... can go to Fuyun City and check..."
"Fuyun City... is the territory of the Duke of Blington. He is the Earth Knight of the Cloud Sea Kingdom... and should know the king’s location..."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded again.
Through this village chief’s dialogue, they have already acquired many clues.
And now, their purpose is clear.
That is to first find this so-called duke, then through him locate the King of the Cloud Sea.
Afterwards, they can inquire about the clues regarding the ’Gate of Heaven’.
As for the village chief’s mention of the Duke of Blington possessing the strength of an Earth Knight.
Although they don’t know how powerful an Earth Knight is, to the current Han Xing and others, there’s basically no existence in this small world that can threaten them.
Cheng Jianyong said at this time, "By the way, Brother Xing, why don’t we just have the God of Radiance directly release divine power to investigate?"
"With his strength, this small world could be enveloped in his divine power domain, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 894 - 471: Earth Knight and Apocalypse Knight_2
paragraphs: Everyone simultaneously looked at the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance said, "That’s right, under my Divine Power Domain, there are practically no secrets in this world that can be hidden from me."
"But as I mentioned before, this world has its own consciousness."
"Once I display my divine power, it will be perceived by the world’s consciousness, triggering a backlash."
"At the same time, our divine power fluctuations could also be sensed by certain existences in this world, possibly causing some kind of incident."
"Moreover, the other party might even flee with the items from the treasure vault."
The crowd nodded in sudden realization.
Han Xing then said, "Radiance is right; our goal is to open the God of Light’s treasure vault, not to contend with the will of this world."
"Besides, with our speed, in just a day or two, we can explore the entire world."
After asking the villagers a few more questions, Han Xing confirmed there was nothing else to extract.
Han Xing looked at the God of Radiance and said, "Radiance, that’s enough, now erase their memories."
With Han Xing’s current power, he couldn’t erase these ordinary people’s memories without harming their brains.
This involves an issue of controlling the Divine Power Value.
Because Han Xing’s grasp of the Divine Power Value is not yet that precise.
In other words, he hasn’t touched the rules.
So, this task is safest left to the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance nodded in agreement.
Then, he sent a surge of divine power towards these villagers...
The villagers stood blankly for a few minutes before regaining their senses.
They looked at each other and said confusedly, "How did I get here? Wasn’t I cooking in the room?"
"Same here, I remember picking Sweet Fruit from a tree, and then I lost track of what happened."
The old village chief seemed lost in thought, shaking his head and saying, "If you can’t remember, don’t think about it. Just go on with what you were doing."
In an instant, the villagers dispersed like birds and animals.
A few minutes later.
Everyone reappeared mid-air.
And Han Xing also found out the location of the Duke of Blington.
In Fuyun City, not far ahead.
Han Xing looked at his teammates and said, "This time, we don’t all need to go over there; it’s enough for Radiance and me to go."
"You all wait here."
The teammates nodded in agreement.
After all, if all six of them acted together, it would indeed attract too much attention.
Moreover, after spending time together, they knew the God of Radiance wouldn’t harm them.
In the next moment.
Han Xing and the God of Radiance turned into a stream of light and vanished from their original spot.
"Whoosh!"
The movement speed at the Divine Level is comparable to the teleportation state of a Divine Demon Battleship.
And even more formidable than the teleportation state.
What concept is this?
They initially were about a hundred thousand kilometers from Fuyun City.
However, under the God of Radiance’s divine power, Han Xing felt as if he entered that space tunnel again.
Two seconds later, he appeared right at the location of Fuyun City.
This speed is worthy of being called divine.
"Not bad, Radiance, your speed is almost like instant movement."
The God of Radiance smiled, "It’s just a small trick of the Light Element rules, nothing worth mentioning."
Han Xing nodded and redirected his focus forward.
In the near distance, a massive Sky Island appeared.
This Sky Island had numerous buildings, with all kinds of towers and castles.
The wide streets were bustling with people, and even some soldiers were directing traffic.
This was a prosperous city, with the technology level resembling the steam era.
Various airships and cars were seen operating on the streets.
Han Xing sensed around a bit and found many existences above Tier Two in this medieval-style town.
The strongest presence detected was located at the center of the city.
Roughly with Lord Level Tier Three strength.
Han Xing contemplated, "This presence should belong to the Duke of Blington."
"Is what was described as the Earth Knight equivalent to Tier Three?"
Without further thought, Han Xing and the God of Radiance flashed their figures.
Directly arriving at the city center.
A splendid castle appeared in front of them.
And at the castle entrance, the words [Duke’s Mansion] were prominently displayed.
Upon seeing this, Han Xing knew he had come to the right place.
Therefore, he directly said, "Radiance, hide our forms, let’s go in directly."
The God of Radiance nodded, then cast a divine power barrier over Han Xing.
In the next moment, they vanished from the spot.
Although the God of Radiance wasn’t a divine spirit of shadow or darkness.
He could still employ simple methods like hiding forms.
He just wasn’t as specialized in this aspect as other divine spirits.
But in this world, there was essentially no existence that could detect them.
The two of them entered the castle openly without drawing anyone’s attention.
They passed through corridors and gardens.
Encountering many maids with superior figures and appearances.
They were graceful and coordinated, with even their steps being uniform.
As they passed by Han Xing, a fragrant aroma of petals wafted through the air.
Yet they remained completely oblivious.
Han Xing continued forward.
Along the way, he also encountered many patrolling soldiers and some knights with Tier Two strength.
However, what puzzled Han Xing was that the castle seemed to be almost entirely inhabited by females.

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - 471: Earth Knight and Apocalypse Knight_3
paragraphs: Whether it’s the soldiers or the patrolling knights, all are beautiful women with excellent figures.
Especially those female knights.
Thanks to long-term training and good physical condition, each one has a tall physique and well-shaped hips.
Tied in high ponytails, wearing silvery armor, they have a bit of a playful style.
Han Xing looked somewhat odd and said, "Is this Duke of Blington a woman? Why is the whole castle full of women?"
The God of Radiance listened, revealing a meaningful smile to Han Xing.
Then, they went straight to the innermost part of the castle.
At this moment, Han Xing understood what the God of Radiance’s smile meant.
Strange sounds continued to come from within the room.
Han Xing frowned and directly unleashed Divine Power.
Taking in everything inside.
A big-bellied guy was battling fiercely in the grand hall.
Under his feet were a group of maids or female knights who had all collapsed.
This guy was the Duke of Blington, with Tier Three strength.
Under his formidable physique, those Tier One and Tier Two, and even some maids, couldn’t withstand his devastation.
That’s why there are so many women in this room.
At this point, Han Xing also understood why there were no other men in the castle.
All the women here, whether knights or maids,
were the Duke of Blington’s tools.
Han Xing rolled his eyes, "Tsk tsk, these guys are living quite lavishly."
"A Tier Three individual can rule the world, living a lifestyle akin to an emperor."
To know, among the current human survivors, Tier Three is already a very ordinary level.
Nowadays, anyone not breaking through to Tier Four would be called lazy.
The God of Radiance laughed, "After all, the power level of this world isn’t high, Tier Three is considered a strong figure.
"Plus, he has the duke’s title, allowing him to live such a degenerate life."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, he directly snapped his fingers.
"Snap!"
The next moment.
In this room, whether it was the Duke of Blington or those women collapsed on the floor, their eyes showed confusion.
Han Xing, with the God of Radiance, stepped over those women lying on the ground.
Headed straight to the duke’s side.
"Where is the King of the Cloud Sea now?"
The duke did not struggle and answered honestly, "In the... Vanessa Continent."
Han Xing continued to ask, "Where is the Vanessa Continent?"
The duke gave a location.
Han Xing nodded and went on, "What is the King of the Cloud Sea doing there?"
"His Majesty the King... is leading the army of knights to fight the Cliff Kingdom for the Sun Crystal Fragment."
"It’s said that in two more years, the real Sun Crystal will fall..."
"At that time, His Majesty the King and King of the Cliff will determine the victor, deciding who will become the Legendary Knight of this era..."
Han Xing nodded.
After asking a few more questions, he looked at the women lying scattered on the ground.
Then he looked at the God of Radiance and asked, "Radiance, is there a way to make this guy reform and harm less of these female knights and maids?"
The God of Radiance laughed, "Of course there is; a mortal’s desire is nothing more than external stimuli received by the brain, requiring some method of release."
"Just need to change the target of desire release, such as shifting from women to men, or even stones..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing couldn’t help but shudder.
"Wow! You guys, divine spirits, your methods are this vicious?"
The God of Radiance was speechless.
Isn’t it what you asked for?
Han Xing pondered for a moment, then suddenly showed a meaningful smile and said, "Radiance, alter his desire target."
"Make it, a fanatic obsession with reading various books, being uncomfortable if he doesn’t read for an hour. How about that?
"After all, knowledge is power."
"I think, after absorbing so much knowledge, this duke would certainly govern his territory better."
The God of Radiance said nothing but casually struck the Duke of Blington with a Divine Power.
"It’s done, master."
Han Xing was taken aback, not expecting the God of Radiance to act so quickly.
Then, Han Xing nodded, and their figures vanished from the castle...
A few minutes later, the duke also got up from the ground.
Around him, those female knights regained consciousness but had no memory of what had just happened.
They only knew that they fainted under the abuse of the Duke of Blington.
At this moment, the duke looked around at the grand hall, his gaze resting on each female knight.
Seeing the duke’s look, these female knights trembled.
Among them, a female knight’s eyes settled on a certain decision, even though she had been through much torment, she still clenched her teeth and stood up.
Just as this female knight was about to sit, she saw the duke directly push her aside.
"Move away!"
The female knight thought she had somehow offended the duke and was immediately frightened, trembling.
However, the duke looked at a shelf beneath him, furrowed his brows, and said, "Get out, all of you get out!"
His voice was loud, even startling the maids and female knights lying limp on the ground.
They had no idea what madness the duke was into.
But in fear, they immediately picked up the clothes from the floor and fled the hall.
A moment later, the duke shouted at the door, "Where are my books!"
"Quickly move my bookshelf over!"

chapters.title: Chapter 896 - 472: Sun Crystal
paragraphs: A few minutes later.
Han Xing and the God of Radiance reappeared beside the team members.
Han Xing said, "Let’s go, I’ve found out the location."
Everyone nodded, none asked what had happened in Fuyun City.
After all, the time Han Xing and the others left this time was less than ten minutes in total.
As the words fell, wrapped in the Divine Power of the God of Radiance, six streams of light crossed the sky, rushing towards the same place at high speed.
It was mentioned before that there may be Divine Spirit Level power in this world.
To avoid detection, the God of Radiance controlled the fluctuation of Divine Power, keeping the group’s movement speed at Demigod Level.
But even at Demigod Level movement speed, it was still very fast.
It reached a speed of over half a million kilometers per hour.
Two hours later, they crossed millions of kilometers and arrived at the central area of this world.
A massive Sky Island Continent appeared in front of them.
This Sky Island also looked full of greenery, with various picturesque mountains, lakes, and even waterfalls descending from the sky.
Apart from these landscapes, there were traces of wars everywhere.
According to the Duke of Blington, this continent is the main battlefield of two kingdoms.
The knight armies from both sides were engaged in a life-and-death struggle here.
Far off, they indeed sensed many Tier Two to Tier Four presences on that Sky Island Continent.
Among them, there were quite a few Tier Five presences.
But most were Elite Level and Leader Level.
Cheng Jianyong also sensed those powerful presences and exclaimed, "Wow, so many knights."
"What are they all gathered here for?"
Han Xing replied, "According to that duke, they seem to be fighting over something called Sun Crystal."
"Sun Crystal?"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s said that these crystals contain infinite power.
"Just a fragment, once absorbed by an ordinary person, can even turn someone into an Earth Knight, which is Tier Three power, in a short time."
Upon hearing this, everyone was surprised.
Although Tier Three is of no use to them.
But discovering such a significant strength-enhancing item in a small world still surprised the group a bit.
Moreover, it’s just the effect of one fragment.
The true ’Sun Crystal’ would likely have a more powerful effect.
At that moment, the sun above everyone’s heads suddenly exploded with intense light.
Under this light, they even sensed a hint of the Rule’s fluctuation.
Shen Yun asked, "What is this?"
Han Xing said, "This is what they mentioned, the burst of the Sun Crystal Fragment."
"Next, some fragments will fall onto various parts of this continent."
Just as the words fell.
From the sky, dazzling meteors indeed descended, dispersing in various corners.
And those knights seemed to know the Sun Crystal was about to fall here, already waiting in various regions of the continent.
At the moment the crystal fragments appeared, tens of millions of eyes simultaneously looked towards the sky.
Their gaze was only full of that dazzling light.
At the same time, those knights controlled the horses beneath them, raised the longswords in their hands and shouted, "Charge! For His Majesty the King! For glory!"
"Kill!"
Rumble!
On both sides combined, close to fifty million knights charged simultaneously.
Throughout this massive Sky Island Continent, vibrations occurred everywhere.
Battles could happen on plains, on mountains, or even in lakes.
Both sides displayed their prowess.
"Roar!!"
In the camp of the Cloud Sea Kingdom, a black silhouette suddenly charged into the sky with a terrifying might.
Han Xing saw that it was a Giant Dragon with double wings on its back, covered entirely in black scales.
It looked somewhat like a Shadow Giant Dragon, but its strength was worlds apart.
And on its back, there was also a Dragon Knight dressed in black armor, with a cold gaze.
The knights of the Cloud Sea Kingdom below exclaimed, "Look, that is Ahmed, one of the only five Sky Knights of our Cloud Sea Kingdom!"
"Lord Ahmed is so powerful! But the dragon beneath him is even stronger!"
"Yeah, truly incredible how Lord Ahmed managed to tame such a powerful creature."
This black dragon has only Tier Four Lord Level strength.
However, despite this, it’s overwhelming for those knights below, who are mostly Tier Two and Tier Three.
"Roar!"
The black dragon opened its mouth, roaring as flames swept thousands of meters.
The might was indeed shocking.
And those knights touched by the flames, regardless of their strength, were instantly turned into ashes.
Even their armor and weapons melted directly into molten iron.
In an instant, the knights of the Cliff Kingdom suffered heavy losses.
At this moment, from the Cliff Kingdom’s side, a gigantic white tiger charged forward.
That white tiger carried a formidable Power of Frost.
The knights of the Cliff Kingdom began to exclaim.
In the next moment, the white tiger collided with the black dragon in battle.
Han Xing and the others watched this scene with interest.
Their perspective in the air was like playing a 3D sand table game.
The knight armies below were like ants, engaging in direct combat there.
"Slash! Slash, slash, slash!"
The Great Sword swung, limbs flying.
Both sides went back and forth, constantly assaulting each other’s formations.
At this moment, a Tier Three knight shouted, "Don’t get caught up in the fight, quickly seize the Sun Crystal Fragment!"
The other knights realized too, having been caught up in the fight, almost forgetting their purpose.
