chapters.title: Chapter 897 - 472: Sun Crystal (2)
paragraphs: At the same time, one meteor after another began to fall from the sky.
"The Sun Crystal Fragments have fallen, go grab them quickly!"
On this battlefield, hundreds of thousands of knights started frantically rushing toward the direction where the crystals were falling.
At this moment, a young knight, whose strength had just reached Tier Two and still appeared quite young, was fighting fiercely with the enemy.
He suddenly saw one of the crystals falling straight toward his head.
At that moment, this young knight immediately forced the enemy back.
Then he reached out and caught the dazzling crystal emanating colorful light.
Then, without hesitation, he swallowed it.
In the next moment, Han Xing and others noticed that the momentum of this young knight skyrocketed instantly, breaking through from Tier Two to Tier Three!
Seeing this scene, the other knights’ eyes immediately filled with yearning.
Then they began to fight even more crazily.
"Kill!"
The people observing the battle from the air were also somewhat surprised by the crystal’s effect.
Cheng Jianyong said with interest, "This crystal is something, it actually allowed him to break through to Tier Three instantly, without encountering any bottleneck."
Han Xing also nodded.
Then, upon seeing a meteor falling from the sky, he directly unleashed his divine power and intercepted it.
Below, those watching the sky knights suddenly saw one of the meteors disappear and were a bit surprised.
But soon, their attention was drawn to more crystals.
After Han Xing collected that crystal fragment.
A system notification appeared.
[Obtained Light Crystal Fragment (Purple) *1]
[Light Crystal Fragment (Purple): A crystal containing extremely faint Power of Light. Upon consumption, it increases 500 points of the four-dimensional attributes.]
Seeing the introduction above the system, the crowd seemed to understand something,
"So, these Sun Crystals are actually left by the God of Light."
Shen Yun pondered, "In that case, this war among the knights is probably intentional by the God of Light.
"I just don’t know what the purpose of this guy is in doing so."
Cheng Jianyong said, "Didn’t that old village chief say? They have to determine the final victor to become Legendary Knights before they can enter the Gate of Heaven."
"These Legendary Knights are probably all absorbed into the God of Light’s force."
"He might be using this method to cultivate his own team."
Shen Yun was a bit surprised and said, "Not bad, Xiaoyongzi, you’ve learned to analyze things now."
Cheng Jianyong gave him a blank look.
After watching the battle below for a while longer, they lost interest.
Han Xing directly said, "Let’s go, find the King of the Cloud Sea and ask if there’s a way to open the Gate of Heaven in advance."
"If we wait for them to kill a Legendary Knight, who knows how long it will take."
The group nodded in agreement, knowing Han Xing made sense.
Then Han Xing released his divine power perception.
After scanning across the entire continent, he discovered two incredibly powerful auras.
Both had the strength of Tier Five Dominator Level, just a step away from Legend.
Han Xing’s eyes showed a thoughtful look.
These two auras are probably from the Kings of the Cloud Sea Kingdom and the Cliff Kingdom.
Clearly, the others also sensed these two kings’ auras.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, who do we visit first now? The Cloud Sea Kingdom or the Cliff Kingdom?"
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing directly said, "Let’s go to the Cloud Sea Kingdom."
The group nodded together.
In the next moment, the five figures flashed.
Rushing swiftly toward a certain place on this continent.
Soon, they discovered an ancient city.
The city walls were lined with various cannons, and from time to time, they could see patrolling soldiers.
Evidently, this was a well-defended city.
And this was the stronghold of the Cloud Sea Kingdom.
In Han Xing’s perception, that Tier Five Dominator level aura was inside.
As the God of Light’s divine power was unleashed, the six silhouettes vanished from their original place.
Then, they openly and unceremoniously entered the city.
Smoothly making their way straight through, heading for the tallest building in the city.
Upon entering the building, they arrived at the entrance of a grand hall.
The door was closed, and besides that Tier Five Dominator level aura, there were also several Tier Four and Tier Five auras.
At this moment, the King of the Cloud Sea seemed to sense a peculiar aura outside the hall.
Although he did not exactly perceive what it was.
But in the heart of the King of the Cloud Sea, a sense of impending death surrounded him.
He lifted his head, a flash of shock flickered in his eyes.
Instinctively, he gripped the sword at his waist.
Bear in mind, he was already a top powerhouse in this world; nothing should be able to give him this kind of feeling.
At this moment, the heart of the King of the Cloud Sea was filled with overwhelming waves.
But because he had been in a high position for so long, he had developed a calm demeanor in the face of danger.
He nonchalantly made an eye gesture towards the nearby guards.
However, outside the hall, the crowd took in all his expressions and movements.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "Brother Xing, this King of the Cloud Sea has some skills, he can actually sense our presence."
Han Xing nodded, "After all, he’s also at Tier Five Dominator Level, just a step away from Legendary."
"A strong person of this level has very keen crisis premonition."
Then Han Xing said, "Let’s go in directly; no need to play games with him."
The group nodded in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - 472: Sun Crystal_3
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong directly reached out and pushed open the iron door of the hall.
"Screech!"
In front of Han Xing and the others, a man appeared seated on the Iron Throne, looking like a middle-aged man in his forties.
At this moment, he was wearing heavy armor, with a sword hanging at his waist.
Seeing the appearance of Han Xing and the others, his heart was suddenly startled.
"Who... are you?" the King of the Cloud Sea asked in a deep voice.
In this world, most people have Western faces.
And Han Xing and his companions had distinctly Eastern faces, which were visibly different.
Han Xing did not answer.
The King of the Cloud Sea also sensed something was wrong.
The next moment, several Tier Four and Tier Five guardians drew their weapons, ready to charge at Han Xing and the others.
And at this moment, Han Xing casually snapped his fingers.
"Snap!"
The group of sword-drawing guardians froze in their movements, a bewildered look appearing in their eyes.
The shock in the eyes of the King of the Cloud Sea deepened.
To know, controlling so many Sky Knights with a mere finger snap was an unheard-of method!
The King of the Cloud Sea was about to draw his sword.
But Han Xing calmly said, "I advise you to put the sword back and not make any attacking moves against us."
His tone was very calm, yet the King of the Cloud Sea’s action froze in place.
At this moment, the King of the Cloud Sea seemed to realize how terrifying these few people were.
In the arena, the aura of each individual gave him the feeling of an ant facing an elephant.
It was a suppression of life level!
The more he sensed, the more sweat dripped from his forehead.
To know, the King of the Cloud Sea was already a top-tier strongman in this world.
For two hundred years, he had fought across this world, rarely encountering an adversary.
The only one who could match him was the one from the Cliff Kingdom.
But now, so many strongmen had suddenly appeared, completely shattering his understanding.
He suddenly realized something and quickly said, "You... could you be beings descended from the Gate of Heaven?
Aside from this possibility, the King of the Cloud Sea couldn’t figure out why so many strongmen had suddenly appeared.
Even wracking his brains, he wouldn’t think that Han Xing and the others were strongmen from another world.
The group exchanged glances.
Han Xing did not answer but instead asked, "Now I will ask you a few questions. If you cooperate obediently, I won’t do anything to you."
Han Xing did not use any means to control the King of the Cloud Sea.
Because reaching the Tier Five Dominator Level, it was already very difficult to control someone like a mortal.
However, the God of Radiance could still do it, but there was no need.
Facing Han Xing’s words, the King of the Cloud Sea showed a thoughtful expression in his eyes.
Before he could respond, Han Xing directly asked, "Do you know how to open the Gate of Heaven in advance?"
As this sentence came out, the King of the Cloud Sea suddenly realized something.
These people weren’t strongmen descended from the Gate of Heaven!
"Are you... strongmen who have been secluded somewhere?" the King of the Cloud Sea asked.
Han Xing waved his hand directly, "Enough, stop probing, quickly tell us the method, we don’t have much time."
The King of the Cloud Sea was taken aback, seemingly sensing the impatience in Han Xing’s tone.
He also knew that if he angered these peerless strongmen, the consequences would be terribly horrific.
When that time comes, not to mention himself, the entire Cloud Sea Kingdom might be wiped out in an instant!

The King of the Cloud Sea took a deep breath and quickly replied, "To answer the distinguished lords, if a certain Chosen Knight breaks through to a Legendary Knight, and we then perform the Divine Descent Ceremony, the Gate of Heaven will open."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this, "I see, then it’s much simpler."
"Basically, you’re saying that if you break through to a Legend, you can open the Gate of Heaven?"
The King of the Cloud Sea paused, carefully speaking, "In theory, that’s the way it is."
Han Xing asked, "What are you still missing to break through to a Legend?"
The King of the Cloud Sea replied, "I need a Heart of the Sun Crystal to break through."
"What is that?" Han Xing asked.
The King of the Cloud Sea explained, "It’s the item the knights outside are competing for."
"However, what they are competing for are just fragments of the Sun Crystal, the power within them is not strong.
"In two years, the Sun Crystal will have the grandest burst it has once every two hundred years."
"At that time, the Heart of the Sun will appear."
After listening to the explanation from the King of the Cloud Sea, Han Xing asked in confusion, "Do you mean you’d have to wait two more years before you can break through to a Legend?"
The King of the Cloud Sea nodded, "Yes."
Han Xing furrowed his brow, he didn’t have time to wait so long.
So, Han Xing asked, "Is there any way to make it explode earlier, or other means to capture the Sun Crystal sooner?"
The King of the Cloud Sea was startled, shocked by Han Xing’s bold idea.
Then, he shook his head and said, "This... no one has ever tried it."
"However, according to legend, the Sun Crystal is located in the area above the cloud layer where the sun resides."
"Even the strongest Chosen Knight cannot approach."
After hearing this, Han Xing showed a look of joy.
According to what the King of the Cloud Sea said, the Sun Crystal exists as a physical entity above this world.
The knights of this world could not approach it, but that doesn’t mean Han Xing and his companions can’t.
Thus, Han Xing looked at the God of Radiance and said, "Radiance, go for a trip, be careful not to be discovered."
The God of Radiance nodded, "Understood."
The next moment, without any hesitation, his figure disappeared from where he stood.
The King of the Cloud Sea looked at the young man in front of him and the other handsome man’s conversation, completely unaware of what Han Xing’s words meant.
However, just a few minutes later.
Suddenly, all living beings in the world felt the sun above their heads flicker.
The world fell into momentary darkness.
Fortunately, the darkness lasted less than a second, and the sun returned to its original state.
At this moment, the King of the Cloud Sea was watching the sky overhead in shock.
Although he didn’t know what had happened, he had a premonition in his heart.
The phenomenon that just occurred with the sun was related to this group of people.

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - 473: The Choice of Destiny
paragraphs: This is a sun that shines on a world, yet it was extinguished so effortlessly by these entities!
This is terrifying!
Before he could think further.
The God of Radiance had already returned to Han Xing’s side,
Then, a dark purple crystal appeared in his hand, emitting intense waves of divine power.
"Master, I got it."
The God of Radiance said casually, then tossed the dark purple crystal to Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded,
However, at this moment, the heart of the King of the Cloud Sea was already raging with tumultuous waves!
He recognized this crystal; it was the Sun Crystal that he and the King of the Cliff had fought over for nearly two hundred years!
My God! What happened?
Could it be that this mysterious man, in the course of a conversation, went to where the Sun was and took the crystal down?
This completely exceeded the King of the Cloud Sea’s imagination!
Even those legendary knights, or the divine spirits inside the Gate of Heaven, couldn’t do that, right?
And what was even more terrifying!
This existence, so powerful that it was beyond the comprehension of the King of the Cloud Sea, was actually calling that young man "Master"!
How powerful must that young man be?
Where did this group of mysterious powerhouses come from?
The King of the Cloud Sea was filled with a flood of strong questions.
However, the crowd felt nothing.
It’s known that after devouring the divine power of the God of Light, the power of the God of Radiance had already surpassed the God of Light.
In this world, there was truly nothing that could threaten him.
Han Xing was examining the dark purple crystal in his hand.
[Light God’s Rule Fragment: After consumption by Tier Five and above entities, divine power value can be increased by 500 points.]
A look of realization appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
So that’s why those knights would break through to become legends after absorbing this rule fragment.
In Tier Five, the difference between legend and non-legend is divine power value.
Only by mastering divine power value can one truly reach the Legendary Realm.
Although this rule fragment might be of some use to Han Xing, it’s not that important.
The urgent matter now is to let this King of the Cloud Sea break through to legend.
Then, everyone will head to the Gate of Heaven to find the God of Light’s treasure trove.
So, Han Xing directly threw the rule fragment to the King of the Cloud Sea.
"Take it."
At this moment, the King of the Cloud Sea, who accepted the crystal, still had disbelief in his eyes.
After all, this is a divine artifact that could turn someone into a legendary knight!
It appears only once every two hundred years, yet the other party just gave it to him.
Seeing his shocked gaze, Han Xing said, "Alright, don’t waste time, quickly use this crystal to break through."
The King of the Cloud Sea calmed his shocked heart, then nodded.
In the great hall, he directly opened his mouth and swallowed the crystal.
The next moment, a force he had never encountered surged within him.
In the King of the Cloud Sea’s eyes, once again filled with shock, there was now a touch of realization.
So this is... the difference between legend and non-legend?
At the same time, a strong aura erupted from him.
And it rapidly swept through the city.
Even the entire Vanessa Continent was engulfed by this terrifying aura.
"Buzz!"
The knights battling tens of thousands of miles away felt a suppression deep in their souls.
"Oh my God! Such a terrifying aura!"
"Whose power is this? It feels more powerful than His Majesty the King!"
"What’s happening?"
This group of knights continually exclaimed.
And across the continent, a middle-aged man clad entirely in black armor instantly raised his head.
He gazed in the direction of the King of the Cloud Sea’s stronghold, shock in his eyes: "This is... the vibration only those legendary knights would have!"
"Could it be that Rashim has broken through to legend?"
"How is that possible? It’s not yet time for the Heart of the Sun to burst!"
Despite the disbelief in his heart, this legendary level aura couldn’t be ignored.
And just as the King of the Cliff was about to rush out to investigate what was happening.
Suddenly—
He felt a terrifying aura rapidly approaching him.
Realizing who was behind that aura, intense shock appeared in the eyes of the middle-aged man in black armor!
"My God! It’s really Rashim!"
"He actually broke through to legend?!"
The King of the Cliff was filled with fear!
At this point, as if realizing something, his expression suddenly changed.
"Not good!"
"Rashim must be coming for me!"
The King of the Cliff directly drew his longsword, broke through the room, and soared into the sky, beginning to escape rapidly!
"Whoosh!"
A stream of light began speeding towards him.
He knew that as King of the Cliff Kingdom, he and the King of the Cloud Sea were mortal enemies.
The first thing both would do upon breaking through to legend would definitely be to eliminate their opponent.
Now that Rashim has already arrived!
The King of the Cliff started fleeing at high speed.
However, even though he possessed Tier Five Dominator Level strength,
comparing to a legendary level powerhouse, the gap was just too great.
It only took a few seconds before he was caught by Rashim.
"Roman, why are you running?" the voice of the King of the Cloud Sea emerged.
"Rashim, don’t kill me!" the King of the Cliff exclaimed.
"I am willing to submit! I am willing to submit!"
At this moment, the King of the Cliff didn’t even put up a fight and directly chose to surrender.
Because he knew clearly how vast the gap was between himself and a legendary knight!
However, Rashim, holding a longsword, was completely unmoved.
The Cloud Sea Kingdom and the Cliff Kingdom had been warring for so many years, with every possible tactic used to the extreme.

After all, this is a divine artifact that could turn someone into a legendary knight!
It appears only once every two hundred years, yet the other party just gave it to him.
Seeing his shocked gaze, Han Xing said, "Alright, don’t waste time, quickly use this crystal to break through."
The King of the Cloud Sea calmed his shocked heart, then nodded.
In the great hall, he directly opened his mouth and swallowed the crystal.
The next moment, a force he had never encountered surged within him.
In the King of the Cloud Sea’s eyes, once again filled with shock, there was now a touch of realization.
So this is... the difference between legend and non-legend?
At the same time, a strong aura erupted from him.
And it rapidly swept through the city.
Even the entire Vanessa Continent was engulfed by this terrifying aura.
"Buzz!"
The knights battling tens of thousands of miles away felt a suppression deep in their souls.
"Oh my God!
Such a terrifying aura!"
"Whose power is this?
It feels more powerful than His Majesty the King!"
"What’s happening?"
This group of knights continually exclaimed.
And across the continent, a middle-aged man clad entirely in black armor instantly raised his head.
He gazed in the direction of the King of the Cloud Sea’s stronghold, shock in his eyes: "This is... the vibration only those legendary knights would have!"
"Could it be that Rashim has broken through to legend?"
"How is that possible?
It’s not yet time for the Heart of the Sun to burst!"
Despite the disbelief in his heart, this legendary level aura couldn’t be ignored.
And just as the King of the Cliff was about to rush out to investigate what was happening.
Suddenly—
He felt a terrifying aura rapidly approaching him.
Realizing who was behind that aura, intense shock appeared in the eyes of the middle-aged man in black armor!
"My God!
It’s really Rashim!"
"He actually broke through to legend?!"
The King of the Cliff was filled with fear!
At this point, as if realizing something, his expression suddenly changed.
"Not good!"
"Rashim must be coming for me!"
The King of the Cliff directly drew his longsword, broke through the room, and soared into the sky, beginning to escape rapidly!
"Whoosh!"
A stream of light began speeding towards him.
He knew that as King of the Cliff Kingdom, he and the King of the Cloud Sea were mortal enemies.
The first thing both would do upon breaking through to legend would definitely be to eliminate their opponent.
Now that Rashim has already arrived!
The King of the Cliff started fleeing at high speed.
However, even though he possessed Tier Five Dominator Level strength,
comparing to a legendary level powerhouse, the gap was just too great.
It only took a few seconds before he was caught by Rashim.
"Roman, why are you running?" the voice of the King of the Cloud Sea emerged.
"Rashim, don’t kill me!" the King of the Cliff exclaimed.
"I am willing to submit!
I am willing to submit!"
At this moment, the King of the Cliff didn’t even put up a fight and directly chose to surrender.
Because he knew clearly how vast the gap was between himself and a legendary knight!
However, Rashim, holding a longsword, was completely unmoved.
The Cloud Sea Kingdom and the Cliff Kingdom had been warring for so many years, with every possible tactic used to the extreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - 473: Choices of Fate_2
paragraphs: What knightly spirit, what royal glory.
None of it compares to their becoming Legendary Knights.
History is written by the victors!
After two hundred years of battle, both sides have suffered great sacrifices, long becoming bitter enemies that cannot rest till one is dead.
Rashim could absolutely never forgive the other side.
This has been the tradition of all the Legendary Knights throughout the generations.
Upon becoming a legend, they would immediately slay their adversary at once!
Rashim unsheathed his sword directly.
At this moment, the King of the Cliff saw such decisiveness from the opponent and felt a surge of ruthlessness inside!
"Damn it! I don’t believe that you, having just broken through, can be that strong!"
He also drew his sword from his waist and thrust fiercely.
However, a layer of faint blue divine power appeared from the King of the Cloud Sea’s longsword.
The instant the two longswords made contact, a crisp sound rang out.
"Ding!"
The next moment, the longsword in the King of the Cliff’s hand was instantly severed.
And then, he watched as the longsword pierced into his heart.
In the final moment of his life, the King of the Cliff murmured, "Is this the power of Legendary Level?"
"Why? Why do I not possess it?"
With just one encounter, the King of the Cliff was decisively defeated.
This scene highlighted explicitly the saying that all under Legend are mere ants.
The King of the Cloud Sea, having just broken through, had the power to instantly kill the King of the Cliff.
The King of the Cliff was also quite unlucky.
If at the time, Han Xing had chosen to seek him out for intelligence on the Gate of Heaven, then maybe it would be the King of the Cloud Sea who is dead now.
Thus, while it’s said that all under Legend are mere ants.
Yet, legendary powerhouses also appear as ants before demigods, or even divine spirits.
A mere thought from Han Xing could decide the fate of these powerhouses.
Similarly, one thought can decide Han Xing’s fate from those true gods, or even more terrifying existences.
It was precisely because Han Xing understood this that he would relentlessly strive to make himself stronger.
"Swipe!"
The King of the Cloud Sea wielded his sword directly, severing the King of the Cliff’s head.
Then, he picked up the head, transforming into a stream of light, and returned to the continent.
The next moment, he arrived amidst the knights’ battlefield, shouting, "The King of the Cliff has been slain by me!"
"Knights of the Cliff Kingdom, you now have thirty seconds to surrender immediately."
"Otherwise, no pardon will be given!"
"No pardon!!!"
The King of the Cloud Sea’s voice, aided by divine power, spread across the entire continent.
All the knights heard his incredibly intimidating voice.
And when they heard that the King of the Cliff had been slain, everyone’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
"How is this possible? His Majesty the King delivered a war speech to us just this morning!"
"That’s right, His Majesty was the Chosen Knight; who could kill him?"
Yet, the next moment, they saw the King of the Cloud Sea holding that still bleeding head.
The face was indeed the King of the Cliff.
"Heavens! His Majesty the King!"
"Ah!! Great Majesty the King, how could you have been slain so swiftly?"
"It’s over, the Cliff Kingdom is over!"
The knights of the Cliff Kingdom felt as if their hearts had died, one by one casting their weapons to the ground.
"Clang... clang klang..."
Even the knights of the Cloud Sea Kingdom found it incredibly hard to believe.
The battle between the two kingdoms had lasted nearly two hundred years.
The King of the Cliff and the King of the Cloud Sea, two Chosen Knights, had battled each other for over a hundred years, evenly matched, unable to defeat one another.
However, in just one morning, the situation changed drastically.
At this moment, some knights from the Cliff Kingdom still refused to accept this fact.
They shouted, "Everyone do not surrender, that isn’t His Majesty the King! He could not have died so easily!"
"It must be some illusion technique by the King of the Cloud Sea!"
Yet the knight who shouted had barely uttered a sound.
A stroke of blue sword qi came at them directly from one thousand miles away.
"Swipe!"
Not only was this knight instantly slain, but in that entire area, the bodies of ten thousand knights from the Cliff Kingdom were instantly cut in two.
This is the terror of legendary level.
Thousands of miles away, killing at a mere thought.
At that moment, all knights of the Cliff Kingdom were shocked by the King of the Cloud Sea’s formidable combat power.
And they all believed, truly, that the King of the Cliff was dead.
One by one, they discarded their weapons and kneeled on one knee to the ground.
This action represented their collective surrender.
The knights of the Cloud Sea Kingdom let out cries of victory.
"Long live His Majesty the King!"
"His Majesty the King is invincible!"
On July 23rd, Year 51321 of the Cloud Sea Kingdom.
The war lasting two hundred years came to an end on this day.
Ten minutes later.
The King of the Cloud Sea returned to Han Xing and others.
Without waiting for more words, Han Xing spoke directly, "How long will it take to hold your ceremony?"
The King of the Cloud Sea pondered for a moment and replied, "Not long, mainly, I need to select an heir to my power."
"When the Gate of Heaven opens, I must leave here, heading to the world beyond the gate."
Han Xing nodded, "Then make it quick, can it be done today?"
A trace of helplessness appeared in the King of the Cloud Sea’s eyes.
In fact, there was one more thing he hadn’t told Han Xing.
That is, once he goes to the Gate of Heaven, he might never return to this world.
After all, tens of thousands of years have passed, and those Legendary Knights who entered the Gate of Heaven never returned.
Clearly, he was destined for the same fate.
